entries.explanation: A sign or transmission that conveys information.

examples.hanzi: 山里的手机信号很弱。
examples.pinyin: shān lǐ de shǒu jī xìn hào hěn ruò.
examples.english: The phone signal is weak in the mountains.

examples.hanzi: 绿灯是可以通行的信号。
examples.pinyin: lǜ dēng shì kě yǐ tōng xíng de xìn hào.
examples.english: A green light is a signal to proceed.

entries.explanation: Enter details to create an account or membership.

examples.hanzi: 注册前请阅读使用说明。
examples.pinyin: zhù cè qián qǐng yuè dú shǐ yòng shuō míng.
examples.english: Read the instructions before signing up.

examples.hanzi: 我用邮箱注册了学习账号。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yòng yóu xiāng zhù cè le xué xí zhàng hào.
examples.english: I used my email to register a study account.

entries.explanation: Transmit a message, file or other information.

examples.hanzi: 照片太大，暂时无法发送。
examples.pinyin: zhào piàn tài dà, zàn shí wú fǎ fā sòng.
examples.english: The photo is too large to send right now.

examples.hanzi: 老师把作业发送到了班级群。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī bǎ zuò yè fā sòng dào liǎo bān jí qún.
examples.english: The teacher sent the homework to the class group.

parts.gloss: to send; to deliver; to transmit

entries.explanation: Spend approved time away from work.

examples.hanzi: 她休假期间去了海边。
examples.pinyin: tā xiū jià qí jiān qù le hǎi biān.
examples.english: She visited the seaside while on leave.

examples.hanzi: 经理下周休假，由同事接替工作。
examples.pinyin: jīng lǐ xià zhōu xiū jià, yóu tóng shì jiē tì gōng zuò.
examples.english: The manager is on leave next week; a colleague will cover.

entries.explanation: Take a photo quickly without arranging the subject.

examples.hanzi: 这张照片是她跑步时抓拍的。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhào piàn shì tā pǎo bù shí zhuā pāi de.
examples.english: This photo was captured while she was running.

examples.hanzi: 记者抓拍到了孩子的笑脸。
examples.pinyin: jì zhě zhuā pāi dào liǎo hái zi de xiào liǎn.
examples.english: The reporter captured a child's smiling face.

entries.explanation: Make another version of text, a file or an object.

examples.hanzi: 请复制这段文字到文档里。
examples.pinyin: qǐng fù zhì zhè duàn wén zì dào wén dàng lǐ.
examples.english: Copy this passage into the document.

examples.hanzi: 重要文件可以复制到另一块硬盘。
examples.pinyin: zhòng yào wén jiàn kě yǐ fù zhì dào lìng yí kuài yìng pán.
examples.english: Important files can be copied to another hard drive.

entries.explanation: Stop an activity or connection before it finishes.

examples.hanzi: 网络故障中断了视频会议。
examples.pinyin: wǎng luò gù zhàng zhōng duàn le shì pín huì yì.
examples.english: A network fault interrupted the video meeting.

examples.hanzi: 讨论被敲门声中断了。
examples.pinyin: tǎo lùn bèi qiāo mén shēng zhōng duàn le.
examples.english: A knock at the door interrupted the discussion.

entries.explanation: Bring together the main points or lessons learned.

examples.hanzi: 请用三句话总结这篇文章。
examples.pinyin: qǐng yòng sān jù huà zǒng jié zhè piān wén zhāng.
examples.english: Summarize this article in three sentences.

examples.hanzi: 比赛结束后，队员一起总结经验。
examples.pinyin: bǐ sài jié shù hòu, duì yuán yì qǐ zǒng jié jīng yàn.
examples.english: After the match, the players reviewed what they had learned.

entries.explanation: A device used for long-term computer storage.

examples.hanzi: 这块硬盘存着很多旧照片。
examples.pinyin: zhè kuài yìng pán cún zhe hěn duō jiù zhào piàn.
examples.english: This hard drive stores many old photos.

examples.hanzi: 电脑的硬盘坏了，文件读不出来。
examples.pinyin: diàn nǎo de yìng pán huài le, wén jiàn dú bù chū lái.
examples.english: The computer's hard drive failed, so the files cannot be read.

entries.explanation: A numerical result in an exam or competition.

examples.hanzi: 老师没有公布每个人的分数。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī méi yǒu gōng bù měi ge rén de fēn shù.
examples.english: The teacher did not announce everyone's score.

examples.hanzi: 这次比赛的分数比上次高。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì bǐ sài de fēn shù bǐ shàng cì gāo.
examples.english: The score in this competition is higher than last time.

entries.explanation: Supply electrical energy to a rechargeable battery.

examples.hanzi: 手机没电了，我正在充电。
examples.pinyin: shǒu jī méi diàn le, wǒ zhèng zài chōng diàn.
examples.english: My phone is flat, so I am charging it.

examples.hanzi: 这盏台灯充电后可以用一整晚。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǎn tái dēng chōng diàn hòu kě yǐ yòng yì zhěng wǎn.
examples.english: This lamp can last all evening after being charged.

entries.explanation: Ask permission to be absent from school or work.

examples.hanzi: 她发烧了，向老师请假。
examples.pinyin: tā fā shāo le, xiàng lǎo shī qǐng jià.
examples.english: She has a fever and asked her teacher for leave.

examples.hanzi: 明天有家事，我需要请假一天。
examples.pinyin: míng tiān yǒu jiā shì, wǒ xū yào qǐng jià yì tiān.
examples.english: I have a family matter tomorrow and need a day off.

entries.explanation: Send a written reply to an earlier message.

examples.hanzi: 收到你的信后，我马上回信。
examples.pinyin: shōu dào nǐ de xìn hòu, wǒ mǎ shàng huí xìn.
examples.english: I wrote back as soon as I received your letter.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷还没有回信，我有点担心。
examples.pinyin: yé ye hái méi yǒu huí xìn, wǒ yǒu diǎn dān xīn.
examples.english: Grandfather has not written back, so I am a little worried.

parts.gloss: to go back; to return; to turn back; to turn around

entries.explanation: A single page of content on the internet.

examples.hanzi: 这个网页上有课程安排。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge wǎng yè shàng yǒu kè chéng ān pái.
examples.english: The course schedule is on this web page.

examples.hanzi: 网页一直打不开，可能是网络问题。
examples.pinyin: wǎng yè yì zhí dǎ bù kāi, kě néng shì wǎng luò wèn tí.
examples.english: The page will not open; it may be a network problem.

entries.explanation: A language other than one's native language.

examples.hanzi: 她正在学习第二门外语。
examples.pinyin: tā zhèng zài xué xí dì èr mén wài yǔ.
examples.english: She is learning a second foreign language.

examples.hanzi: 这份说明书有几种外语版本。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn shuō míng shū yǒu jǐ zhǒng wài yǔ bǎn běn.
examples.english: These instructions are available in several foreign languages.

entries.explanation: A screen that displays computer output.

examples.hanzi: 这台显示器比旧的清楚。
examples.pinyin: zhè tái xiǎn shì qì bǐ jiù de qīng chu.
examples.english: This monitor is clearer than the old one.

examples.hanzi: 请把显示器调低一点，眼睛更舒服。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ xiǎn shì qì tiáo dī yì diǎn, yǎn jing gèng shū fu.
examples.english: Lower the monitor a little to make viewing more comfortable.

entries.explanation: A numbered or named part of a longer text.

examples.hanzi: 本书最后一个章节讲学习方法。
examples.pinyin: běn shū zuì hòu yí ge zhāng jié jiǎng xué xí fāng fǎ.
examples.english: The last chapter discusses study methods.

examples.hanzi: 我们按章节整理了阅读笔记。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men àn zhāng jié zhěng lǐ le yuè dú bǐ jì.
examples.english: We organized our reading notes by chapter.

entries.explanation: A control pressed to operate a device.

examples.hanzi: 遥控器上的按键有点松。
examples.pinyin: yáo kòng qì shàng de àn jiàn yǒu diǎn sōng.
examples.english: A button on the remote control is loose.

examples.hanzi: 请不要同时按下两个按键。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bú yào tóng shí àn xià liǎng gè àn jiàn.
examples.english: Do not press two keys at the same time.

entries.explanation: The final part of a calendar year.

examples.hanzi: 我们年底会整理一次旧照片。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men nián dǐ huì zhěng lǐ yí cì jiù zhào piàn.
examples.english: We sort our old photos at the end of the year.

examples.hanzi: 这座图书馆预计年底开放。
examples.pinyin: zhè zuò tú shū guǎn yù jì nián dǐ kāi fàng.
examples.english: This library is expected to open at the end of the year.

entries.explanation: Written content considered as words rather than images.

examples.hanzi: 这个工具可以从图片中提取文本。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge gōng jù kě yǐ cóng tú piàn zhōng tí qǔ wén běn.
examples.english: This tool can extract text from images.

examples.hanzi: 请把文本改成更容易读的句子。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ wén běn gǎi chéng gèng róng yì dú de jù zi.
examples.english: Rewrite the text using sentences that are easier to read.

entries.explanation: The short interval between two lessons.

examples.hanzi: 课间我们到走廊透透气。
examples.pinyin: kè jiān wǒ men dào zǒu láng tòu tòu qì.
examples.english: We get some fresh air in the corridor between classes.

examples.hanzi: 请利用课间准备好下节课的书。
examples.pinyin: qǐng lì yòng kè jiān zhǔn bèi hǎo xià jié kè de shū.
examples.english: Use the break to get the books for the next lesson ready.

entries.explanation: A classmate who shares or sits beside one's desk.

examples.hanzi: 同桌借给我一块橡皮。
examples.pinyin: tóng zhuō jiè gěi wǒ yí kuài xiàng pí.
examples.english: My desk mate lent me an eraser.

examples.hanzi: 我和同桌一起检查答案。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hé tóng zhuō yì qǐ jiǎn chá dá àn.
examples.english: My desk mate and I checked our answers together.

entries.explanation: The place where an examination is held.

examples.hanzi: 进入考场前请关掉手机。
examples.pinyin: jìn rù kǎo chǎng qián qǐng guān diào shǒu jī.
examples.english: Turn off your phone before entering the exam room.

examples.hanzi: 准考证上写着考场的位置。
examples.pinyin: zhǔn kǎo zhèng shàng xiě zhe kǎo chǎng de wèi zhì.
examples.english: The exam admission card shows the exam venue.

entries.english: fail to meet the passing mark
entries.explanation: Receive a result below the required standard.

examples.hanzi: 他这次考试不及格，需要补考。
examples.pinyin: tā zhè cì kǎo shì bù jí gé, xū yào bǔ kǎo.
examples.english: He failed this exam and needs to retake it.

chunks.gloss: fail to meet the passing mark

examples.hanzi: 作业漏做太多，成绩可能不及格。
examples.pinyin: zuò yè lòu zuò tài duō, chéng jì kě néng bù jí gé.
examples.english: Too much homework is missing, so the grade may be a fail.

chunks.gloss: fail to meet the passing mark

parts.gloss: fail to meet the passing mark

entries.explanation: A short message sent through a mobile phone service.

examples.hanzi: 我收到一条提醒上课的短信。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shōu dào yì tiáo tí xǐng shàng kè de duǎn xìn.
examples.english: I received a text reminding me about class.

examples.hanzi: 验证码短信还没有到。
examples.pinyin: yàn zhèng mǎ duǎn xìn hái méi yǒu dào.
examples.english: The verification text has not arrived yet.

entries.explanation: Maintain social contact with other people.

examples.hanzi: 她喜欢和不同年龄的人交往。
examples.pinyin: tā xǐ huan hé bù tóng nián líng de rén jiāo wǎng.
examples.english: She enjoys interacting with people of different ages.

examples.hanzi: 与邻居交往时要尊重彼此的习惯。
examples.pinyin: yǔ lín jū jiāo wǎng shí yào zūn zhòng bǐ cǐ de xí guàn.
examples.english: Respect each other's habits when interacting with neighbors.

entries.explanation: Inner feelings that connect people to experiences or others.

examples.hanzi: 这篇文章表达了对家乡的情感。
examples.pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng biǎo dá le duì jiā xiāng de qíng gǎn.
examples.english: This article expresses feelings for the writer's hometown.

examples.hanzi: 音乐能帮助人们表达情感。
examples.pinyin: yīn yuè néng bāng zhù rén men biǎo dá qíng gǎn.
examples.english: Music can help people express their emotions.

entries.explanation: Something a device or service is designed to do.

examples.hanzi: 这个软件增加了录音功能。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge ruǎn jiàn zēng jiā le lù yīn gōng néng.
examples.english: This software added a recording function.

examples.hanzi: 我最常用的是提醒功能。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zuì cháng yòng de shì tí xǐng gōng néng.
examples.english: The reminder function is the one I use most.

entries.explanation: A small camera built into or connected to a device.

examples.hanzi: 视频开始前，请检查摄像头。
examples.pinyin: shì pín kāi shǐ qián, qǐng jiǎn chá shè xiàng tóu.
examples.english: Check the webcam before the video starts.

examples.hanzi: 门口的摄像头只拍公共区域。
examples.pinyin: mén kǒu de shè xiàng tóu zhī pāi gōng gòng qū yù.
examples.english: The camera by the door records only the public area.

entries.explanation: Select and join sections of a recording.

examples.hanzi: 我把采访录音剪接成了一个短片。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ cǎi fǎng lù yīn jiǎn jiē chéng le yí ge duǎn piàn.
examples.english: I edited the interview recording into a short film.

examples.hanzi: 剪接时不要改变说话人的原意。
examples.pinyin: jiǎn jiē shí bú yào gǎi biàn shuō huà rén de yuán yì.
examples.english: Do not change the speaker's meaning when editing.

entries.explanation: Capture sound for later listening.

examples.hanzi: 这段录音里有老师的发音示范。
examples.pinyin: zhè duàn lù yīn lǐ yǒu lǎo shī de fā yīn shì fàn.
examples.english: This recording contains the teacher's pronunciation examples.

examples.hanzi: 录音前要征得在场人的同意。
examples.pinyin: lù yīn qián yào zhēng dé zài chǎng rén de tóng yì.
examples.english: Get permission from those present before recording.

entries.explanation: A telephone call received by a phone.

examples.hanzi: 我开会时没有注意到来电。
examples.pinyin: wǒ kāi huì shí méi yǒu zhù yì dào lái diàn.
examples.english: I did not notice the incoming call during the meeting.

examples.hanzi: 手机上显示了三次未接来电。
examples.pinyin: shǒu jī shàng xiǎn shì le sān cì wèi jiē lái diàn.
examples.english: The phone shows three missed calls.

entries.explanation: Stop temporarily with the possibility of continuing.

examples.hanzi: 请暂停视频，我想记下这句话。
examples.pinyin: qǐng zàn tíng shì pín, wǒ xiǎng jì xià zhè jù huà.
examples.english: Pause the video; I want to write down this sentence.

examples.hanzi: 雨太大，比赛只能暂停。
examples.pinyin: yǔ tài dà, bǐ sài zhǐ néng zàn tíng.
examples.english: The rain was so heavy that the match had to pause.

entries.explanation: The exchange of messages through communication systems.

examples.hanzi: 山区的通讯条件改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: shān qū de tōng xùn tiáo jiàn gǎi shàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: Communications in the mountains have improved greatly.

examples.hanzi: 这台设备用于应急通讯。
examples.pinyin: zhè tāi shè bèi yòng yú yìng jí tōng xùn.
examples.english: This device is used for emergency communications.

entries.explanation: Take in a message, signal or transmitted file.

examples.hanzi: 电脑正在接收老师发来的文件。
examples.pinyin: diàn nǎo zhèng zài jiē shōu lǎo shī fā lái de wén jiàn.
examples.english: The computer is receiving the file sent by the teacher.

examples.hanzi: 这台收音机能接收本地节目。
examples.pinyin: zhè tái shōu yīn jī néng jiē shōu běn dì jié mù.
examples.english: This radio can receive local programs.

entries.explanation: A device that picks up sound for amplification or recording.

examples.hanzi: 说话时请靠近麦克风。
examples.pinyin: shuō huà shí qǐng kào jìn mài kè fēng.
examples.english: Move closer to the microphone when speaking.

examples.hanzi: 麦克风关着，大家听不见你的声音。
examples.pinyin: mài kè fēng guān zhe, dà jiā tīng bu jiàn nǐ de shēng yīn.
examples.english: The microphone is off, so nobody can hear you.

entries.explanation: A short assessment of knowledge or ability.

examples.hanzi: 明天有一个听力测验。
examples.pinyin: míng tiān yǒu yí ge tīng lì cè yàn.
examples.english: There is a listening quiz tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 这次测验不计入总成绩。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì cè yàn bú jì rù zǒng chéng jì.
examples.english: This quiz does not count toward the final grade.

entries.explanation: How much of a planned activity has been completed.

examples.hanzi: 我们按周检查学习进度。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men àn zhōu jiǎn chá xué xí jìn dù.
examples.english: We check our study progress each week.

examples.hanzi: 下雨影响了修路的进度。
examples.pinyin: xià yǔ yǐng xiǎng le xiū lù de jìn dù.
examples.english: Rain affected the progress of the road repairs.

entries.explanation: Operating without a physical connecting wire.

examples.hanzi: 这副无线耳机需要先充电。
examples.pinyin: zhè fù wú xiàn ěr jī xū yào xiān chōng diàn.
examples.english: These wireless earphones need charging first.

chunks.gloss: FU (measure word for pairs or sets)

examples.hanzi: 会议室提供无线网络。
examples.pinyin: huì yì shì tí gōng wú xiàn wǎng luò.
examples.english: The meeting room provides a wireless network.

entries.explanation: A place or account used to receive mail.

examples.hanzi: 请把课程资料发到我的邮箱。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ kè chéng zī liào fā dào wǒ de yóu xiāng.
examples.english: Send the course materials to my email inbox.

examples.hanzi: 我每天早上检查一次邮箱。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang jiǎn chá yí cì yóu xiāng.
examples.english: I check my inbox every morning.

entries.explanation: Stop a device by turning its power off.

examples.hanzi: 离开前请给电脑关机。
examples.pinyin: lí kāi qián qǐng gěi diàn nǎo guān jī.
examples.english: Shut down the computer before leaving.

examples.hanzi: 手机关机后就收不到电话了。
examples.pinyin: shǒu jī guān jī hòu jiù shōu bú dào diàn huà le.
examples.english: The phone cannot receive calls once it is switched off.

entries.explanation: Enter an account to access a service.

examples.hanzi: 输入密码后就可以登录。
examples.pinyin: shū rù mì mǎ hòu jiù kě yǐ dēng lù.
examples.english: You can log in after entering the password.

examples.hanzi: 我换了手机，需要重新登录。
examples.pinyin: wǒ huàn le shǒu jī, xū yào chóng xīn dēng lù.
examples.english: I changed phones and need to log in again.

entries.explanation: The most important parts of a topic.

examples.hanzi: 老师把要点写在黑板上。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī bǎ yào diǎn xiě zài hēi bǎn shàng.
examples.english: The teacher wrote the main points on the board.

examples.hanzi: 请先告诉我报告的要点。
examples.pinyin: qǐng xiān gào su wǒ bào gào de yào diǎn.
examples.english: Tell me the main points of the report first.

entries.explanation: Reach the required passing standard.

examples.hanzi: 这次考试要六十分才能及格。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì kǎo shì yào liù shí fēn cái néng jí gé.
examples.english: You need sixty points to pass this exam.

examples.hanzi: 只求及格还不够，要弄懂错题。
examples.pinyin: zhī qiú jí gé hái bú gòu, yào nòng dǒng cuò tí.
examples.english: Passing alone is not enough; understand the mistakes.

entries.explanation: Recorded sound and moving images considered together.

examples.hanzi: 图书馆有专门的音像资料室。
examples.pinyin: tú shū guǎn yǒu zhuān mén de yīn xiàng zī liào shì.
examples.english: The library has a room for audio and video materials.

examples.hanzi: 这些音像资料记录了村里的旧习俗。

entries.explanation: An additional copy of an original document.

examples.hanzi: 请保留一份合同副本。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎo liú yì fèn hé tóng fù běn.
examples.english: Keep a copy of the contract.

examples.hanzi: 修改前先建立文档副本。
examples.pinyin: xiū gǎi qián xiān jiàn lì wén dàng fù běn.
examples.english: Make a copy of the document before editing it.

entries.explanation: A mirrored representation or complete copy of a system.

examples.hanzi: 相机预览中的镜像和照片方向不同。
examples.pinyin: xiàng jī yù lǎn zhōng de jìng xiàng hé zhào piàn fāng xiàng bù tóng.
examples.english: The mirrored camera preview faces a different direction from the photo.

examples.hanzi: 安装前先检查系统镜像是否完整。
examples.pinyin: ān zhuāng qián xiān jiǎn chá xì tǒng jìng xiàng shì fǒu wán zhěng.
examples.english: Check that the system image is complete before installation.

entries.explanation: Copy recorded material or computer files.

examples.hanzi: 我把照片拷贝到新的电脑上。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ zhào piàn kǎo bèi dào xīn de diàn nǎo shàng.
examples.english: I copied the photos to the new computer.

examples.hanzi: 这些资料不能随意拷贝给别人。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiē zī liào bù néng suí yì kǎo bèi gěi bié ren.
examples.english: These materials must not be copied to others without permission.

entries.explanation: Retrieve and interpret information from a source.

examples.hanzi: 软件正在读取文件。
examples.pinyin: ruǎn jiàn zhèng zài dú qǔ wén jiàn.
examples.english: The software is reading the file.

examples.hanzi: 这张卡损坏后，设备无法读取。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng kǎ sǔn huài hòu, shè bèi wú fǎ dú qǔ.
examples.english: The device cannot read this card after it was damaged.

entries.explanation: Produce spoken or visible content by reading.

examples.hanzi: 请把这个词的拼音读出来。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhè ge cí de pīn yīn dú chū lái.
examples.english: Read the pinyin of this word aloud.

examples.hanzi: 电脑不能读出这份旧文件的内容。
examples.pinyin: diàn nǎo bù néng dú chū zhè fèn jiù wén jiàn de nèi róng.
examples.english: The computer cannot retrieve the contents of this old file.

parts.gloss: to read out; to read aloud
to go out; to come out

entries.explanation: Bring stored information into a running program.

examples.hanzi: 游戏正在载入新的场景。
examples.pinyin: yóu xì zhèng zài zǎi rù xīn de chǎng jǐng.
examples.english: The game is loading a new scene.

examples.hanzi: 文件太大，载入需要一点时间。
examples.pinyin: wén jiàn tài dà, zǎi rù xū yào yì diǎn shí jiān.
examples.english: The file is large and takes a little time to load.

entries.explanation: Join a device or service to a larger network.

examples.hanzi: 新电脑已经接入学校网络。
examples.pinyin: xīn diàn nǎo yǐ jīng jiē rù xué xiào wǎng luò.
examples.english: The new computer has connected to the school network.

examples.hanzi: 这个接口可以接入外部麦克风。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge jiē kǒu kě yǐ jiē rù wài bù mài kè fēng.
examples.english: An external microphone can be connected through this port.

entries.explanation: Change from one mode, view or item to another.

examples.hanzi: 听课时不要频繁切换窗口。
examples.pinyin: tīng kè shí bú yào pín fán qiē huàn chuāng kǒu.
examples.english: Do not keep switching windows during class.

examples.hanzi: 她把键盘切换成了另一种输入法。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ jiàn pán qiē huàn chéng le lìng yì zhǒng shū rù fǎ.
examples.english: She switched the keyboard to another input method.

entries.explanation: Update a display with the latest available information.

examples.hanzi: 请刷新网页后再查看消息。
examples.pinyin: qǐng shuā xīn wǎng yè hòu zài chá kàn xiāo xi.
examples.english: Refresh the page before checking the messages again.

examples.hanzi: 名单刷新后出现了我的名字。
examples.pinyin: míng dān shuā xīn hòu chū xiàn le wǒ de míng zi.
examples.english: My name appeared after the list was refreshed.

entries.explanation: Prevent unwanted content or signals from reaching someone.

examples.hanzi: 我屏蔽了这类广告消息。
examples.pinyin: wǒ píng bì le zhè lèi guǎng gào xiāo xi.
examples.english: I blocked this type of advertising message.

examples.hanzi: 这间房的厚墙会屏蔽无线信号。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiān fáng de hòu qiáng huì píng bì wú xiàn xìn hào.
examples.english: The thick walls of this room can block wireless signals.

entries.explanation: Convert coded information into a usable form.

examples.hanzi: 播放器正在解码这段视频。
examples.pinyin: bō fàng qì zhèng zài jiě mǎ zhè duàn shì pín.
examples.english: The player is decoding this video.

chunks.gloss: player (device for playing audio or video)

examples.hanzi: 接收数据后还需要解码。
examples.pinyin: jiē shōu shù jù hòu hái xū yào jiě mǎ.
examples.english: The data must be decoded after it is received.

entries.explanation: Find a way to solve a difficult problem or code.

examples.hanzi: 他终于破解了这道谜题。
examples.pinyin: tā zhōng yú pò jiě le zhè dào mí tí.
examples.english: He finally solved this puzzle.

examples.hanzi: 团队尝试破解设备故障的原因。
examples.pinyin: tuán duì cháng shì pò jiě shè bèi gù zhàng de yuán yīn.
examples.english: The team tried to solve the mystery of the device fault.

chunks.gloss: try (to see what it's like or whether one can do it)

entries.explanation: Add something to a structured collection or group.

examples.hanzi: 这篇短文被编入新教材。
examples.pinyin: zhè piān duǎn wén bèi biān rù xīn jiào cái.
examples.english: This short article was included in the new textbook.

examples.hanzi: 学校把新生编入不同的班级。
examples.pinyin: xué xiào bǎ xīn shēng biān rù bù tóng de bān jí.
examples.english: The school placed the new students in different classes.

entries.explanation: An individual item in a list or reference work.

examples.hanzi: 这本词典增加了新的条目。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn cí diǎn zēng jiā le xīn de tiáo mù.
examples.english: This dictionary has added new entries.

examples.hanzi: 请检查名单中的重复条目。
examples.pinyin: qǐng jiǎn chá míng dān zhōng de chóng fù tiáo mù.
examples.english: Check the list for duplicate entries.

entries.explanation: Used automatically unless another choice is made.

examples.hanzi: 默认设置会关闭声音。
examples.pinyin: mò rèn shè zhì huì guān bì shēng yīn.
examples.english: The default setting turns the sound off.

examples.hanzi: 我把这个软件设为默认播放器。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ zhè ge ruǎn jiàn shè wèi mò rèn bō fàng qì.
examples.english: I made this software the default player.

entries.explanation: A secret phrase or short command used for access or coordination.

examples.hanzi: 请定期更换登录口令。
examples.pinyin: qǐng dìng qí gēng huàn dēng lù kǒu lìng.
examples.english: Change your login password regularly.

examples.hanzi: 队员听到口令后一起开始。
examples.pinyin: duì yuán tīng dào kǒu lìng hòu yì qǐ kāi shǐ.
examples.english: The team members started together after hearing the command.

entries.explanation: Try to contact or summon a person.

examples.hanzi: 护士通过广播呼叫医生。
examples.pinyin: hù shi tōng guò guǎng bō hū jiào yī shēng.
examples.english: The nurse called the doctor over the announcement system.

examples.hanzi: 按下这个按钮可以呼叫工作人员。
examples.pinyin: àn xià zhè ge àn niǔ kě yǐ hū jiào gōng zuò rén yuán.
examples.english: Pressing this button calls a staff member.

chunks.gloss: button, a control on a device

entries.explanation: Call a telephone number.

examples.hanzi: 请拨打通知上的电话号码。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bō dǎ tōng zhī shàng de diàn huà hào mǎ.
examples.english: Call the telephone number on the notice.

examples.hanzi: 我刚才拨打了学校的电话。
examples.pinyin: wǒ gāng cái bō dǎ le xué xiào de diàn huà.
examples.english: I called the school a moment ago.

entries.explanation: Enter a telephone number to start a call.

examples.hanzi: 拨号之前先检查号码。
examples.pinyin: bō hào zhī qián xiān jiǎn chá hào mǎ.
examples.english: Check the number before dialing.

examples.hanzi: 旧电话要转动圆盘拨号。
examples.pinyin: jiù diàn huà yào zhuǎn dòng yuán pán bō hào.
examples.english: An old telephone is dialed by turning its rotary dial.

entries.explanation: Successfully establish a telephone connection.

examples.hanzi: 我终于拨通了办公室的电话。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhōng yú bō tōng le bàn gōng shì de diàn huà.
examples.english: I finally got through to the office by phone.

examples.hanzi: 电话拨通了，却没有人接。
examples.pinyin: diàn huà bō tōng le, què méi yǒu rén jiē.
examples.english: The call connected, but nobody answered.

entries.explanation: Call back after receiving a call or message.

examples.hanzi: 她说下班后会回电。
examples.pinyin: tā shuō xià bān hòu huì huí diàn.
examples.english: She said she would call back after work.

examples.hanzi: 收到留言后，请尽快回电。
examples.pinyin: shōu dào liú yán hòu, qǐng jǐn kuài huí diàn.
examples.english: Call back as soon as possible after receiving the message.

parts.gloss: to go back; to return; to turn back; to turn around

entries.explanation: Contact someone by telephone, usually in a formal context.

examples.hanzi: 如有疑问，请致电办公室。
examples.pinyin: rú yǒu yí wèn, qǐng zhì diàn bàn gōng shì.
examples.english: Call the office if you have any questions.

examples.hanzi: 她致电学校询问课程安排。
examples.pinyin: tā zhì diàn xué xiào xún wèn kè chéng ān pái.
examples.english: She called the school to ask about the course schedule.

entries.explanation: Have a conversation over a telephone.

examples.hanzi: 我正在和奶奶通电话。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhèng zài hé nǎi nai tōng diàn huà.
examples.english: I am talking to my grandmother on the phone.

examples.hanzi: 他们每周通电话一次。
examples.pinyin: tā men měi zhōu tōng diàn huà yí cì.
examples.english: They talk on the phone once a week.

entries.explanation: A meeting whose participants communicate by telephone.

examples.hanzi: 我们通过电话会议讨论了安排。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men tōng guò diàn huà huì yì tǎo lùn le ān pái.
examples.english: We discussed the arrangements in a telephone conference.

examples.hanzi: 电话会议开始前要确认参会人员。
examples.pinyin: diàn huà huì yì kāi shǐ qián yào què rèn cān huì rén yuán.
examples.english: Confirm the participants before the telephone conference starts.

entries.explanation: A telephone call between places far apart.

examples.hanzi: 他给远方的家人打长途电话。
examples.pinyin: tā gěi yuǎn fāng de jiā rén dǎ cháng tú diàn huà.
examples.english: He made a long-distance call to his family far away.

examples.hanzi: 以前打长途电话需要计算时间。
examples.pinyin: yǐ qián dǎ cháng tú diàn huà xū yào jì suàn shí jiān.
examples.english: In the past, long-distance calls had to be timed carefully.

entries.explanation: Television programs delivered through a cable connection.

examples.hanzi: 家里的有线电视收不到这个频道。
examples.pinyin: jiā lǐ de yǒu xiàn diàn shì shōu bú dào zhè ge pín dào.
examples.english: Our cable television does not receive this channel.

examples.hanzi: 这栋楼统一安装了有线电视。
examples.pinyin: zhè dòng lóu tǒng yì ān zhuāng le yǒu xiàn diàn shì.
examples.english: Cable television was installed throughout this building.

entries.explanation: A device that transmits or receives radio signals.

examples.hanzi: 请把收音机的天线拉出来。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ shōu yīn jī de tiān xiàn lā chū lái.
examples.english: Extend the radio's antenna.

examples.hanzi: 这根天线需要调整方向。
examples.pinyin: zhè gēn tiān xiàn xū yào tiáo zhěng fāng xiàng.
examples.english: The direction of this antenna needs adjusting.

entries.explanation: Equipment used to play and amplify sound.

examples.hanzi: 舞台旁放着两组音响。
examples.pinyin: wǔ tái páng fàng zhe liǎng zǔ yīn xiǎng.
examples.english: There are two sound systems beside the stage.

examples.hanzi: 音响声音太大，邻居听得见。
examples.pinyin: yīn xiǎng shēng yīn tài dà, lín jū tīng de jiàn.
examples.english: The sound system is so loud that the neighbors can hear it.

entries.explanation: A unit that produces amplified sound.

examples.hanzi: 音箱摆在书架两边。
examples.pinyin: yīn xiāng bǎi zài shū jià liǎng biān.
examples.english: The speakers stand on either side of the bookshelf.

examples.hanzi: 这只音箱没有声音了。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhī yīn xiāng méi yǒu shēng yīn le.
examples.english: This speaker is no longer producing sound.

entries.explanation: A component that converts electrical signals into sound.

examples.hanzi: 手机的扬声器被水弄坏了。
examples.pinyin: shǒu jī de yáng shēng qì bèi shuǐ nòng huài le.
examples.english: Water damaged the phone's speaker.

examples.hanzi: 请不要把扬声器靠近耳朵。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bú yào bǎ yáng shēng qì kào jìn ěr duo.
examples.english: Do not hold the loudspeaker close to your ears.

entries.explanation: A telephone fixed at a home or workplace.

examples.hanzi: 办公室的座机一直在响。
examples.pinyin: bàn gōng shì de zuò jī yì zhí zài xiǎng.
examples.english: The office landline keeps ringing.

examples.hanzi: 你可以拨打家里的座机。
examples.pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ bō dǎ jiā lǐ de zuò jī.
examples.english: You can call the landline at home.

entries.explanation: A wire carrying a telephone connection.

examples.hanzi: 电话线从桌子下面穿过去。
examples.pinyin: diàn huà xiàn cóng zhuō zi xià miàn chuān guò qù.
examples.english: The telephone cable runs beneath the desk.

examples.hanzi: 检查电话线是否插好了。
examples.pinyin: jiǎn chá diàn huà xiàn shì fǒu chā hǎo le.
examples.english: Check that the telephone cable is plugged in properly.

entries.explanation: A list of people's names and contact information.

examples.hanzi: 换手机前先备份通讯录。
examples.pinyin: huàn shǒu jī qián xiān bèi fèn tōng xùn lù.
examples.english: Back up the contact directory before changing phones.

examples.hanzi: 我在通讯录里找到了老师的号码。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài tōng xùn lù lǐ zhǎo dào le lǎo shī de hào mǎ.
examples.english: I found the teacher's number in my contact directory.

entries.explanation: A book or list used to store telephone numbers.

examples.hanzi: 奶奶还保留着一本旧电话本。
examples.pinyin: nǎi nai hái bǎo liú zhe yì běn jiù diàn huà běn.
examples.english: Grandmother still keeps an old telephone address book.

examples.hanzi: 我把新号码写进电话本。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ xīn hào mǎ xiě jìn diàn huà běn.
examples.english: I wrote the new number in the telephone book.

entries.explanation: A written message sent to another person.

examples.hanzi: 请不要打开别人的信件。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bú yào dǎ kāi bié ren de xìn jiàn.
examples.english: Do not open other people's letters.

examples.hanzi: 这些信件记录了她的留学生活。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiē xìn jiàn jì lù le tā de liú xué shēng huó.
examples.english: These letters record her life studying abroad.

entries.explanation: Send written communication to another person.

examples.hanzi: 发信前请核对收件地址。
examples.pinyin: fā xìn qián qǐng hé duì shōu jiàn dì zhǐ.
examples.english: Check the recipient's address before sending the letter.

examples.hanzi: 她每月给家里发信。
examples.pinyin: tā měi yuè gěi jiā lǐ fā xìn.
examples.english: She sends letters home every month.

entries.explanation: A paper cover used to hold a letter.

examples.hanzi: 请把邮票贴在信封右上角。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ yóu piào tiē zài xìn fēng yòu shàng jiǎo.
examples.english: Put the stamp on the upper right corner of the envelope.

examples.hanzi: 这个信封里有两张照片。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge xìn fēng lǐ yǒu liǎng zhāng zhào piàn.
examples.english: There are two photos in this envelope.

entries.explanation: Technology that turns spoken words into usable information.

examples.hanzi: 语音识别把我的话转成了文字。
examples.pinyin: yǔ yīn shí bié bǎ wǒ de huà zhuǎn chéng le wén zì.
examples.english: Speech recognition turned my spoken words into text.

examples.hanzi: 这里太吵，语音识别容易出错。
examples.pinyin: zhè lǐ tài chǎo, yǔ yīn shí bié róng yì chū cuò.
examples.english: It is noisy here, so speech recognition may make mistakes.

entries.explanation: A meeting using live video between different locations.

examples.hanzi: 明天的视频会议需要提前测试声音。
examples.pinyin: míng tiān de shì pín huì yì xū yào tí qián cè shì shēng yīn.
examples.english: Test the sound before tomorrow's video conference.

examples.hanzi: 她在家参加了公司的视频会议。
examples.pinyin: tā zài jiā cān jiā le gōng sī de shì pín huì yì.
examples.english: She joined the company's video conference from home.

entries.explanation: Make a service available or connect to it.

examples.hanzi: 新的课程下周上线。
examples.pinyin: xīn de kè chéng xià zhōu shàng xiàn.
examples.english: The new course will become available online next week.

examples.hanzi: 这个功能上线后，用户可以直接报名。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge gōng néng shàng xiàn hòu, yòng hù kě yǐ zhí jiē bào míng.
examples.english: Users can sign up directly after this function goes live.

entries.explanation: Taking place through an internet service.

examples.hanzi: 这次讲座改成了线上活动。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì jiǎng zuò gǎi chéng le xiàn shàng huó dòng.
examples.english: This talk has become an online event.

examples.hanzi: 线上报名和现场报名都可以。
examples.pinyin: xiàn shàng bào míng hé xiàn chǎng bào míng dōu kě yǐ.
examples.english: You can register either online or in person.

chunks.gloss: the scene (of a crime, accident etc)

entries.explanation: A person known or encountered through the internet.

examples.hanzi: 她和网友一起讨论读书心得。
examples.pinyin: tā hé wǎng yǒu yì qǐ tǎo lùn dú shū xīn dé.
examples.english: She discussed her reading reflections with online friends.

chunks.gloss: what one has learned (through experience, reading etc)

examples.hanzi: 不要轻易向网友透露家庭地址。
examples.pinyin: bú yào qīng yì xiàng wǎng yǒu tòu lù jiā tíng dì zhǐ.
examples.english: Do not readily reveal your home address to people online.

entries.explanation: A recorded visual representation of people or events.

examples.hanzi: 这些影像保存了城市过去的样子。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiē yǐng xiàng bǎo cún le chéng shì guò qù de yàng zi.
examples.english: These images preserve what the city looked like in the past.

examples.hanzi: 展览同时展示照片和影像。
examples.pinyin: zhǎn lǎn tóng shí zhǎn shì zhào piàn hé yǐng xiàng.
examples.english: The exhibition displays both photographs and recorded visuals.

entries.explanation: A quick photograph or a saved momentary view.

examples.hanzi: 相册里有很多旅行快照。
examples.pinyin: xiàng cè lǐ yǒu hěn duō lǚ xíng kuài zhào.
examples.english: The album contains many travel snapshots.

examples.hanzi: 这张快照拍到了大家自然的笑容。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng kuài zhào pāi dào liǎo dà jiā zì rán de xiào róng.
examples.english: This snapshot captured everyone's natural smiles.

entries.explanation: A picture produced by a camera.

examples.hanzi: 这张相片拍摄于十年前。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng xiàng piàn pāi shè yú shí nián qián.
examples.english: This photograph was taken ten years ago.

examples.hanzi: 她把相片夹在日记本里。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ xiàng piàn jiā zài rì jì běn lǐ.
examples.english: She put the photograph inside her diary.

examples.hanzi: 老师安排周五给大家补课。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī ān pái zhōu wǔ gěi dà jiā bǔ kè.
examples.english: The teacher arranged a make-up lesson for everyone on Friday.

entries.explanation: Study a subject with additional guidance or lessons.

examples.hanzi: 他利用假期补习数学。
examples.pinyin: tā lì yòng jià qī bǔ xí shù xué.
examples.english: He took extra mathematics tuition during the holidays.

examples.hanzi: 补习以后，她理解了以前的难点。
examples.pinyin: bǔ xí yǐ hòu, tā lǐ jiě le yǐ qián de nán diǎn.
examples.english: After extra tuition, she understood the points she had found difficult.

entries.explanation: A class providing additional subject teaching.

examples.hanzi: 她周末去参加英语补习班。
examples.pinyin: tā zhōu mò qù cān jiā yīng yǔ bǔ xí bān.
examples.english: She attends an English tuition class on weekends.

examples.hanzi: 这个补习班每班只有六个人。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge bǔ xí bān měi bān zhǐ yǒu liù gè rén.
examples.english: This tuition class has only six people in each group.

entries.explanation: A course designed to teach a practical skill.

examples.hanzi: 公司安排了一个安全培训班。
examples.pinyin: gōng sī ān pái le yí ge ān quán péi xùn bān.
examples.english: The company arranged a safety training course.

examples.hanzi: 她在摄影培训班认识了新朋友。
examples.pinyin: tā zài shè yǐng péi xùn bān rèn shi le xīn péng you.
examples.english: She met new friends in a photography training class.

entries.explanation: One part of an academic year.

examples.hanzi: 这个学期我们换了新教室。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge xué qī wǒ men huàn le xīn jiào shì.
examples.english: We moved to a new classroom this term.

examples.hanzi: 学期结束前要归还借来的书。
examples.pinyin: xué qī jié shù qián yào guī huán jiè lái de shū.
examples.english: Return the borrowed books before the term ends.

entries.explanation: The final part of an academic term.

examples.hanzi: 期末考试安排在六月。
examples.pinyin: qī mò kǎo shì ān pái zài liù yuè.
examples.english: The final examinations are scheduled for June.

examples.hanzi: 期末时，老师给大家写了评语。
examples.pinyin: qī mò shí, lǎo shī gěi dà jiā xiě le píng yǔ.
examples.english: The teacher wrote comments for everyone at the end of the term.

entries.explanation: Begin attendance at an educational institution.

examples.hanzi: 妹妹今年秋天入学。
examples.pinyin: mèi mei jīn nián qiū tiān rù xué.
examples.english: My younger sister starts school this autumn.

examples.hanzi: 入学前需要准备哪些材料？
examples.pinyin: rù xué qián xū yào zhǔn bèi nǎ xiē cái liào?
examples.english: What documents are needed before entering school?

entries.explanation: Go back to school after an absence.

examples.hanzi: 假期结束后，学生陆续返校。
examples.pinyin: jià qī jié shù hòu, xué sheng lù xù fǎn xiào.
examples.english: The students returned to school after the holidays.

examples.hanzi: 她康复后已经返校上课。
examples.pinyin: tā kāng fù hòu yǐ jīng fǎn xiào shàng kè.
examples.english: She has returned to classes after recovering.

entries.explanation: A higher-education institution or a division within one.

examples.hanzi: 他在音乐学院学习。
examples.pinyin: tā zài yīn yuè xué yuàn xué xí.
examples.english: He studies at a music college.

examples.hanzi: 这个学院开设了新的课程。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge xué yuàn kāi shè le xīn de kè chéng.
examples.english: This faculty has introduced new courses.

entries.explanation: A college or university offering advanced education.

examples.hanzi: 几所高校联合举办了讲座。
examples.pinyin: jǐ suǒ gāo xiào lián hé jǔ bàn le jiǎng zuò.
examples.english: Several higher-education institutions organized the talk together.

examples.hanzi: 这个展览向附近高校的学生开放。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge zhǎn lǎn xiàng fù jìn gāo xiào de xué sheng kāi fàng.
examples.english: This exhibition is open to students from nearby colleges and universities.

entries.explanation: A school providing education after primary school.

examples.hanzi: 这所中学离我家很近。
examples.pinyin: zhè suǒ zhōng xué lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn.
examples.english: This secondary school is near my home.

examples.hanzi: 哥哥在中学参加了篮球队。
examples.pinyin: gē ge zài zhōng xué cān jiā le lán qiú duì.
examples.english: My older brother joined a basketball team at secondary school.

entries.explanation: The earlier stage of secondary education.

examples.hanzi: 她今年开始读初中。
examples.pinyin: tā jīn nián kāi shǐ dú chū zhōng.
examples.english: She starts junior secondary school this year.

examples.hanzi: 这本词典适合初中学生。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn cí diǎn shì hé chū zhōng xué sheng.
examples.english: This dictionary suits junior secondary students.

entries.explanation: The later stage of secondary education.

examples.hanzi: 哥哥在高中学习物理。
examples.pinyin: gē ge zài gāo zhōng xué xí wù lǐ.
examples.english: My older brother studies physics at senior secondary school.

examples.hanzi: 这所高中有很大的图书馆。
examples.pinyin: zhè suǒ gāo zhōng yǒu hěn dà de tú shū guǎn.
examples.english: This senior secondary school has a large library.

entries.explanation: A student attending a university.

examples.hanzi: 几位大学生来学校做志愿服务。
examples.pinyin: jǐ wèi dà xué shēng lái xué xiào zuò zhì yuàn fú wù.
examples.english: Several university students came to the school to volunteer.

chunks.gloss: (of a person) to be (an intermediary, a good student etc)

examples.hanzi: 她是一名学习医学的大学生。
examples.pinyin: tā shì yì míng xué xí yī xué de dà xué shēng.
examples.english: She is a university student studying medicine.

entries.explanation: A child attending primary school.

examples.hanzi: 小学生过马路时要注意安全。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo xué shēng guò mǎ lù shí yào zhù yì ān quán.
examples.english: Primary-school students should be careful when crossing the road.

examples.hanzi: 这本书为小学生设计。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū wèi xiǎo xué shēng shè jì.
examples.english: This book is designed for primary-school students.

entries.explanation: A student attending secondary school.

examples.hanzi: 这次活动由中学生组织。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì huó dòng yóu zhōng xué shēng zǔ zhī.
examples.english: This activity was organized by secondary-school students.

examples.hanzi: 中学生可以借阅这一类读物。
examples.pinyin: zhōng xué shēng kě yǐ jiè yuè zhè yí lèi dú wù.
examples.english: Secondary-school students may borrow this type of reading material.

entries.explanation: A student in the later stage of secondary school.

examples.hanzi: 几个高中生正在准备演讲。
examples.pinyin: jǐ ge gāo zhōng shēng zhèng zài zhǔn bèi yǎn jiǎng.
examples.english: Several senior secondary students are preparing a speech.

examples.hanzi: 这份阅读材料适合高中生。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn yuè dú cái liào shì hé gāo zhōng shēng.
examples.english: This reading material suits senior secondary students.

entries.explanation: A student newly admitted to an institution.

examples.hanzi: 老师带新生参观教室。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī dài xīn shēng cān guān jiào shì.
examples.english: The teacher showed the new students around the classroom.

chunks.gloss: to visit (a place, e.g. museum or factory); to tour; to look around

examples.hanzi: 新生入学后要领取课表。
examples.pinyin: xīn shēng rù xué hòu yào lǐng qǔ kè biǎo.
examples.english: New students collect a timetable after enrollment.

entries.explanation: A person enrolled in a training course.

examples.hanzi: 这次培训有二十名学员。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì péi xùn yǒu èr shí míng xué yuán.
examples.english: There are twenty participants in this training course.

examples.hanzi: 教员给学员示范了操作方法。
examples.pinyin: jiào yuán gěi xué yuán shì fàn le cāo zuò fāng fǎ.
examples.english: The instructor demonstrated the procedure to the trainees.

entries.explanation: A person taking an examination.

examples.hanzi: 考生应提前找到自己的座位。
examples.pinyin: kǎo shēng yīng tí qián zhǎo dào zì jǐ de zuò wèi.
examples.english: Candidates should find their seats beforehand.

examples.hanzi: 每位考生都领到了一份试卷。
examples.pinyin: měi wèi kǎo shēng dōu lǐng dào le yì fèn shì juàn.
examples.english: Each candidate received an exam paper.

entries.explanation: A person who evaluates an examination candidate.

examples.hanzi: 考官请她读一段文章。
examples.pinyin: kǎo guān qǐng tā dú yì duàn wén zhāng.
examples.english: The examiner asked her to read a passage.

examples.hanzi: 两位考官分别记录了成绩。
examples.pinyin: liǎng wèi kǎo guān fēn bié jì lù le chéng jì.
examples.english: The two examiners recorded the results separately.

entries.explanation: A document listing a student's results.

examples.hanzi: 她把成绩单带回家给父母看。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ chéng jì dān dài huí jiā gěi fù mǔ kàn.
examples.english: She brought her grade report home to show her parents.

examples.hanzi: 申请学校时需要提交成绩单。
examples.pinyin: shēn qǐng xué xiào shí xū yào tí jiāo chéng jì dān.
examples.english: An academic transcript is required when applying to a school.

entries.explanation: Give a numerical evaluation according to criteria.

examples.hanzi: 老师按照统一标准评分。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī àn zhào tǒng yì biāo zhǔn píng fēn.
examples.english: The teacher marked the work using one standard.

examples.hanzi: 评分结束后会公布结果。
examples.pinyin: píng fēn jié shù hòu huì gōng bù jié guǒ.
examples.english: The results will be announced after scoring ends.

entries.explanation: A distinct subject studied or examined.

examples.hanzi: 这个学期增加了新的科目。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge xué qī zēng jiā le xīn de kē mù.
examples.english: A new subject was added this term.

examples.hanzi: 请注明你要报考的科目。
examples.pinyin: qǐng zhù míng nǐ yào bào kǎo de kē mù.
examples.english: State the subject you want to be examined in.

entries.explanation: The study of places, environments and their relationships.

examples.hanzi: 地理课上我们学习看地图。
examples.pinyin: dì lǐ kè shang wǒ men xué xí kàn dì tú.
examples.english: We learn to read maps in geography class.

examples.hanzi: 她对家乡的地理很熟悉。
examples.pinyin: tā duì jiā xiāng de dì lǐ hěn shú xī.
examples.english: She is familiar with the geography of her hometown.

entries.explanation: Comprehend the meaning of written material.

examples.hanzi: 我终于读懂了这封信。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhōng yú dú dǒng le zhè fēng xìn.
examples.english: I finally understood this letter.

examples.hanzi: 这段说明太复杂，不容易读懂。
examples.pinyin: zhè duàn shuō míng tài fù zá, bù róng yì dú dǒng.
examples.english: These instructions are complicated and difficult to understand.

entries.explanation: Comprehend spoken language or explanation.

examples.hanzi: 他说得很慢，我都听懂了。
examples.pinyin: tā shuō de hěn màn, wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le.
examples.english: He spoke slowly, and I understood everything.

examples.hanzi: 如果没听懂，可以请老师再说一次。
examples.pinyin: rú guǒ méi tīng dǒng, kě yǐ qǐng lǎo shī zài shuō yí cì.
examples.english: If you do not understand, ask the teacher to repeat it.

entries.explanation: A person employed by an organization, especially in office work.

examples.hanzi: 这家公司有三十名职员。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī yǒu sān shí míng zhí yuán.
examples.english: This company has thirty employees.

examples.hanzi: 前台职员帮我联系了负责人。
examples.pinyin: qián tái zhí yuán bāng wǒ lián xì le fù zé rén.
examples.english: The front-desk staff member helped me contact the person in charge.

entries.explanation: Workers and employees of an organization collectively.

examples.hanzi: 工厂为职工安排了体检。
examples.pinyin: gōng chǎng wèi zhí gōng ān pái le tǐ jiǎn.
examples.english: The factory arranged health checks for its employees.

examples.hanzi: 职工可以在食堂吃午饭。
examples.pinyin: zhí gōng kě yǐ zài shí táng chī wǔ fàn.
examples.english: Employees can have lunch in the canteen.

entries.explanation: A learner gaining practical experience in a workplace.

examples.hanzi: 实习生正在学习整理档案。
examples.pinyin: shí xí shēng zhèng zài xué xí zhěng lǐ dàng àn.
examples.english: The intern is learning to organize records.

examples.hanzi: 部门给每位实习生安排了指导老师。
examples.pinyin: bù mén gěi měi wèi shí xí shēng ān pái le zhǐ dǎo lǎo shī.
examples.english: The department assigned a mentor to each intern.

entries.explanation: A worker employed for a limited period.

examples.hanzi: 店里请了两名临时工帮忙。
examples.pinyin: diàn lǐ qǐng le liǎng míng lín shí gōng bāng máng.
examples.english: The shop hired two temporary workers to help.

examples.hanzi: 她暑假做过临时工。
examples.pinyin: tā shǔ jià zuò guò lín shí gōng.
examples.english: She worked as a temporary worker during the summer holidays.

entries.explanation: The person managing an organization's overall operations.

examples.hanzi: 总经理在会议上介绍了新计划。
examples.pinyin: zǒng jīng lǐ zài huì yì shàng jiè shào le xīn jì huà.
examples.english: The general manager introduced the new plan at the meeting.

examples.hanzi: 她今天需要向总经理汇报进度。
examples.pinyin: tā jīn tiān xū yào xiàng zǒng jīng lǐ huì bào jìn dù.
examples.english: She needs to report progress to the general manager today.

chunks.gloss: report to a person or group

entries.explanation: A manager who supports or substitutes for the main manager.

examples.hanzi: 经理不在时由副经理负责。
examples.pinyin: jīng lǐ bú zài shí yóu fù jīng lǐ fù zé.
examples.english: The deputy manager is in charge when the manager is absent.

chunks.gloss: to be responsible for; to be in charge of; to bear responsibility for

examples.hanzi: 副经理协调了各组的工作。
examples.pinyin: fù jīng lǐ xié tiáo le gè zǔ de gōng zuò.
examples.english: The deputy manager coordinated the groups' work.

entries.explanation: A person who helps another person with work duties.

examples.hanzi: 助理把会议资料送到了办公室。
examples.pinyin: zhù lǐ bǎ huì yì zī liào sòng dào le bàn gōng shì.
examples.english: The assistant delivered the meeting materials to the office.

examples.hanzi: 她担任摄影师的助理。
examples.pinyin: tā dān rèn shè yǐng shī de zhù lǐ.
examples.english: She works as a photographer's assistant.

entries.explanation: A person who provides specialist advice.

examples.hanzi: 公司请顾问检查了培训方案。
examples.pinyin: gōng sī qǐng gù wèn jiǎn chá le péi xùn fāng àn.
examples.english: The company asked a consultant to review the training plan.

examples.hanzi: 这位顾问熟悉学校管理。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi gù wèn shú xī xué xiào guǎn lǐ.
examples.english: This adviser is familiar with school management.

entries.explanation: A professional who prepares and reviews financial records.

examples.hanzi: 会计师正在核对账目。
examples.pinyin: kuài jì shī zhèng zài hé duì zhàng mù.
examples.english: The accountant is checking the accounts.

examples.hanzi: 她找会计师咨询公司的财务问题。
examples.pinyin: tā zhǎo kuài jì shī zī xún gōng sī de cái wù wèn tí.
examples.english: She consulted an accountant about the company's finances.

entries.explanation: The person who creates the plan or form of something.

examples.hanzi: 这张椅子的设计者考虑了儿童身高。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng yǐ zi de shè jì zhě kǎo lǜ le ér tóng shēn gāo.
examples.english: The designer of this chair considered children's height.

examples.hanzi: 展览介绍了每件作品的设计者。
examples.pinyin: zhǎn lǎn jiè shào le měi jiàn zuò pǐn de shè jì zhě.
examples.english: The exhibition introduces the designer of each work.

entries.explanation: A person who works alongside another worker.

examples.hanzi: 工友帮他搬走了重箱子。
examples.pinyin: gōng yǒu bāng tā bān zǒu le zhòng xiāng zi.
examples.english: His fellow worker helped move the heavy box.

examples.hanzi: 休息时，工友们一起聊天。
examples.pinyin: xiū xi shí, gōng yǒu men yì qǐ liáo tiān.
examples.english: The workers chat together during breaks.

entries.explanation: A matter arising from one's job or public duties.

examples.hanzi: 这次出差是为了处理公事。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì chū chāi shì wèi le chǔ lǐ gōng shì.
examples.english: This business trip is for work-related matters.

examples.hanzi: 她习惯把公事和私事分开。
examples.pinyin: tā xí guàn bǎ gōng shì hé sī shì fēn kāi.
examples.english: She prefers to keep work matters separate from personal matters.

entries.explanation: A space used for creative or professional work.

examples.hanzi: 她的工作室里放满了画。
examples.pinyin: tā de gōng zuò shì lǐ fàng mǎn le huà.
examples.english: Her studio is full of paintings.

examples.hanzi: 工作室每周开放一次。
examples.pinyin: gōng zuò shì měi zhōu kāi fàng yí cì.
examples.english: The studio opens to visitors once a week.

entries.explanation: A computer or equipped station used for professional tasks.

examples.hanzi: 这台工作站用来处理大型图像。
examples.pinyin: zhè tái gōng zuò zhàn yòng lái chǔ lǐ dà xíng tú xiàng.
examples.english: This workstation processes large images.

examples.hanzi: 每个工作站旁都放着操作说明。
examples.pinyin: měi ge gōng zuò zhàn páng dōu fàng zhe cāo zuò shuō míng.
examples.english: Operating instructions are beside each workstation.

entries.explanation: A group formed to carry out a particular task.

examples.hanzi: 学校成立了一个活动工作组。
examples.pinyin: xué xiào chéng lì le yí ge huó dòng gōng zuò zǔ.
examples.english: The school formed a working group for the event.

examples.hanzi: 工作组每周检查一次进度。
examples.pinyin: gōng zuò zǔ měi zhōu jiǎn chá yí cì jìn dù.
examples.english: The working group checks progress each week.

entries.explanation: The amount of work that needs to be done.

examples.hanzi: 这周的工作量比上周大。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhōu de gōng zuò liàng bǐ shàng zhōu dà.
examples.english: The workload is heavier this week than last week.

examples.hanzi: 新工具减少了重复的工作量。
examples.pinyin: xīn gōng jù jiǎn shǎo le chóng fù de gōng zuò liàng.
examples.english: The new tool reduced repetitive work.

entries.explanation: The ordered steps followed when performing a job.

examples.hanzi: 新员工先学习工作流程。
examples.pinyin: xīn yuán gōng xiān xué xí gōng zuò liú chéng.
examples.english: New employees learn the workflow first.

examples.hanzi: 我们简化了文件审批的工作流程。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men jiǎn huà le wén jiàn shěn pī de gōng zuò liú chéng.
examples.english: We simplified the workflow for document approval.

entries.explanation: A desk used for office work.

examples.hanzi: 我的办公桌靠近窗户。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de bàn gōng zhuō kào jìn chuāng hu.
examples.english: My office desk is near the window.

examples.hanzi: 下班前请整理办公桌。
examples.pinyin: xià bān qián qǐng zhěng lǐ bàn gōng zhuō.
examples.english: Tidy your office desk before leaving work.

entries.explanation: A building containing workplaces and offices.

examples.hanzi: 这栋办公楼有六层。
examples.pinyin: zhè dòng bàn gōng lóu yǒu liù céng.
examples.english: This office building has six floors.

examples.hanzi: 她在办公楼门口等同事。
examples.pinyin: tā zài bàn gōng lóu mén kǒu děng tóng shì.
examples.english: She is waiting for her colleague outside the office building.

entries.explanation: The department handling employee-related affairs.

examples.hanzi: 请把请假申请交给人事部。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ qǐng jià shēn qǐng jiāo gěi rén shì bù.
examples.english: Submit the leave request to the personnel department.

examples.hanzi: 人事部通知我下周面试。
examples.pinyin: rén shì bù tōng zhī wǒ xià zhōu miàn shì.
examples.english: The personnel department informed me of an interview next week.

entries.explanation: The workforce and its management within an organization.

examples.hanzi: 她在人力资源部门工作。
examples.pinyin: tā zài rén lì zī yuán bù mén gōng zuò.
examples.english: She works in the human resources department.

examples.hanzi: 合理安排人力资源能减少加班。
examples.pinyin: hé lǐ ān pái rén lì zī yuán néng jiǎn shǎo jiā bān.
examples.english: Planning human resources properly can reduce overtime.

entries.explanation: A person looking or applying for employment.

examples.hanzi: 求职者在门口等候面试。
examples.pinyin: qiú zhí zhě zài mén kǒu děng hòu miàn shì.
examples.english: The job applicants waited outside for interviews.

examples.hanzi: 这次活动向求职者介绍了招聘信息。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì huó dòng xiàng qiú zhí zhě jiè shào le zhāo pìn xìn xī.
examples.english: This event introduced recruitment information to job seekers.

entries.explanation: Begin serving in a job or official role.

examples.hanzi: 她明天到新公司就职。
examples.pinyin: tā míng tiān dào xīn gōng sī jiù zhí.
examples.english: She starts her position at the new company tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 他就职后先熟悉了团队。
examples.pinyin: tā jiù zhí hòu xiān shú xī le tuán duì.
examples.english: He got to know the team after taking up the position.

entries.explanation: Find or hold paid work.

examples.hanzi: 培训帮助学员提高就业能力。
examples.pinyin: péi xùn bāng zhù xué yuán tí gāo jiù yè néng lì.
examples.english: The training helps participants improve their employability.

examples.hanzi: 毕业后，她选择在家乡就业。
examples.pinyin: bì yè hòu, tā xuǎn zé zài jiā xiāng jiù yè.
examples.english: After graduation, she chose to work in her hometown.

entries.explanation: Accept a person for a job or position.

examples.hanzi: 通过面试后，她被公司录用了。
examples.pinyin: tōng guò miàn shì hòu, tā bèi gōng sī lù yòng le.
examples.english: The company hired her after the interview.

examples.hanzi: 录用通知将在下周发出。
examples.pinyin: lù yòng tōng zhī jiāng zài xià zhōu fā chū.
examples.english: The appointment notice will be sent next week.

entries.explanation: A skill or field in which someone is particularly capable.

examples.hanzi: 他的专长是修理旧家具。
examples.pinyin: tā de zhuān cháng shì xiū lǐ jiù jiā jù.
examples.english: His specialty is repairing old furniture.

examples.hanzi: 老师鼓励每个人发挥自己的专长。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī gǔ lì měi ge rén fā huī zì jǐ de zhuān cháng.
examples.english: The teacher encourages everyone to use their particular skills.

entries.explanation: Carry out assigned responsibilities properly.

examples.hanzi: 这位管理员很尽职。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi guǎn lǐ yuán hěn jìn zhí.
examples.english: This administrator performs her duties conscientiously.

examples.hanzi: 他尽职地检查了每一个出口。
examples.pinyin: tā jìn zhí de jiǎn chá le měi yí ge chū kǒu.
examples.english: He checked every exit conscientiously.

entries.explanation: Taking one's work seriously and responsibly.

examples.hanzi: 她虽然经验少，但十分敬业。
examples.pinyin: tā suī rán jīng yàn shǎo, dàn shí fēn jìng yè.
examples.english: She lacks experience but is very dedicated to her work.

examples.hanzi: 敬业不等于永远不休息。
examples.pinyin: jìng yè bù děng yú yǒng yuǎn bù xiū xi.
examples.english: Dedication to work does not mean never resting.

entries.explanation: Fail to perform responsibilities properly.

examples.hanzi: 漏掉重要检查被认为是失职。
examples.pinyin: lòu diào zhòng yào jiǎn chá bèi rèn wéi shì shī zhí.
examples.english: Missing an important check was considered neglect of duty.

examples.hanzi: 发现失职问题后，团队改进了流程。
examples.pinyin: fā xiàn shī zhí wèn tí hòu, tuán duì gǎi jìn le liú chéng.
examples.english: The team improved the process after finding a failure of duty.

entries.explanation: Begin a construction or production task.

examples.hanzi: 材料到齐以后就可以开工。
examples.pinyin: cái liào dào qí yǐ hòu jiù kě yǐ kāi gōng.
examples.english: Work can begin once all the materials arrive.

examples.hanzi: 工人们早上七点开工。
examples.pinyin: gōng rén men zǎo shang qī diǎn kāi gōng.
examples.english: The workers start work at seven in the morning.

entries.english: finish a construction or production task
entries.explanation: Complete the work on a project or product.

examples.hanzi: 这座小桥下周就能完工。
examples.pinyin: zhè zuò xiǎo qiáo xià zhōu jiù néng wán gōng.
examples.english: This small bridge can be finished next week.

chunks.gloss: finish a construction or production task

examples.hanzi: 房间完工后还要检查一次。
examples.pinyin: fáng jiān wán gōng hòu hái yào jiǎn chá yí cì.
examples.english: The room needs another inspection after the work is finished.

chunks.gloss: finish a construction or production task

parts.gloss: finish a construction or production task

entries.explanation: The planned time allowed for completing work.

examples.hanzi: 下雨使工期延长了几天。
examples.pinyin: xià yǔ shǐ gōng qī yán cháng le jǐ tiān.
examples.english: Rain extended the construction period by several days.

examples.hanzi: 这项维修的工期是一周。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng wéi xiū de gōng qī shì yì zhōu.
examples.english: The repair is scheduled to take one week.

entries.explanation: Start building or carrying out construction work.

examples.hanzi: 新教室下个月动工。
examples.pinyin: xīn jiào shì xià gè yuè dòng gōng.
examples.english: Construction of the new classroom begins next month.

examples.hanzi: 动工前，工作人员检查了地面。
examples.pinyin: dòng gōng qián, gōng zuò rén yuán jiǎn chá le dì miàn.
examples.english: Staff inspected the ground before construction began.

entries.explanation: A place where building work is taking place.

examples.hanzi: 工地旁边设了安全围栏。
examples.pinyin: gōng dì páng biān shè le ān quán wéi lán.
examples.english: A safety fence was set up beside the construction site.

examples.hanzi: 经过工地时要注意路面。
examples.pinyin: jīng guò gōng dì shí yào zhù yì lù miàn.
examples.english: Watch the ground when passing the construction site.

entries.explanation: Be responsible for work during an assigned period.

examples.hanzi: 今晚由我值班。
examples.pinyin: jīn wǎn yóu wǒ zhí bān.
examples.english: I am on duty tonight.

examples.hanzi: 值班人员会记录来访信息。
examples.pinyin: zhí bān rén yuán huì jì lù lái fǎng xìn xī.
examples.english: The staff on duty record visitor information.

entries.explanation: Work the currently assigned shift.

examples.hanzi: 请找当班的负责人。
examples.pinyin: qǐng zhǎo dāng bān de fù zé rén.
examples.english: Please find the supervisor on the current shift.

examples.hanzi: 她当班时遇到了一次停电。
examples.pinyin: tā dāng bān shí yù dào le yí cì tíng diàn.
examples.english: She experienced a power outage while on shift.

entries.explanation: Replace one shift of workers with another.

examples.hanzi: 两组工作人员在中午换班。
examples.pinyin: liǎng zǔ gōng zuò rén yuán zài zhōng wǔ huàn bān.
examples.english: The two staff groups change shifts at noon.

examples.hanzi: 换班前要交代未完成的工作。
examples.pinyin: huàn bān qián yào jiāo dài wèi wán chéng de gōng zuò.
examples.english: Explain unfinished tasks before changing shifts.

entries.explanation: A work period scheduled late in the day.

examples.hanzi: 她这周上晚班。
examples.pinyin: tā zhè zhōu shàng wǎn bān.
examples.english: She works the evening shift this week.

examples.hanzi: 晚班结束后，食堂已经关门了。
examples.pinyin: wǎn bān jié shù hòu, shí táng yǐ jīng guān mén le.
examples.english: The canteen had closed by the time the evening shift ended.

chunks.gloss: close a door; close for business

entries.explanation: A work period starting early in the day.

examples.hanzi: 我明天上早班，要早点睡。
examples.pinyin: wǒ míng tiān shàng zǎo bān, yào zǎo diǎn shuì.
examples.english: I have the morning shift tomorrow and need to sleep early.

examples.hanzi: 早班的同事已经准备好材料。
examples.pinyin: zǎo bān de tóng shì yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo cái liào.
examples.english: The morning-shift colleagues have prepared the materials.

entries.explanation: An assigned shift or scheduled round of operation.

examples.hanzi: 下周的班次安排已经贴出来。
examples.pinyin: xià zhōu de bān cì ān pái yǐ jīng tiē chū lái.
examples.english: Next week's shift schedule has been posted.

examples.hanzi: 她想和同事交换一个班次。
examples.pinyin: tā xiǎng hé tóng shì jiāo huàn yí ge bān cì.
examples.english: She wants to exchange a shift with a colleague.

entries.explanation: Be present when scheduled to work or study.

examples.hanzi: 老师记录了本周的出勤情况。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī jì lù le běn zhōu de chū qín qíng kuàng.
examples.english: The teacher recorded attendance for this week.

examples.hanzi: 暴雨影响了员工出勤。
examples.pinyin: bào yǔ yǐng xiǎng le yuán gōng chū qín.
examples.english: Heavy rain affected employee attendance.

entries.explanation: End a job or remove someone from a position.

examples.hanzi: 她辞掉工作去继续学习。
examples.pinyin: tā cí diào gōng zuò qù jì xù xué xí.
examples.english: She quit her job to continue studying.

examples.hanzi: 他没有因为一时生气就辞掉工作。
examples.pinyin: tā méi yǒu yīn wèi yì shí shēng qì jiù cí diào gōng zuò.
examples.english: He did not quit his job just because he was momentarily angry.

entries.explanation: Move from one employer to another.

examples.hanzi: 他跳槽到一家规模更小的公司。
examples.pinyin: tā tiào cáo dào yì jiā guī mó gèng xiǎo de gōng sī.
examples.english: He moved to a smaller company.

examples.hanzi: 跳槽之前，她仔细比较了工作内容。
examples.pinyin: tiào cáo zhī qián, tā zǐ xì bǐ jiào le gōng zuò nèi róng.
examples.english: She carefully compared job duties before changing employers.

entries.explanation: Give tasks or resources to different people.

examples.hanzi: 经理把任务分派给各组。
examples.pinyin: jīng lǐ bǎ rèn wù fēn pài gěi gè zǔ.
examples.english: The manager assigned the tasks to the different groups.

examples.hanzi: 工作应按照能力合理分派。
examples.pinyin: gōng zuò yīng àn zhào néng lì hé lǐ fēn pài.
examples.english: Work should be allocated according to people's abilities.

entries.explanation: Separate people or items into several groups.

examples.hanzi: 老师按兴趣给学生分组。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī àn xìng qù gěi xué sheng fēn zǔ.
examples.english: The teacher grouped students by their interests.

examples.hanzi: 活动开始前，大家先分组。
examples.pinyin: huó dòng kāi shǐ qián, dà jiā xiān fēn zǔ.
examples.english: Everyone divided into groups before the activity began.

entries.explanation: Give one or more items to each recipient.

examples.hanzi: 同学们帮忙分发资料。
examples.pinyin: tóng xué men bāng máng fēn fā zī liào.
examples.english: The classmates helped hand out the materials.

chunks.gloss: to help; to lend a hand

examples.hanzi: 请把这些练习本分发给大家。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhè xiē liàn xí běn fēn fā gěi dà jiā.
examples.english: Hand these exercise books out to everyone.

entries.explanation: Work together in a coordinated way.

examples.hanzi: 两个部门协同处理了这件事。
examples.pinyin: liǎng gè bù mén xié tóng chǔ lǐ le zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: The two departments handled the matter together.

examples.hanzi: 设备需要协同运行才能完成任务。
examples.pinyin: shè bèi xū yào xié tóng yùn xíng cái néng wán chéng rèn wù.
examples.english: The devices must operate together to finish the task.

chunks.gloss: (of a train service etc) to operate

entries.explanation: Discuss a matter to reach an agreed arrangement.

examples.hanzi: 时间冲突时，可以先协商。
examples.pinyin: shí jiān chōng tū shí, kě yǐ xiān xié shāng.
examples.english: When schedules conflict, discuss an arrangement first.

examples.hanzi: 双方协商后决定延期。
examples.pinyin: shuāng fāng xié shāng hòu jué dìng yán qī.
examples.english: The two sides agreed to postpone after discussions.

entries.explanation: Consider a matter together to make a decision.

examples.hanzi: 老师们正在商讨活动安排。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī men zhèng zài shāng tǎo huó dòng ān pái.
examples.english: The teachers are discussing the activity arrangements.

examples.hanzi: 这个问题需要和家人商讨。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge wèn tí xū yào hé jiā rén shāng tǎo.
examples.english: This issue needs discussing with the family.

entries.explanation: Discuss something face to face.

examples.hanzi: 复杂的问题最好约时间面谈。
examples.pinyin: fù zá de wèn tí zuì hǎo yuē shí jiān miàn tán.
examples.english: It is better to arrange an in-person discussion for complicated issues.

examples.hanzi: 她和老师面谈了学习计划。
examples.pinyin: tā hé lǎo shī miàn tán le xué xí jì huà.
examples.english: She discussed her study plan with the teacher in person.

entries.explanation: Have an arranged discussion about significant matters.

examples.hanzi: 学校和家长代表举行了会谈。
examples.pinyin: xué xiào hé jiā zhǎng dài biǎo jǔ xíng le huì tán.
examples.english: The school held talks with parent representatives.

chunks.gloss: parent or guardian of a child

examples.hanzi: 这次会谈讨论了学生住宿。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì huì tán tǎo lùn le xué sheng zhù sù.
examples.english: These talks discussed student accommodation.

entries.explanation: Talk about a practical matter to reach an arrangement.

examples.hanzi: 他们正在商谈合作方式。
examples.pinyin: tā men zhèng zài shāng tán hé zuò fāng shì.
examples.english: They are discussing how to cooperate.

examples.hanzi: 房租到期前，她和房东商谈续租。
examples.pinyin: fáng zū dào qī qián, tā hé fáng dōng shāng tán xù zū.
examples.english: She discussed renewing the rental with the landlord before it expired.

chunks.gloss: rent for a room or house

entries.explanation: A meeting devoted to discussing a specialized subject.

examples.hanzi: 她参加了一场教学研讨会。
examples.pinyin: tā cān jiā le yì chǎng jiào xué yán tǎo huì.
examples.english: She attended a seminar on teaching.

examples.hanzi: 研讨会最后安排了小组交流。
examples.pinyin: yán tǎo huì zuì hòu ān pái le xiǎo zǔ jiāo liú.
examples.english: Group discussions were arranged at the end of the seminar.

entries.explanation: A meeting arranged for exchanging views on a topic.

examples.hanzi: 班级下周开一次读书讨论会。
examples.pinyin: bān jí xià zhōu kāi yí cì dú shū tǎo lùn huì.
examples.english: The class will hold a reading discussion next week.

examples.hanzi: 讨论会欢迎大家提出不同意见。
examples.pinyin: tǎo lùn huì huān yíng dà jiā tí chū bù tóng yì jiàn.
examples.english: The discussion meeting welcomes different opinions.

entries.explanation: Receive or meet a person in an arranged setting.

examples.hanzi: 校长会见了来访的教师。
examples.pinyin: xiào zhǎng huì jiàn le lái fǎng de jiào shī.
examples.english: The principal met the visiting teachers.

examples.hanzi: 会见结束后，大家参观了校园。
examples.pinyin: huì jiàn jié shù hòu, dà jiā cān guān le xiào yuán.
examples.english: Everyone toured the campus after the meeting.

entries.explanation: Come together at an agreed place.

examples.hanzi: 我们在图书馆门口会合。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men zài tú shū guǎn mén kǒu huì hé.
examples.english: We met up at the library entrance.

examples.hanzi: 两组队员下午在山脚会合。
examples.pinyin: liǎng zǔ duì yuán xià wǔ zài shān jiǎo huì hé.
examples.english: The two groups met at the foot of the mountain in the afternoon.

entries.explanation: Have a brief informal meeting.

examples.hanzi: 我们午饭前碰头商量一下。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men wǔ fàn qián pèng tóu shāng liang yí xià.
examples.english: Let's meet briefly before lunch to discuss it.

examples.hanzi: 他们每周碰头一次，交换进度。
examples.pinyin: tā men měi zhōu pèng tóu yí cì, jiāo huàn jìn dù.
examples.english: They meet briefly once a week to share progress.

entries.english: arrange to meet or do something together
entries.explanation: Make a shared plan with another person.

examples.hanzi: 我们相约周末去看展览。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men xiāng yuē zhōu mò qù kàn zhǎn lǎn.
examples.english: We arranged to visit the exhibition together on the weekend.

chunks.gloss: arrange to meet or do something together

examples.hanzi: 几位旧友相约回母校看看。
examples.pinyin: jǐ wèi jiù yǒu xiāng yuē huí mǔ xiào kàn kàn.
examples.english: Several old friends arranged to visit their former school together.

chunks.gloss: arrange to meet or do something together

parts.gloss: arrange to meet or do something together

entries.explanation: Organize ideas and preparations for a future activity.

examples.hanzi: 她正在筹划一次小型展览。
examples.pinyin: tā zhèng zài chóu huà yí cì xiǎo xíng zhǎn lǎn.
examples.english: She is planning a small exhibition.

examples.hanzi: 这次旅行筹划了很久。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì lǚ xíng chóu huà le hěn jiǔ.
examples.english: This trip was planned for a long time.

parts.gloss: to prepare; to plan; to raise (funds)

entries.explanation: Create an organized plan, standard or policy.

examples.hanzi: 老师和学生一起制订学习计划。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī hé xué sheng yì qǐ zhì dìng xué xí jì huà.
examples.english: The teacher and students formulated a study plan together.

examples.hanzi: 团队正在制订新的工作标准。
examples.pinyin: tuán duì zhèng zài zhì dìng xīn de gōng zuò biāo zhǔn.
examples.english: The team is drawing up new work standards.

entries.explanation: A matter placed on an agenda for discussion.

examples.hanzi: 今天会议的议题是课程安排。
examples.pinyin: jīn tiān huì yì de yì tí shì kè chéng ān pái.
examples.english: Today's meeting topic is the course schedule.

examples.hanzi: 这个议题需要更多资料。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge yì tí xū yào gèng duō zī liào.
examples.english: This discussion topic needs more information.

entries.explanation: A focused treatment of one particular subject.

examples.hanzi: 杂志做了一个阅读专题。
examples.pinyin: zá zhì zuò le yí ge yuè dú zhuān tí.
examples.english: The magazine prepared a special feature on reading.

examples.hanzi: 这次讲座是关于城市交通的专题。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì jiǎng zuò shì guān yú chéng shì jiāo tōng de zhuān tí.
examples.english: This lecture focuses specifically on urban transport.

entries.explanation: One of a limited number of available positions.

examples.hanzi: 这个课程只剩两个名额。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge kè chéng zhǐ shèng liǎng gè míng é.
examples.english: Only two places remain on this course.

examples.hanzi: 报名成功不代表一定有名额。
examples.pinyin: bào míng chéng gōng bú dài biǎo yí dìng yǒu míng é.
examples.english: Successful registration does not guarantee an available place.

entries.explanation: A written record of matters to remember or communicate.

examples.hanzi: 她把约定写进备忘录。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ yuē dìng xiě jìn bèi wàng lù.
examples.english: She recorded the agreement in a reminder note.

examples.hanzi: 这份备忘录列出了后续任务。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn bèi wàng lù liè chū le hòu xù rèn wù.
examples.english: This memorandum lists the follow-up tasks.

entries.explanation: A short report summarizing important developments.

examples.hanzi: 经理在早会上读了一份简报。
examples.pinyin: jīng lǐ zài zǎo huì shàng dú le yì fèn jiǎn bào.
examples.english: The manager read a brief report at the morning meeting.

examples.hanzi: 学校每月发布活动简报。
examples.pinyin: xué xiào měi yuè fā bù huó dòng jiǎn bào.
examples.english: The school publishes an activity bulletin every month.

entries.english: report to a person or group
entries.explanation: Give an organized account of progress or results.

examples.hanzi: 她向老师汇报了调查结果。
examples.pinyin: tā xiàng lǎo shī huì bào le diào chá jié guǒ.
examples.english: She reported the survey results to the teacher.

chunks.gloss: report to a person or group

examples.hanzi: 每组用五分钟汇报进度。
examples.pinyin: měi zǔ yòng wǔ fēn zhōng huì bào jìn dù.
examples.english: Each group has five minutes to report its progress.

chunks.gloss: report to a person or group

parts.gloss: report to a person or group

entries.explanation: Send information to a higher authority or department.

examples.hanzi: 发现问题后要及时上报。
examples.pinyin: fā xiàn wèn tí hòu yào jí shí shàng bào.
examples.english: Report a problem to the higher level promptly when it is found.

examples.hanzi: 工作人员把数据上报给主管。
examples.pinyin: gōng zuò rén yuán bǎ shù jù shàng bào gěi zhǔ guǎn.
examples.english: The staff reported the data to the supervisor.

entries.explanation: A structured table presenting recorded results or figures.

examples.hanzi: 这张报表显示了本月支出。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng bào biǎo xiǎn shì le běn yuè zhī chū.
examples.english: This statement shows this month's expenditure.

examples.hanzi: 提交报表前请核对数字。
examples.pinyin: tí jiāo bào biǎo qián qǐng hé duì shù zì.
examples.english: Check the figures before submitting the report form.

entries.explanation: A document recording terms agreed by parties.

examples.hanzi: 双方在协议书上签字。
examples.pinyin: shuāng fāng zài xié yì shū shàng qiān zì.
examples.english: Both sides signed the written agreement.

examples.hanzi: 这份协议书明确了合作期限。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn xié yì shū míng què le hé zuò qī xiàn.
examples.english: This agreement states the period of cooperation.

entries.explanation: Formally agree to a contract by signing it.

examples.hanzi: 学校与机构签订了合作协议。
examples.pinyin: xué xiào yǔ jī gòu qiān dìng le hé zuò xié yì.
examples.english: The school signed a cooperation agreement with the organization.

examples.hanzi: 签订合同前要仔细阅读条款。
examples.pinyin: qiān dìng hé tóng qián yào zǐ xì yuè dú tiáo kuǎn.
examples.english: Read the terms carefully before signing the contract.

entries.explanation: Help someone or something with money.

examples.hanzi: 这个项目资助学生完成研究。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge xiàng mù zī zhù xué sheng wán chéng yán jiū.
examples.english: This project provides students with funding for their research.

examples.hanzi: 她希望资助家乡的图书室。
examples.pinyin: tā xī wàng zī zhù jiā xiāng de tú shū shì.
examples.english: She hopes to fund her hometown's reading room.

entries.explanation: Provide resources to support an event or project.

examples.hanzi: 本地企业赞助了学校的比赛。
examples.pinyin: běn dì qǐ yè zàn zhù le xué xiào de bǐ sài.
examples.english: A local company sponsored the school competition.

examples.hanzi: 活动主办方正在寻找赞助。
examples.pinyin: huó dòng zhǔ bàn fāng zhèng zài xún zhǎo zàn zhù.
examples.english: The event organizer is looking for sponsorship.

entries.explanation: Support or benefits provided to employees or a community.

examples.hanzi: 公司介绍了员工福利。
examples.pinyin: gōng sī jiè shào le yuán gōng fú lì.
examples.english: The company explained its employee benefits.

examples.hanzi: 这项福利包括定期健康检查。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng fú lì bāo kuò dìng qī jiàn kāng jiǎn chá.
examples.english: This benefit includes regular health checks.

entries.explanation: Handle a matter on behalf of another person or organization.

examples.hanzi: 她代理同事处理了当天的工作。
examples.pinyin: tā dài lǐ tóng shì chǔ lǐ le dàng tiān de gōng zuò.
examples.english: She handled the day's work on behalf of her colleague.

examples.hanzi: 这个代理负责联系不同的出版社。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge dài lǐ fù zé lián xì bù tóng de chū bǎn shè.
examples.english: This agent contacts different publishers.

entries.explanation: One connected part of a larger process.

examples.hanzi: 最后一个环节是提问。
examples.pinyin: zuì hòu yí ge huán jié shì tí wèn.
examples.english: The final part is for questions.

examples.hanzi: 这个环节出了问题，会影响后面。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge huán jié chū le wèn tí, huì yǐng xiǎng hòu mian.
examples.english: A problem at this step will affect what follows.

entries.explanation: The development of an activity through time.

examples.hanzi: 天气影响了比赛进程。
examples.pinyin: tiān qì yǐng xiǎng le bǐ sài jìn chéng.
examples.english: The weather affected the course of the match.

examples.hanzi: 老师定期检查学习进程。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī dìng qí jiǎn chá xué xí jìn chéng.
examples.english: The teacher regularly checks the progress of learning.

entries.explanation: The time needed for a recurring process.

examples.hanzi: 这项检查的周期是一个月。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng jiǎn chá de zhōu qī shì yí ge yuè.
examples.english: This check repeats on a monthly cycle.

examples.hanzi: 不同植物的生长周期不一样。
examples.pinyin: bù tóng zhí wù de shēng zhǎng zhōu qī bù yí yàng.
examples.english: Different plants have different growth cycles.

entries.explanation: Accumulated understanding of a subject or the skill behind an activity.

examples.hanzi: 养花也有不少学问。
examples.pinyin: yǎng huā yě yǒu bù shǎo xué wèn.
examples.english: There is plenty to learn about growing flowers too.

examples.hanzi: 他愿意向有学问的人请教。
examples.pinyin: tā yuàn yì xiàng yǒu xué wèn de rén qǐng jiào.
examples.english: He likes asking knowledgeable people for advice.

entries.explanation: A belief or idea that guides choices and actions.

examples.hanzi: 这所学校重视合作的教育理念。
examples.pinyin: zhè suǒ xué xiào zhòng shì hé zuò de jiào yù lǐ niàn.
examples.english: This school values an educational philosophy of cooperation.

examples.hanzi: 设计理念是让阅读更舒服。
examples.pinyin: shè jì lǐ niàn shì ràng yuè dú gèng shū fu.
examples.english: The guiding design idea is to make reading more comfortable.

entries.explanation: Useful in real situations.

examples.hanzi: 这本小册子很实用。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn xiǎo cè zi hěn shí yòng.
examples.english: This booklet is very practical.

examples.hanzi: 她送给我一份实用的旅行清单。
examples.pinyin: tā sòng gěi wǒ yì fèn shí yòng de lǚ xíng qīng dān.
examples.english: She gave me a useful travel checklist.

entries.explanation: A useful or successful result of effort.

examples.hanzi: 坚持练习后，学习有了成效。
examples.pinyin: jiān chí liàn xí hòu, xué xí yǒu le chéng xiào.
examples.english: Regular practice produced results in learning.

examples.hanzi: 新办法的成效还需要观察。
examples.pinyin: xīn bàn fǎ de chéng xiào hái xū yào guān chá.
examples.english: The effectiveness of the new method still needs observing.

entries.explanation: Reduce effort or unnecessary trouble.

examples.hanzi: 提前准备材料比较省事。
examples.pinyin: tí qián zhǔn bèi cái liào bǐ jiào shěng shì.
examples.english: Preparing the materials ahead of time saves trouble.

examples.hanzi: 这个工具让整理照片更省事。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge gōng jù ràng zhěng lǐ zhào piàn gèng shěng shì.
examples.english: This tool makes organizing photos less troublesome.

entries.explanation: Require or use less physical effort.

examples.hanzi: 用小车搬箱子更省力。
examples.pinyin: yòng xiǎo chē bān xiāng zi gèng shěng lì.
examples.english: Moving boxes with a trolley takes less effort.

examples.hanzi: 这个把手的设计很省力。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge bǎ shou de shè jì hěn shěng lì.
examples.english: The design of this handle makes it easy to use.

entries.explanation: Remove a step or item that is unnecessary.

examples.hanzi: 网上提交可以省去邮寄步骤。
examples.pinyin: wǎng shàng tí jiāo kě yǐ shěng qù yóu jì bù zhòu.
examples.english: Submitting online removes the need to post the documents.

examples.hanzi: 这句话可以省去最后一个词。
examples.pinyin: zhè jù huà kě yǐ shěng qù zuì hòu yī ge cí.
examples.english: The last word can be omitted from this sentence.
