entries.explanation: Use less time, money or other resources.

examples.hanzi: 提前订票可以节省一些钱。
examples.pinyin: tí qián dìng piào kě yǐ jié shěng yì xiē qián.
examples.english: Booking early can save some money.

examples.hanzi: 大家共用资料能节省纸张。
examples.pinyin: dà jiā gòng yòng zī liào néng jié shěng zhǐ zhāng.
examples.english: Sharing materials can save paper.

entries.explanation: Move an action to an earlier time.

examples.hanzi: 她提早十分钟到了教室。
examples.pinyin: tā tí zǎo shí fēn zhōng dào liǎo jiào shì.
examples.english: She arrived in the classroom ten minutes early.

examples.hanzi: 如果天气变差，我们会提早回家。
examples.pinyin: rú guǒ tiān qì biàn chà, wǒ men huì tí zǎo huí jiā.
examples.english: We will go home earlier if the weather gets worse.

entries.explanation: At the earliest practical time.

examples.hanzi: 有问题请尽早告诉我。
examples.pinyin: yǒu wèn tí qǐng jǐn zǎo gào su wǒ.
examples.english: Tell me as early as possible if there is a problem.

examples.hanzi: 她希望尽早完成作业。
examples.pinyin: tā xī wàng jǐn zǎo wán chéng zuò yè.
examples.english: She hopes to finish the homework as early as possible.

entries.explanation: Remind or press someone to carry out a task.

examples.hanzi: 老师督促我们按时交作业。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī dū cù wǒ men àn shí jiāo zuò yè.
examples.english: The teacher urged us to hand in homework on time.

examples.hanzi: 她设置提醒，督促自己每天练习。
examples.pinyin: tā shè zhì tí xǐng, dū cù zì jǐ měi tiān liàn xí.
examples.english: She set reminders to encourage herself to practice daily.

entries.explanation: Give someone reasons or confidence to act.

examples.hanzi: 这次进步激励她继续学习。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì jìn bù jī lì tā jì xù xué xí.
examples.english: This improvement motivated her to keep studying.

examples.hanzi: 老师用具体的肯定激励学生。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī yòng jù tǐ de kěn dìng jī lì xué sheng.
examples.english: The teacher motivates students with specific praise.

entries.explanation: Increase someone's confidence or enthusiasm.

examples.hanzi: 同学们的支持让他很受鼓舞。
examples.pinyin: tóng xué men de zhī chí ràng tā hěn shòu gǔ wǔ.
examples.english: His classmates' support greatly encouraged him.

examples.hanzi: 这次成功鼓舞了整个团队。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì chéng gōng gǔ wǔ le zhěng gè tuán duì.
examples.english: This success lifted the whole team's spirits.

entries.explanation: Manage one's life or responsibilities independently.

examples.hanzi: 她离家以后学会了自立。
examples.pinyin: tā lí jiā yǐ hòu xué huì le zì lì.
examples.english: She learned to be self-reliant after leaving home.

examples.hanzi: 父母鼓励孩子逐渐自立。
examples.pinyin: fù mǔ gǔ lì hái zi zhú jiàn zì lì.
examples.english: The parents encourage their child to become independent gradually.

entries.explanation: Provide help to each other.

examples.hanzi: 同学们组成了互助小组。
examples.pinyin: tóng xué men zǔ chéng le hù zhù xiǎo zǔ.
examples.english: The classmates formed a mutual-help group.

examples.hanzi: 邻里互助让生活方便很多。
examples.pinyin: lín lǐ hù zhù ràng shēng huó fāng biàn hěn duō.
examples.english: Neighbors helping one another makes life much easier.

entries.explanation: Work in the same setting or on shared tasks.

examples.hanzi: 我们曾经共事三年。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men céng jīng gòng shì sān nián.
examples.english: We worked together for three years.

examples.hanzi: 与她共事让我学到很多。
examples.pinyin: yǔ tā gòng shì ràng wǒ xué dào hěn duō.
examples.english: Working with her taught me a lot.

entries.explanation: Attend social activities connected with work or obligations.

examples.hanzi: 他今晚有工作上的应酬。
examples.pinyin: tā jīn wǎn yǒu gōng zuò shàng de yìng chou.
examples.english: He has a work-related social engagement tonight.

examples.hanzi: 她尽量减少不必要的应酬。
examples.pinyin: tā jǐn liàng jiǎn shǎo bú bì yào de yìng chou.
examples.english: She tries to reduce unnecessary social obligations.

entries.explanation: Follow an agreement or attend as promised.

examples.hanzi: 约好时间以后，双方都要守约。
examples.pinyin: yuē hǎo shí jiān yǐ hòu, shuāng fāng dōu yào shǒu yuē.
examples.english: Both sides should keep the agreement after setting a time.

examples.hanzi: 她一向守约，从不无故迟到。
examples.pinyin: tā yí xiàng shǒu yuē, cóng bù wú gù chí dào.
examples.english: She always keeps her appointments and is never late without reason.

entries.explanation: Do what one has promised to do.

examples.hanzi: 答应别人的事情要守信用。
examples.pinyin: dā ying bié ren de shì qíng yào shǒu xìn yòng.
examples.english: Keep your word about things you promise others.

examples.hanzi: 他很守信用，按时还了书。
examples.pinyin: tā hěn shǒu xìn yòng, àn shí hái le shū.
examples.english: He kept his word and returned the book on time.

entries.explanation: Continue to follow a promise or commitment.

examples.hanzi: 双方都应信守承诺。
examples.pinyin: shuāng fāng dōu yīng xìn shǒu chéng nuò.
examples.english: Both sides should honor their promises.

examples.hanzi: 她信守约定，没有透露朋友的秘密。
examples.pinyin: tā xìn shǒu yuē dìng, méi yǒu tòu lù péng you de mì mì.
examples.english: She kept the agreement and did not reveal her friend's secret.

entries.explanation: An awareness of being accountable for one's duties.

examples.hanzi: 照顾植物培养了他的责任感。
examples.pinyin: zhào gù zhí wù péi yǎng le tā de zé rèn gǎn.
examples.english: Caring for plants developed his sense of responsibility.

examples.hanzi: 她对这项工作有很强的责任感。
examples.pinyin: tā duì zhè xiàng gōng zuò yǒu hěn qiáng de zé rèn gǎn.
examples.english: She has a strong sense of responsibility toward this work.

entries.explanation: A willingness to take duties seriously.

examples.hanzi: 这位老师很有责任心。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi lǎo shī hěn yǒu zé rèn xīn.
examples.english: This teacher takes her responsibilities seriously.

examples.hanzi: 养宠物需要耐心和责任心。
examples.pinyin: yǎng chǒng wù xū yào nài xīn hé zé rèn xīn.
examples.english: Keeping a pet requires patience and a responsible attitude.

entries.english: right to speak; influence in discussion
entries.explanation: The right or standing to express views on a matter.

examples.hanzi: 每个组员都应该有发言权。
examples.pinyin: měi ge zǔ yuán dōu yīng gāi yǒu fā yán quán.
examples.english: Every group member should have the right to speak.

chunks.gloss: right to speak; influence in discussion

examples.hanzi: 了解实际情况才能更有发言权。
examples.pinyin: liǎo jiě shí jì qíng kuàng cái néng gèng yǒu fā yán quán.
examples.english: Knowing the situation gives you a stronger voice in the discussion.

chunks.gloss: right to speak; influence in discussion

parts.gloss: right to speak; influence in discussion

entries.explanation: An idea or feeling left by an experience.

examples.hanzi: 这座城市给我留下了很好的印象。
examples.pinyin: zhè zuò chéng shì gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn hǎo de yìn xiàng.
examples.english: This city left a very good impression on me.

examples.hanzi: 我对那次比赛还有一点印象。
examples.pinyin: wǒ duì nà cì bǐ sài hái yǒu yì diǎn yìn xiàng.
examples.english: I still have some memory of that match.

entries.explanation: Have mutual feelings of love.

examples.hanzi: 他们相爱多年，仍然关心彼此。
examples.pinyin: tā men xiāng ài duō nián, réng rán guān xīn bǐ cǐ.
examples.english: They have loved each other for years and still care about each other.

examples.hanzi: 相爱的人也需要学会沟通。
examples.pinyin: xiāng ài de rén yě xū yào xué huì gōu tōng.
examples.english: People who love each other still need to learn to communicate.

chunks.gloss: to communicate; to discuss with others

parts.gloss: to love; to be fond of; to like

entries.english: fall in love with; become fond of
entries.explanation: Begin to feel love or strong liking for someone or something.

examples.hanzi: 他在一次旅行中爱上了摄影。
examples.pinyin: tā zài yí cì lǚ xíng zhōng ài shàng le shè yǐng.
examples.english: He became fond of photography during a trip.

chunks.gloss: fall in love with; become fond of

examples.hanzi: 她慢慢爱上了这座安静的小城。
examples.pinyin: tā màn màn ài shàng le zhè zuò ān jìng de xiǎo chéng.
examples.english: She gradually fell in love with this quiet small town.

chunks.gloss: fall in love with; become fond of

parts.gloss: fall in love with; become fond of

entries.explanation: A male partner in a romantic relationship.

examples.hanzi: 她和男友一起准备晚饭。
examples.pinyin: tā hé nán yǒu yì qǐ zhǔn bèi wǎn fàn.
examples.english: She and her boyfriend prepared dinner together.

examples.hanzi: 她把男友介绍给了家人。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ nán yǒu jiè shào gěi le jiā rén.
examples.english: She introduced her boyfriend to her family.

entries.explanation: A female partner in a romantic relationship.

examples.hanzi: 他的女友喜欢读旅行故事。
examples.pinyin: tā de nǚ yǒu xǐ huan dú lǚ xíng gù shi.
examples.english: His girlfriend enjoys reading travel stories.

examples.hanzi: 他陪女友去参加朋友的婚礼。
examples.pinyin: tā péi nǚ yǒu qù cān jiā péng you de hūn lǐ.
examples.english: He accompanied his girlfriend to a friend's wedding.

entries.explanation: Two people who are in a romantic relationship.

examples.hanzi: 这对情侣每周一起去散步。
examples.pinyin: zhè duì qíng lǚ měi zhōu yì qǐ qù sàn bù.
examples.english: This couple goes for a walk together every week.

examples.hanzi: 两位情侣一起经营一家小店。
examples.pinyin: liǎng wèi qíng lǚ yì qǐ jīng yíng yì jiā xiǎo diàn.
examples.english: The two romantic partners run a small shop together.

entries.explanation: A relationship involving romantic love.

examples.hanzi: 她不愿公开自己的恋情。
examples.pinyin: tā bú yuàn gōng kāi zì jǐ de liàn qíng.
examples.english: She does not want to make her romantic relationship public.

examples.hanzi: 这段恋情让他学会更好地沟通。
examples.pinyin: zhè duàn liàn qíng ràng tā xué huì gèng hǎo de gōu tōng.
examples.english: This relationship taught him to communicate better.

entries.explanation: The affection and trust between friends.

examples.hanzi: 我们珍惜多年的友情。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men zhēn xī duō nián de yǒu qíng.
examples.english: We value our years of friendship.

examples.hanzi: 即使住得很远，友情也没有变。
examples.pinyin: jí shǐ zhù de hěn yuǎn, yǒu qíng yě méi yǒu biàn.
examples.english: Our friendship has not changed even though we live far apart.

entries.explanation: Build friendships with other people.

examples.hanzi: 阅读小组给她提供了交友的机会。
examples.pinyin: yuè dú xiǎo zǔ gěi tā tí gōng le jiāo yǒu de jī huì.
examples.english: The reading group gave her opportunities to make friends.

examples.hanzi: 交友时要尊重彼此的选择。
examples.pinyin: jiāo yǒu shí yào zūn zhòng bǐ cǐ de xuǎn zé.
examples.english: Respect each other's choices when making friends.

entries.explanation: Get to know people and build friendships.

examples.hanzi: 他喜欢在活动中交朋友。
examples.pinyin: tā xǐ huan zài huó dòng zhōng jiāo péng you.
examples.english: He likes making friends at activities.

examples.hanzi: 刚到新学校时，她不太会交朋友。
examples.pinyin: gāng dào xīn xué xiào shí, tā bú tài huì jiāo péng you.
examples.english: She was unsure how to make friends when she first arrived at the new school.

entries.explanation: The closeness built through personal contact.

examples.hanzi: 我和这位邻居有多年交情。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hé zhè wèi lín jū yǒu duō nián jiāo qing.
examples.english: This neighbor and I have known each other well for years.

examples.hanzi: 他们工作上认识，但没有深的交情。
examples.pinyin: tā men gōng zuò shàng rèn shi, dàn méi yǒu shēn de jiāo qing.
examples.english: They know each other through work but are not close friends.

entries.explanation: Care, obligations or favors arising from human relationships.

examples.hanzi: 她记得别人帮忙的人情。
examples.pinyin: tā jì de bié ren bāng máng de rén qíng.
examples.english: She remembers the favors others have done for her.

examples.hanzi: 处理事情时也要考虑人情。
examples.pinyin: chǔ lǐ shì qíng shí yě yào kǎo lǜ rén qíng.
examples.english: Human relationships should also be considered when handling matters.

entries.explanation: People one knows who can provide connections or support.

examples.hanzi: 她在志愿活动中积累了人脉。
examples.pinyin: tā zài zhì yuàn huó dòng zhōng jī lěi le rén mài.
examples.english: She built a network of contacts through volunteering.

examples.hanzi: 人脉不能代替真正的能力。
examples.pinyin: rén mài bù néng dài tì zhēn zhèng de néng lì.
examples.english: Connections cannot replace real ability.

entries.explanation: Relationships between people in a social setting.

examples.hanzi: 良好的人际关系需要沟通。
examples.pinyin: liáng hǎo de rén jì guān xì xū yào gōu tōng.
examples.english: Good interpersonal relationships require communication.

examples.hanzi: 他希望改善办公室的人际关系。
examples.pinyin: tā xī wàng gǎi shàn bàn gōng shì de rén jì guān xì.
examples.english: He hopes to improve relationships in the office.

entries.explanation: An interconnected set of social contacts.

examples.hanzi: 共同的兴趣扩大了她的关系网。
examples.pinyin: gòng tóng de xìng qù kuò dà le tā de guān xi wǎng.
examples.english: Shared interests expanded her network of relationships.

examples.hanzi: 他通过关系网找到了一位合适的老师。
examples.pinyin: tā tōng guò guān xi wǎng zhǎo dào le yí wèi hé shì de lǎo shī.
examples.english: He found a suitable teacher through his network of contacts.

entries.explanation: A person one knows but may not be close to.

examples.hanzi: 我在车站遇见一位熟人。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài chē zhàn yù jiàn yí wèi shú rén.
examples.english: I met an acquaintance at the station.

examples.hanzi: 因为是熟人，她很快放松下来。
examples.pinyin: yīn wèi shì shú rén, tā hěn kuài fàng sōng xià lái.
examples.english: She relaxed quickly because the person was someone she knew.

chunks.gloss: down; complement of completion or change

entries.explanation: A friend with whom one shares a close relationship.

examples.hanzi: 她把烦恼告诉了密友。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ fán nǎo gào su le mì yǒu.
examples.english: She told her close friend about her worries.

examples.hanzi: 两位密友经常一起读书。
examples.pinyin: liǎng wèi mì yǒu jīng cháng yì qǐ dú shū.
examples.english: The two close friends often read together.

entries.explanation: A friend known from an earlier time.

examples.hanzi: 他在旅行时遇到了旧友。
examples.pinyin: tā zài lǚ xíng shí yù dào le jiù yǒu.
examples.english: He met an old friend while traveling.

examples.hanzi: 旧友来访，让她想起了学生时代。
examples.pinyin: jiù yǒu lái fǎng, ràng tā xiǎng qǐ le xué sheng shí dài.
examples.english: The old friend's visit reminded her of her student days.

entries.explanation: A friend who understands one's thoughts and feelings deeply.

examples.hanzi: 她把这位同学当作知己。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ zhè wèi tóng xué dàng zuò zhī jǐ.
examples.english: She considers this classmate a close confidant.

examples.hanzi: 能遇到理解自己的知己很难得。
examples.pinyin: néng yù dào lǐ jiě zì jǐ de zhī jǐ hěn nán dé.
examples.english: Finding a friend who truly understands you is precious.

entries.explanation: A person who shares a room or accommodation.

examples.hanzi: 我的室友习惯早睡。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de shì yǒu xí guàn zǎo shuì.
examples.english: My roommate prefers going to bed early.

examples.hanzi: 她和室友商量了打扫的安排。
examples.pinyin: tā hé shì yǒu shāng liang le dǎ sǎo de ān pái.
examples.english: She discussed the cleaning schedule with her roommate.

entries.explanation: A member of the same team.

examples.hanzi: 队友在场边鼓励他。
examples.pinyin: duì yǒu zài chǎng biān gǔ lì tā.
examples.english: His teammates encouraged him from the sidelines.

examples.hanzi: 训练结束后，她和队友一起回家。
examples.pinyin: xùn liàn jié shù hòu, tā hé duì yǒu yì qǐ huí jiā.
examples.english: She went home with her teammates after training.

entries.explanation: Treating others with warmth and goodwill.

examples.hanzi: 新同学对大家很友善。
examples.pinyin: xīn tóng xué duì dà jiā hěn yǒu shàn.
examples.english: The new classmate is friendly toward everyone.

examples.hanzi: 他的友善让陌生人也愿意聊天。
examples.pinyin: tā de yǒu shàn ràng mò shēng rén yě yuàn yì liáo tiān.
examples.english: His friendliness makes even strangers willing to chat.

entries.explanation: A wish to help or care for others.

examples.hanzi: 她是好心提醒我带伞。
examples.pinyin: tā shì hǎo xīn tí xǐng wǒ dài sǎn.
examples.english: She kindly reminded me to bring an umbrella.

examples.hanzi: 这位好心的邻居帮我搬了箱子。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi hǎo xīn de lín jū bāng wǒ bān le xiāng zi.
examples.english: This kindhearted neighbor helped me move the box.

entries.explanation: A positive intention behind a helpful action.

examples.hanzi: 我明白你的好意，但想自己试试。
examples.pinyin: wǒ míng bai nǐ de hǎo yì, dàn xiǎng zì jǐ shì shi.
examples.english: I understand your kind intentions, but want to try it myself.

examples.hanzi: 他把我的好意误解了。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ wǒ de hǎo yì wù jiě le.
examples.english: He misunderstood my good intentions.

entries.explanation: Words that praise, comfort or present something favorably.

examples.hanzi: 他只想听好话，不愿听建议。
examples.pinyin: tā zhī xiǎng tīng hǎo huà, bú yuàn tīng jiàn yì.
examples.english: He only wants favorable comments and not advice.

examples.hanzi: 一句好话能让人心情轻松一些。
examples.pinyin: yí jù hǎo huà néng ràng rén xīn qíng qīng sōng yì xiē.
examples.english: A kind word can help someone feel a little more relaxed.

entries.explanation: A positive feeling toward a person or thing.

examples.hanzi: 她对这位新老师很有好感。
examples.pinyin: tā duì zhè wèi xīn lǎo shī hěn yǒu hǎo gǎn.
examples.english: She has a favorable impression of the new teacher.

examples.hanzi: 整洁的环境增加了客人的好感。
examples.pinyin: zhěng jié de huán jìng zēng jiā le kè rén de hǎo gǎn.
examples.english: The tidy surroundings improved the visitors' impression.

entries.explanation: An intention that is kind rather than harmful.

examples.hanzi: 我把这句话理解为善意的提醒。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ zhè jù huà lǐ jiě wèi shàn yì de tí xǐng.
examples.english: I understood this as a well-intentioned reminder.

examples.hanzi: 争论时也要保留善意。
examples.pinyin: zhēng lùn shí yě yào bǎo liú shàn yì.
examples.english: Keep a sense of goodwill even when disagreeing.

entries.explanation: Expressing real feelings without pretending.

examples.hanzi: 我真心希望你学得开心。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhēn xīn xī wàng nǐ xué de kāi xīn.
examples.english: I sincerely hope you enjoy learning.

examples.hanzi: 她用真心换来了朋友的信任。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng zhēn xīn huàn lái le péng you de xìn rèn.
examples.english: Her sincerity won her friend's trust.

entries.explanation: A genuine willingness to act respectfully or cooperatively.

examples.hanzi: 这封道歉信表达了他的诚意。
examples.pinyin: zhè fēng dào qiàn xìn biǎo dá le tā de chéng yì.
examples.english: This apology letter expressed his sincerity.

examples.hanzi: 双方都拿出了合作的诚意。
examples.pinyin: shuāng fāng dōu ná chū le hé zuò de chéng yì.
examples.english: Both sides showed genuine willingness to cooperate.

entries.explanation: Coming genuinely from one's deepest feelings.

examples.hanzi: 我们向老师表示衷心的感谢。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men xiàng lǎo shī biǎo shì zhōng xīn de gǎn xiè.
examples.english: We offer heartfelt thanks to the teacher.

examples.hanzi: 她收到朋友衷心的祝福。
examples.pinyin: tā shōu dào péng you zhōng xīn de zhù fú.
examples.english: She received sincere wishes from her friend.

entries.explanation: The feeling of appreciation for kindness or help.

examples.hanzi: 她用一张卡片表达谢意。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng yì zhāng kǎ piàn biǎo dá xiè yì.
examples.english: She expressed her gratitude with a card.

examples.hanzi: 我不知道怎样表示自己的谢意。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào zěn yàng biǎo shì zì jǐ de xiè yì.
examples.english: I do not know how to express my gratitude.

entries.explanation: Recognize and appreciate help or kindness received.

examples.hanzi: 她感恩家人一直支持自己。
examples.pinyin: tā gǎn ēn jiā rén yì zhí zhī chí zì jǐ.
examples.english: She is grateful for her family's continued support.

examples.hanzi: 感恩不一定需要昂贵的礼物。
examples.pinyin: gǎn ēn bù yí dìng xū yào áng guì de lǐ wù.
examples.english: Showing gratitude does not require an expensive gift.

entries.explanation: Formally show gratitude.

examples.hanzi: 演出结束后，学生向老师致谢。
examples.pinyin: yǎn chū jié shù hòu, xué sheng xiàng lǎo shī zhì xiè.
examples.english: The students thanked the teacher after the performance.

examples.hanzi: 他在文章结尾向帮助者致谢。
examples.pinyin: tā zài wén zhāng jié wěi xiàng bāng zhù zhě zhì xiè.
examples.english: He thanked those who helped him at the end of the article.

entries.explanation: Formally express regret for a mistake or inconvenience.

examples.hanzi: 负责人为延误向大家致歉。
examples.pinyin: fù zé rén wèi yán wù xiàng dà jiā zhì qiàn.
examples.english: The person in charge apologized to everyone for the delay.

examples.hanzi: 她写信向朋友致歉。
examples.pinyin: tā xiě xìn xiàng péng you zhì qiàn.
examples.english: She wrote to apologize to her friend.

entries.explanation: The regret felt over causing inconvenience or harm.

examples.hanzi: 他为迟到表达了歉意。
examples.pinyin: tā wèi chí dào biǎo dá le qiàn yì.
examples.english: He expressed regret for being late.

examples.hanzi: 她带着歉意解释了情况。
examples.pinyin: tā dài zhe qiàn yì jiě shì le qíng kuàng.
examples.english: She explained the situation apologetically.

entries.explanation: Feeling regret for having failed or hurt someone.

examples.hanzi: 让朋友久等，他感到愧疚。
examples.pinyin: ràng péng you jiǔ děng, tā gǎn dào kuì jiù.
examples.english: He felt guilty for keeping his friend waiting.

examples.hanzi: 她因为忘记约定而有些愧疚。
examples.pinyin: tā yīn wèi wàng jì yuē dìng ér yǒu xiē kuì jiù.
examples.english: She felt some remorse for forgetting the appointment.

entries.explanation: Respect for one's own worth and dignity.

examples.hanzi: 当众取笑别人会伤害他的自尊。
examples.pinyin: dāng zhòng qǔ xiào bié ren huì shāng hài tā de zì zūn.
examples.english: Making fun of someone publicly can hurt their self-respect.

examples.hanzi: 她学会了表达需要，也保留了自尊。
examples.pinyin: tā xué huì le biǎo dá xū yào, yě bǎo liú le zì zūn.
examples.english: She learned to express her needs while keeping her self-respect.

entries.explanation: Sensitivity to one's worth and how others treat it.

examples.hanzi: 批评时要顾及对方的自尊心。
examples.pinyin: pī píng shí yào gù jí duì fāng de zì zūn xīn.
examples.english: Consider the other person's dignity when criticizing.

examples.hanzi: 他自尊心很强，不愿接受嘲笑。
examples.pinyin: tā zì zūn xīn hěn qiáng, bú yuàn jiē shòu cháo xiào.
examples.english: He has a strong sense of dignity and does not accept ridicule.

entries.explanation: Belief in one's ability to handle a task.

examples.hanzi: 这次成功增强了她的自信心。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì chéng gōng zēng qiáng le tā de zì xìn xīn.
examples.english: This success strengthened her self-confidence.

examples.hanzi: 老师帮助他慢慢建立自信心。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī bāng zhù tā màn màn jiàn lì zì xìn xīn.
examples.english: The teacher helped him gradually build self-confidence.

entries.explanation: The feeling of being safe and supported.

examples.hanzi: 熟悉的声音给孩子安全感。
examples.pinyin: shú xī de shēng yīn gěi hái zi ān quán gǎn.
examples.english: A familiar voice gives the child a sense of security.

examples.hanzi: 稳定的约定能增加彼此的安全感。
examples.pinyin: wěn dìng de yuē dìng néng zēng jiā bǐ cǐ de ān quán gǎn.
examples.english: Reliable agreements can increase both people's sense of security.

entries.explanation: Satisfaction from completing something meaningful.

examples.hanzi: 做完第一幅画，她很有成就感。
examples.pinyin: zuò wán dì yī fú huà, tā hěn yǒu chéng jiù gǎn.
examples.english: She felt a sense of achievement after finishing her first painting.

examples.hanzi: 小目标也能带来成就感。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo mù biāo yě néng dài lái chéng jiù gǎn.
examples.english: Small goals can also bring a sense of achievement.

entries.explanation: Expecting positive possibilities despite difficulties.

examples.hanzi: 虽然进度慢，她仍然很乐观。
examples.pinyin: suī rán jìn dù màn, tā réng rán hěn lè guān.
examples.english: She remains optimistic despite slow progress.

examples.hanzi: 他对新学期保持乐观的态度。
examples.pinyin: tā duì xīn xué qī bǎo chí lè guān de tài dù.
examples.english: He keeps an optimistic attitude toward the new term.

entries.explanation: The pleasure found in an activity or experience.

examples.hanzi: 他在做饭中发现了乐趣。
examples.pinyin: tā zài zuò fàn zhōng fā xiàn le lè qù.
examples.english: He found enjoyment in cooking.

examples.hanzi: 和朋友一起学习增加了乐趣。
examples.pinyin: hé péng you yì qǐ xué xí zēng jiā le lè qù.
examples.english: Studying with friends made it more enjoyable.

entries.explanation: A person who enjoys and takes interest in an activity.

examples.hanzi: 这次活动吸引了很多摄影爱好者。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì huó dòng xī yǐn le hěn duō shè yǐng ài hào zhě.
examples.english: This event attracted many photography enthusiasts.

examples.hanzi: 她是一位古典音乐爱好者。
examples.pinyin: tā shì yí wèi gǔ diǎn yīn yuè ài hào zhě.
examples.english: She is a classical music enthusiast.

entries.explanation: A person particularly interested in films.

examples.hanzi: 这位影迷收藏了很多电影海报。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi yǐng mí shōu cáng le hěn duō diàn yǐng hǎi bào.
examples.english: This film fan has collected many film posters.

examples.hanzi: 影迷们在活动后交流观后感。
examples.pinyin: yǐng mí men zài huó dòng hòu jiāo liú guān hòu gǎn.
examples.english: The film fans discussed their impressions after the event.

chunks.gloss: impression or feeling after visiting or watching (movies, museums etc)

entries.explanation: Something a person sincerely wants to happen.

examples.hanzi: 她的心愿是学会画画。
examples.pinyin: tā de xīn yuàn shì xué huì huà huà.
examples.english: Her wish is to learn to paint.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷终于实现了多年的心愿。
examples.pinyin: yé ye zhōng yú shí xiàn le duō nián de xīn yuàn.
examples.english: Grandfather finally fulfilled a wish he had held for years.

entries.explanation: Feelings or thoughts one deeply wants to express.

examples.hanzi: 这首歌说出了她的心声。
examples.pinyin: zhè shǒu gē shuō chū le tā de xīn shēng.
examples.english: This song expressed her inner feelings.

examples.hanzi: 老师鼓励学生说出心声。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī gǔ lì xué sheng shuō chū xīn shēng.
examples.english: The teacher encouraged students to voice their true feelings.

entries.explanation: What a person is thinking about or concentrating on.

examples.hanzi: 她的心思都放在学习上。
examples.pinyin: tā de xīn si dōu fàng zài xué xí shàng.
examples.english: Her attention is focused entirely on studying.

examples.hanzi: 我看不出他真正的心思。
examples.pinyin: wǒ kàn bu chū tā zhēn zhèng de xīn si.
examples.english: I cannot tell what he is really thinking.

entries.explanation: The deepest part of one's private feelings.

examples.hanzi: 他从心底感谢朋友的帮助。
examples.pinyin: tā cóng xīn dǐ gǎn xiè péng you de bāng zhù.
examples.english: He thanks his friend from the bottom of his heart.

examples.hanzi: 这段回忆一直留在她心底。
examples.pinyin: zhè duàn huí yì yì zhí liú zài tā xīn dǐ.
examples.english: This memory has stayed deep in her heart.

entries.explanation: Hold a feeling or intention within oneself.

examples.hanzi: 她心怀感激地接受了帮助。
examples.pinyin: tā xīn huái gǎn jī de jiē shòu le bāng zhù.
examples.english: She accepted the help with gratitude.

examples.hanzi: 即使遇到困难，他仍心怀希望。
examples.pinyin: jí shǐ yù dào kùn nan, tā réng xīn huái xī wàng.
examples.english: He still cherishes hope despite difficulties.

entries.explanation: How open or tolerant a person's attitude is.

examples.hanzi: 他心胸开阔，愿意听不同意见。
examples.pinyin: tā xīn xiōng kāi kuò, yuàn yì tīng bù tóng yì jiàn.
examples.english: He is open-minded and willing to hear different views.

examples.hanzi: 不要因为小事让心胸变得狭窄。
examples.pinyin: bú yào yīn wèi xiǎo shì ràng xīn xiōng biàn de xiá zhǎi.
examples.english: Do not let small matters make you narrow-minded.

entries.explanation: A person's moral nature or intentions.

examples.hanzi: 这位邻居心地善良。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi lín jū xīn dì shàn liáng.
examples.english: This neighbor has a kind nature.

examples.hanzi: 她的心地从平时的小事就能看出来。
examples.pinyin: tā de xīn dì cóng píng shí de xiǎo shì jiù néng kàn chu lai.
examples.english: Her character shows in small everyday actions.

chunks.gloss: (after a verb, indicates coming out, completion of an action, or ability to discern or detect)

entries.explanation: Words expressing one's genuine feelings.

examples.hanzi: 他终于向朋友说了心里话。
examples.pinyin: tā zhōng yú xiàng péng you shuō le xīn li huà.
examples.english: He finally told his friend his true feelings.

examples.hanzi: 这封信里写的都是心里话。
examples.pinyin: zhè fēng xìn lǐ xiě de dōu shì xīn li huà.
examples.english: Everything in this letter comes from the writer's heart.

entries.explanation: The overall attitude with which someone faces a situation.

examples.hanzi: 比赛前要调整好心态。
examples.pinyin: bǐ sài qián yào tiáo zhěng hǎo xīn tài.
examples.english: Adjust your mental attitude before the match.

examples.hanzi: 学习时保持开放的心态很有帮助。
examples.pinyin: xué xí shí bǎo chí kāi fàng de xīn tài hěn yǒu bāng zhù.
examples.english: An open attitude is helpful when learning.

entries.explanation: A person's preference or desire to act.

examples.hanzi: 安排活动时要考虑孩子的意愿。
examples.pinyin: ān pái huó dòng shí yào kǎo lǜ hái zi de yì yuàn.
examples.english: Consider the child's wishes when arranging activities.

examples.hanzi: 她表达了继续学习的意愿。
examples.pinyin: tā biǎo dá le jì xù xué xí de yì yuàn.
examples.english: She expressed a wish to continue studying.

entries.explanation: The purpose behind an action or message.

examples.hanzi: 我没有理解他这句话的意图。
examples.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu lǐ jiě tā zhè jù huà de yì tú.
examples.english: I did not understand the intention behind his words.

examples.hanzi: 先说明意图，可以减少误会。
examples.pinyin: xiān shuō míng yì tú, kě yǐ jiǎn shǎo wù huì.
examples.english: Explaining your intention first can reduce misunderstandings.

entries.explanation: The reason something is said or done.

examples.hanzi: 老师这样安排有自己的用意。
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī zhè yàng ān pái yǒu zì jǐ de yòng yì.
examples.english: The teacher has a reason for arranging it this way.

examples.hanzi: 我后来才明白她的用意。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hòu lái cái míng bai tā de yòng yì.
examples.english: I understood her purpose only later.

entries.explanation: What someone originally meant or wanted to do.

examples.hanzi: 我的本意是帮忙，并不是批评。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de běn yì shì bāng máng, bìng bú shì pī píng.
examples.english: My original intention was to help, not criticize.

examples.hanzi: 请不要误解这句话的本意。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bú yào wù jiě zhè jù huà de běn yì.
examples.english: Do not misunderstand the intended meaning of this sentence.

entries.explanation: The meaning intended before it was altered or interpreted.

examples.hanzi: 翻译要尽量保留原意。
examples.pinyin: fān yì yào jǐn liàng bǎo liú yuán yì.
examples.english: A translation should preserve the original meaning as much as possible.

examples.hanzi: 转述时不要改变对方的原意。
examples.pinyin: zhuǎn shù shí bú yào gǎi biàn duì fāng de yuán yì.
examples.english: Do not change someone's original meaning when repeating their words.

entries.explanation: Form an idea without being certain.

examples.hanzi: 我猜想她可能还在路上。
examples.pinyin: wǒ cāi xiǎng tā kě néng hái zài lù shang.
examples.english: I suppose she may still be on the way.

chunks.gloss: on the way; on the road

examples.hanzi: 他的猜想后来得到了证实。
examples.pinyin: tā de cāi xiǎng hòu lái de dào liǎo zhèng shí.
examples.english: His guess was later confirmed.

entries.explanation: A feeling about what may happen before evidence is available.

examples.hanzi: 她有一种比赛会顺利的预感。
examples.pinyin: tā yǒu yì zhǒng bǐ sài huì shùn lì de yù gǎn.
examples.english: She has a feeling that the match will go smoothly.

examples.hanzi: 这个预感并没有成为事实。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge yù gǎn bìng méi yǒu chéng wéi shì shí.
examples.english: This premonition did not come true.

entries.explanation: Imagine how something may develop before it happens.

examples.hanzi: 结果比我预想的好。
examples.pinyin: jié guǒ bǐ wǒ yù xiǎng de hǎo.
examples.english: The result was better than I had anticipated.

examples.hanzi: 出发前要预想可能遇到的问题。
examples.pinyin: chū fā qián yào yù xiǎng kě néng yù dào de wèn tí.
examples.english: Anticipate possible problems before setting out.

entries.explanation: Know relevant facts about a situation.

examples.hanzi: 她对此并不知情。
examples.pinyin: tā duì cǐ bìng bù zhī qíng.
examples.english: She knows nothing about this situation.

examples.hanzi: 在所有人知情后，我们再做决定。
examples.pinyin: zài suǒ yǒu rén zhī qíng hòu, wǒ men zài zuò jué dìng.
examples.english: We will decide after everyone has been informed.

entries.explanation: Feeling proud or satisfied with a success.

examples.hanzi: 她赢了比赛，笑得很得意。
examples.pinyin: tā yíng le bǐ sài, xiào de hěn dé yì.
examples.english: She won the match and smiled proudly.

examples.hanzi: 有一点进步也不要太得意。
examples.pinyin: yǒu yì diǎn jìn bù yě bú yào tài dé yì.
examples.english: Do not become too pleased with yourself after a little progress.

entries.explanation: Feeling bothered or unable to settle one's thoughts.

examples.hanzi: 外面的噪声让我很心烦。
examples.pinyin: wài miàn de zào shēng ràng wǒ hěn xīn fán.
examples.english: The noise outside is making me annoyed.

examples.hanzi: 心烦时，她喜欢走出去散步。
examples.pinyin: xīn fán shí, tā xǐ huan zǒu chū qù sàn bù.
examples.english: She likes going for a walk when she feels troubled.

entries.explanation: Feel bothered by a troublesome matter.

examples.hanzi: 她为搬家的事情烦心。
examples.pinyin: tā wèi bān jiā de shì qing fán xīn.
examples.english: She is troubled by the move.

examples.hanzi: 这是件烦心的事，需要慢慢处理。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì jiàn fán xīn de shì, xū yào màn màn chǔ lǐ.
examples.english: This is a troubling matter that needs handling patiently.

entries.english: be in a difficult position; trouble someone
entries.explanation: Face a difficult choice or make a request hard to meet.

examples.hanzi: 两个邀请同时到来，让她很为难。
examples.pinyin: liǎng gè yāo qǐng tóng shí dào lái, ràng tā hěn wéi nán.
examples.english: Receiving two invitations at once put her in a difficult position.

chunks.gloss: be in a difficult position; trouble someone

examples.hanzi: 如果时间不合适，我不想为难你。
examples.pinyin: rú guǒ shí jiān bù hé shì, wǒ bù xiǎng wéi nán nǐ.
examples.english: I do not want to trouble you if the time is unsuitable.

chunks.gloss: be in a difficult position; trouble someone

parts.gloss: be in a difficult position; trouble someone

entries.explanation: Feeling shy or awkward about a social situation.

examples.hanzi: 大家突然表扬她，她有些难为情。
examples.pinyin: dà jiā tū rán biǎo yáng tā, tā yǒu xiē nán wéi qíng.
examples.english: She felt a little embarrassed when everyone suddenly praised her.

examples.hanzi: 弄错朋友的名字让他很难为情。
examples.pinyin: nòng cuò péng you de míng zi ràng tā hěn nán wéi qíng.
examples.english: Getting his friend's name wrong made him embarrassed.

entries.explanation: Feeling unable to handle a situation without support.

examples.hanzi: 第一次迷路时，他感到很无助。
examples.pinyin: dì yī cì mí lù shí, tā gǎn dào hěn wú zhù.
examples.english: He felt helpless when he got lost for the first time.

examples.hanzi: 朋友的陪伴减少了她的无助感。
examples.pinyin: péng you de péi bàn jiǎn shǎo le tā de wú zhù gǎn.
examples.english: Her friend's company reduced her feeling of helplessness.

entries.explanation: Lose confidence because of difficulties or setbacks.

examples.hanzi: 一次失败并没有让她灰心。
examples.pinyin: yí cì shī bài bìng méi yǒu ràng tā huī xīn.
examples.english: One failure did not make her lose heart.

examples.hanzi: 他有些灰心，但仍愿意再试。
examples.pinyin: tā yǒu xiē huī xīn, dàn réng yuàn yì zài shì.
examples.english: He feels discouraged but is still willing to try again.

entries.explanation: Feeling disappointed after a setback.

examples.hanzi: 计划取消后，她有些丧气。
examples.pinyin: jì huà qǔ xiāo hòu, tā yǒu xiē sàng qì.
examples.english: She felt downhearted after the plan was canceled.

examples.hanzi: 别一遇到困难就丧气。
examples.pinyin: bié yì yù dào kùn nan jiù sàng qì.
examples.english: Do not become discouraged at the first difficulty.

entries.explanation: Having a sad and reflective mood.

examples.hanzi: 这首歌的旋律有些忧郁。
examples.pinyin: zhè shǒu gē de xuán lǜ yǒu xiē yōu yù.
examples.english: The melody of this song is slightly melancholy.

examples.hanzi: 她望着窗外，神情忧郁。
examples.pinyin: tā wàng zhe chuāng wài, shén qíng yōu yù.
examples.english: She gazed out of the window with a melancholy expression.

entries.explanation: Feel concern about possible difficulties.

examples.hanzi: 父母对她独自旅行有些忧虑。
examples.pinyin: fù mǔ duì tā dú zì lǚ xíng yǒu xiē yōu lǜ.
examples.english: Her parents are concerned about her traveling alone.

examples.hanzi: 他把忧虑写在日记里。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ yōu lǜ xiě zài rì jì lǐ.
examples.english: He wrote his worries in his diary.

entries.explanation: Feeling sadness stirred by memories or parting.

examples.hanzi: 翻看旧照片时，她有些伤感。
examples.pinyin: fān kàn jiù zhào piàn shí, tā yǒu xiē shāng gǎn.
examples.english: She felt sentimental while looking through old photos.

examples.hanzi: 这首离别的歌让人伤感。
examples.pinyin: zhè shǒu lí bié de gē ràng rén shāng gǎn.
examples.english: This song about parting makes people feel sad.

entries.explanation: A bad circumstance or unhappy event.

examples.hanzi: 他把这次不幸当作重新开始的机会。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ zhè cì bú xìng dàng zuò chóng xīn kāi shǐ de jī huì.
examples.english: He treated this misfortune as a chance to start again.

examples.hanzi: 这个故事讲述了一个不幸的家庭。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge gù shi jiǎng shù le yí ge bú xìng de jiā tíng.
examples.english: This story tells of an unfortunate family.

entries.explanation: Reacting mainly through immediate feelings rather than steady judgment.

examples.hanzi: 她发现自己疲惫时容易情绪化。
examples.pinyin: tā fā xiàn zì jǐ pí bèi shí róng yì qíng xù huà.
examples.english: She notices that she becomes more emotional when tired.

examples.hanzi: 讨论重要事情时，他尽量不情绪化。
examples.pinyin: tǎo lùn zhòng yào shì qíng shí, tā jǐn liàng bù qíng xù huà.
examples.english: He tries not to react emotionally when discussing important matters.

entries.explanation: Easily affected by feelings or delicate matters.

examples.hanzi: 他对别人的批评很敏感。
examples.pinyin: tā duì bié ren de pī píng hěn mǐn gǎn.
examples.english: He is sensitive to criticism from others.

examples.hanzi: 这是一个敏感的话题，需要谨慎表达。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì yí ge mǐn gǎn de huà tí, xū yào jǐn shèn biǎo dá.
examples.english: This is a sensitive topic that needs careful wording.

entries.explanation: Lacking energy or interest.

examples.hanzi: 今天走了很久，她觉得浑身没劲。
examples.pinyin: jīn tiān zǒu le hěn jiǔ, tā jué de hún shēn méi jìn.
examples.english: After a long walk today, she feels exhausted.

examples.hanzi: 这个重复的游戏有点没劲。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge chóng fù de yóu xì yǒu diǎn méi jìn.
examples.english: This repetitive game is a little boring.

entries.explanation: Experience physical or emotional comfort.

examples.hanzi: 听到朋友的安慰后，我好受多了。
examples.pinyin: tīng dào péng you de ān wèi hòu, wǒ hǎo shòu duō le.
examples.english: I felt much better after my friend's comforting words.

examples.hanzi: 被误解的感觉并不好受。
examples.pinyin: bèi wù jiě de gǎn jué bìng bù hǎo shòu.
examples.english: Being misunderstood does not feel good.

entries.explanation: Get through a situation with less difficulty or discomfort.

examples.hanzi: 有人分担工作，日子就好过一些。
examples.pinyin: yǒu rén fēn dān gōng zuò, rì zi jiù hǎo guò yì xiē.
examples.english: Life is easier when someone shares the work.

chunks.gloss: share (a burden, a cost, a responsibility)

examples.hanzi: 经历离别以后，她并不好过。
examples.pinyin: jīng lì lí bié yǐ hòu, tā bìng bù hǎo guò.
examples.english: She has had a difficult time since the separation.

entries.explanation: Extremely sad because of a painful emotional experience.

examples.hanzi: 失去陪伴多年的宠物让她心碎。
examples.pinyin: shī qù péi bàn duō nián de chǒng wù ràng tā xīn suì.
examples.english: Losing her longtime pet left her heartbroken.

examples.hanzi: 这个离别的故事听得他心碎。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge lí bié de gù shi tīng de tā xīn suì.
examples.english: This story of parting broke his heart.

entries.explanation: Easily moved by pity or affection.

examples.hanzi: 看到孩子难过，她又心软了。
examples.pinyin: kàn dào hái zi nán guò, tā yòu xīn ruǎn le.
examples.english: She softened again when she saw the child upset.

examples.hanzi: 他心软，不忍拒绝朋友的请求。
examples.pinyin: tā xīn ruǎn, bù rěn jù jué péng you de qǐng qiú.
examples.english: He is softhearted and cannot bear to refuse his friend's request.

entries.explanation: Eager for something to happen without delay.

examples.hanzi: 等了很久，他开始心急。
examples.pinyin: děng le hěn jiǔ, tā kāi shǐ xīn jí.
examples.english: He became impatient after waiting a long time.

examples.hanzi: 题目难时不要心急，慢慢读。
examples.pinyin: tí mù nán shí bú yào xīn jí, màn màn dú.
examples.english: Do not rush when a problem is difficult; read it slowly.

entries.english: feel protective concern; feel sorry for
entries.explanation: Feel distress over someone's suffering or something valued.

examples.hanzi: 看见孩子受伤，妈妈很心疼。
examples.pinyin: kàn jiàn hái zi shòu shāng, mā ma hěn xīn téng.
examples.english: The mother felt distressed to see her child hurt.

chunks.gloss: feel protective concern; feel sorry for

examples.hanzi: 她心疼奶奶每天辛苦做饭。
examples.pinyin: tā xīn téng nǎi nai měi tiān xīn kǔ zuò fàn.
examples.english: She feels for her grandmother, who works hard cooking every day.

chunks.gloss: feel protective concern; feel sorry for

parts.gloss: feel protective concern; feel sorry for

entries.explanation: Loved and valued very much.

examples.hanzi: 她修好了心爱的旧玩具。
examples.pinyin: tā xiū hǎo le xīn ài de jiù wán jù.
examples.english: She repaired her cherished old toy.

examples.hanzi: 他把心爱的书送给了朋友。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ xīn ài de shū sòng gěi le péng you.
examples.english: He gave his beloved book to a friend.

entries.explanation: Feel positive affection or enjoyment toward something.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们喜爱这位耐心的老师。
examples.pinyin: hái zi men xǐ ài zhè wèi nài xīn de lǎo shī.
examples.english: The children are fond of this patient teacher.

examples.hanzi: 她喜爱安静的阅读环境。
examples.pinyin: tā xǐ ài ān jìng de yuè dú huán jìng.
examples.english: She likes a quiet reading environment.

parts.gloss: to love; to be fond of; to like

entries.explanation: The things or activities a person tends to enjoy.

examples.hanzi: 每个人的喜好都不同。
examples.pinyin: měi ge rén de xǐ hào dōu bù tóng.
examples.english: Everyone has different preferences.

examples.hanzi: 送礼前可以了解对方的喜好。
examples.pinyin: sòng lǐ qián kě yǐ liǎo jiě duì fāng de xǐ hào.
examples.english: Learn about the other person's preferences before choosing a gift.

entries.explanation: Feeling pleased at good news or success.

examples.hanzi: 看到进步，她感到欣喜。
examples.pinyin: kàn dào jìn bù, tā gǎn dào xīn xǐ.
examples.english: She felt delighted to see her progress.

examples.hanzi: 他的到来让家人十分欣喜。
examples.pinyin: tā de dào lái ràng jiā rén shí fēn xīn xǐ.
examples.english: His arrival delighted his family.

entries.explanation: Feeling glad or pleased.

examples.hanzi: 收到朋友的信，她满心欢喜。
examples.pinyin: shōu dào péng you de xìn, tā mǎn xīn huān xǐ.
examples.english: She was full of joy when she received her friend's letter.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们欢喜地迎接新老师。
examples.pinyin: hái zi men huān xǐ de yíng jiē xīn lǎo shī.
examples.english: The children happily welcomed the new teacher.

entries.explanation: Laugh with happiness.

examples.hanzi: 公园里传来孩子们的欢笑。
examples.pinyin: gōng yuán lǐ chuán lái hái zi men de huān xiào.
examples.english: The sound of children laughing joyfully came from the park.

examples.hanzi: 一家人围着桌子欢笑。
examples.pinyin: yì jiā rén wéi zhe zhuō zi huān xiào.
examples.english: The family laughed happily around the table.

entries.explanation: The sound produced when people laugh.

examples.hanzi: 教室里响起了笑声。
examples.pinyin: jiào shì lǐ xiǎng qǐ le xiào shēng.
examples.english: Laughter filled the classroom.

examples.hanzi: 远处的笑声让她也放松下来。
examples.pinyin: yuǎn chù de xiào shēng ràng tā yě fàng sōng xià lái.
examples.english: The laughter in the distance helped her relax too.

chunks.gloss: down; complement of completion or change

entries.explanation: Smile or laugh in a silly, unrestrained way.

examples.hanzi: 想到那件趣事，他忍不住傻笑。
examples.pinyin: xiǎng dào nà jiàn qù shì, tā rěn bu zhù shǎ xiào.
examples.english: He could not help grinning at the thought of that amusing incident.

examples.hanzi: 她看着旧照片，一个人傻笑。
examples.pinyin: tā kàn zhe jiù zhào piàn, yí gè rén shǎ xiào.
examples.english: She giggled to herself while looking at old photos.

entries.explanation: Begin to laugh at something.

examples.hanzi: 这个小故事让大家发笑。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge xiǎo gù shi ràng dà jiā fā xiào.
examples.english: This short story made everyone laugh.

examples.hanzi: 他尽量不发笑，认真听她说完。
examples.pinyin: tā jǐn liàng bù fā xiào, rèn zhēn tīng tā shuō wán.
examples.english: He tried not to laugh and listened seriously until she finished.

entries.explanation: Cause someone to laugh through something amusing.

examples.hanzi: 哥哥用一个故事逗笑了妹妹。
examples.pinyin: gē ge yòng yí ge gù shi dòu xiào le mèi mei.
examples.english: The older brother made his sister laugh with a story.

examples.hanzi: 这张有趣的照片把我逗笑了。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng yǒu qù de zhào piàn bǎ wǒ dòu xiào le.
examples.english: This amusing photo made me laugh.

entries.explanation: Entertain someone through humor or play.

examples.hanzi: 他做了个鬼脸，把孩子逗乐了。
examples.pinyin: tā zuò le ge guǐ liǎn, bǎ hái zi dòu lè le.
examples.english: He pulled a funny face and amused the child.

examples.hanzi: 这个节目常常把观众逗乐。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge jié mù cháng cháng bǎ guān zhòng dòu lè.
examples.english: This program often entertains the audience.

entries.explanation: Begin to show anger.

examples.hanzi: 他听到谎话后发怒了。
examples.pinyin: tā tīng dào huǎng huà hòu fā nù le.
examples.english: He became angry after hearing the lie.

examples.hanzi: 她没有发怒，而是先问清原因。
examples.pinyin: tā méi yǒu fā nù, ér shì xiān wèn qīng yuán yīn.
examples.english: She did not get angry and first asked what had happened.

entries.explanation: Feeling anger caused by an irritating problem.

examples.hanzi: 反复的噪声让她很恼怒。
examples.pinyin: fǎn fù de zào shēng ràng tā hěn nǎo nù.
examples.english: The repeated noise made her irritated.

examples.hanzi: 他压下恼怒，重新解释了一遍。
examples.pinyin: tā yā xià nǎo nù, chóng xīn jiě shì le yí biàn.
examples.english: He held back his annoyance and explained again.

entries.explanation: Cause another person to become irritated.

examples.hanzi: 他的玩笑惹恼了同桌。
examples.pinyin: tā de wán xiào rě nǎo le tóng zhuō.
examples.english: His joke annoyed his desk mate.

examples.hanzi: 不停打断别人容易惹恼对方。
examples.pinyin: bù tíng dǎ duàn bié ren róng yì rě nǎo duì fāng.
examples.english: Constantly interrupting someone can annoy them.

entries.explanation: Attentive to another person's needs.

examples.hanzi: 她准备热茶的举动很贴心。
examples.pinyin: tā zhǔn bèi rè chá de jǔ dòng hěn tiē xīn.
examples.english: It was thoughtful of her to prepare hot tea.

examples.hanzi: 这份贴心的提醒让我少走了弯路。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn tiē xīn de tí xǐng ràng wǒ shǎo zǒu le wān lù.
examples.english: This considerate reminder saved me unnecessary trouble.

entries.explanation: Give careful attention to an activity or person.

examples.hanzi: 她用心准备了这堂课。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng xīn zhǔn bèi le zhè táng kè.
examples.english: She put care into preparing this lesson.

examples.hanzi: 礼物不必昂贵，重要的是用心。
examples.pinyin: lǐ wù bú bì áng guì, zhòng yào de shì yòng xīn.
examples.english: A gift need not be expensive; what matters is the thought behind it.

entries.explanation: Real affection or sincere emotion.

examples.hanzi: 这封信表达了她的真情。
examples.pinyin: zhè fēng xìn biǎo dá le tā de zhēn qíng.
examples.english: This letter expresses her genuine feelings.

examples.hanzi: 真情不一定需要华丽的语言。
examples.pinyin: zhēn qíng bù yí dìng xū yào huá lì de yǔ yán.
examples.english: Genuine emotion does not require elaborate language.

entries.explanation: Strong and enduring affection.

examples.hanzi: 她深情地望着多年未见的家人。
examples.pinyin: tā shēn qíng de wàng zhe duō nián wèi jiàn de jiā rén.
examples.english: She looked with deep affection at relatives she had not seen for years.

chunks.gloss: 8th earthly branch: 1-3 p.m., 6th solar month (7th July-6th August), year of the Sheep

examples.hanzi: 这首歌表达了对家乡的深情。
examples.pinyin: zhè shǒu gē biǎo dá le duì jiā xiāng de shēn qíng.
examples.english: This song expresses deep affection for the singer's hometown.

examples.pinyin: zhè píng shí cù fàng zài chú fáng guì zi lǐ.
examples.english: This bottle of cooking vinegar is in the kitchen cupboard.

examples.pinyin: liáng bàn cài lǐ jiā le yì diǎn shí cù.
examples.english: A little vinegar was added to the cold dish.

entries.explanation: A fragrant oil made from sesame seeds and used as a seasoning.

examples.hanzi: 这碗面上滴了几滴香油。
examples.pinyin: zhè wǎn miàn shàng dī le jǐ dī xiāng yóu.
examples.english: A few drops of sesame oil were added to this bowl of noodles.

entries.explanation: An edible oil made from rapeseed.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈用菜油炒菜。
examples.pinyin: mā ma yòng cài yóu chǎo cài.
examples.english: Mom uses rapeseed oil to stir-fry vegetables.

examples.english: This bottle of rapeseed oil has just been opened.

entries.explanation: Oil intended for preparing food.

examples.hanzi: 食用油不要倒得太多。
examples.pinyin: shí yòng yóu bú yào dào de tài duō.
examples.english: Do not pour in too much cooking oil.

examples.pinyin: diàn lǐ yǒu bù tóng zhǒng lèi de shí yòng yóu.
examples.english: The shop has different kinds of cooking oil.

entries.explanation: An ingredient added to food to improve or change its taste.

examples.hanzi: 厨房里有盐和其他调料。
examples.pinyin: chú fáng lǐ yǒu yán hé qí tā tiáo liào.
examples.english: There is salt and other seasoning in the kitchen.

examples.pinyin: zhè dào cài bú yòng fàng hěn duō tiáo liào.
examples.english: This dish does not need much seasoning.

entries.explanation: A seasoning commonly used to add a savory taste to food.

examples.hanzi: 这包味精放在调料架上。
examples.pinyin: zhè bāo wèi jīng fàng zài tiáo liào jià shàng.
examples.english: This packet of monosodium glutamate is on the seasoning rack.

examples.pinyin: zhè dào tāng méi yǒu fàng wèi jīng.
examples.english: No monosodium glutamate was added to this soup.

examples.pinyin: tā wǎng tāng lǐ jiā le yì diǎn hú jiāo.
examples.english: He adds a little pepper to the soup.

examples.pinyin: zhè ge píng guǒ yǒu dàn dàn de tián wèi.
examples.english: This apple has a mild sweet taste.

examples.pinyin: zhuō shàng yǒu yì xiǎo dié xián cài.

examples.pinyin: yé ye hē zhōu shí xǐ huan pèi xián cài.
examples.english: Grandpa likes to have pickles with his congee.

entries.explanation: The fresh rootlike stem of ginger used in cooking.

examples.pinyin: tā bǎ shēng jiāng qiē chéng báo piàn.
examples.english: She cuts the fresh ginger into thin slices.

examples.pinyin: zhè dào yú lǐ fàng le yì diǎn shēng jiāng.
examples.english: A little fresh ginger was added to this fish dish.

entries.explanation: A bulb of garlic made up of separate cloves.

chunks.gloss: to pull apart with the hands

examples.pinyin: miàn bāo lǐ yǒu tián tián de hóng dòu.

examples.pinyin: tā bǎ jī xiōng qiē chéng báo piàn.

examples.english: Grandma cuts the Chinese yam into small pieces.
