examples.english: This doctor studies chronic diseases.

examples.hanzi: 社区举办了慢性病知识讲座。
examples.pinyin: shè qū jǔ bàn le màn xìng bìng zhī shi jiǎng zuò.
examples.english: The community held a talk about chronic diseases.

entries.explanation: An injury caused by an external force or accident.

examples.hanzi: 医生检查了他身上的外伤。
examples.pinyin: yī shēng jiǎn chá le tā shēn shang de wài shāng.
examples.english: The doctor examines the injuries on his body.

examples.hanzi: 护士先记录了外伤的位置。
examples.pinyin: hù shi xiān jì lù le wài shāng de wèi zhì.
examples.english: The nurse first records the location of the external injury.

entries.explanation: A box containing supplies used for immediate basic care.

examples.hanzi: 急救箱放在办公室里。
examples.pinyin: jí jiù xiāng fàng zài bàn gōng shì lǐ.
examples.english: The first-aid kit is in the office.

examples.hanzi: 她检查了急救箱里的用品。
examples.pinyin: tā jiǎn chá le jí jiù xiāng lǐ de yòng pǐn.
examples.english: She checks the supplies in the first-aid kit.

entries.explanation: A discolored area of skin caused by bleeding under the surface.

examples.hanzi: 她的膝盖上有一块瘀青。
examples.pinyin: tā de xī gài shang yǒu yí kuài yū qīng.
examples.english: There is a bruise on her knee.

examples.hanzi: 医生看了看他手臂上的瘀青。
examples.pinyin: yī shēng kàn le kan tā shǒu bì shàng de yū qīng.
examples.english: The doctor looks at the bruise on his arm.

entries.explanation: A common written form for a bruise or contusion.

examples.hanzi: 他的腿上出现了一块淤青。
examples.pinyin: tā de tuǐ shàng chū xiàn le yí kuài yū qīng.
examples.english: A bruise has appeared on his leg.

examples.hanzi: 这块淤青的颜色变淡了。
examples.pinyin: zhè kuài yū qīng de yán sè biàn dàn le.
examples.english: The color of this bruise has become lighter.

entries.explanation: Swelling caused by fluid accumulating in body tissues.

examples.hanzi: 医生检查了他的水肿。
examples.pinyin: yī shēng jiǎn chá le tā de shuǐ zhǒng.
examples.english: The doctor examines his edema.

examples.hanzi: 这份病历记录了水肿的位置。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn bìng lì jì lù le shuǐ zhǒng de wèi zhì.
examples.english: This medical record notes the location of the swelling from fluid.

entries.explanation: Reddened and swollen, often around an injury or irritation.

examples.hanzi: 他的手指有点红肿。
examples.pinyin: tā de shǒu zhǐ yǒu diǎn hóng zhǒng.
examples.english: His finger is a little red and swollen.

examples.hanzi: 医生看了看红肿的地方。
examples.pinyin: yī shēng kàn le kan hóng zhǒng de dì fang.
examples.english: The doctor examines the red and swollen area.

entries.explanation: To have blood flow out of the body.

examples.hanzi: 他的手指还在流血。
examples.pinyin: tā de shǒu zhǐ hái zài liú xuè.
examples.english: His finger is still bleeding.

examples.hanzi: 护士发现伤口开始流血。
examples.pinyin: hù shi fā xiàn shāng kǒu kāi shǐ liú xuè.
examples.english: The nurse notices that the wound has started bleeding.

entries.explanation: To have pain in the head in its literal sense.

examples.hanzi: 她今天头疼，想早点休息。
examples.pinyin: tā jīn tiān tóu téng, xiǎng zǎo diǎn xiū xi.
examples.english: She has a headache today and wants to rest early.

examples.hanzi: 他把头疼的情况告诉了医生。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ tóu téng de qíng kuàng gào su le yī shēng.
examples.english: He tells the doctor about his headache.

entries.explanation: Clothes worn for sleeping.

examples.hanzi: 他换上睡衣准备睡觉。
examples.pinyin: tā huàn shàng shuì yī zhǔn bèi shuì jiào.
examples.english: He puts on his pajamas and gets ready for bed.

examples.hanzi: 这套睡衣是棉布做的。
examples.pinyin: zhè tào shuì yī shì mián bù zuò de.
examples.english: These pajamas are made from cotton fabric.

entries.explanation: A padded bag in which a person can sleep.

examples.hanzi: 她把睡袋铺在帐篷里。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ shuì dài pū zài zhàng peng lǐ.
examples.english: She lays the sleeping bag inside the tent.

examples.hanzi: 这个睡袋很轻，方便携带。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge shuì dài hěn qīng, fāng biàn xié dài.
examples.english: This sleeping bag is light and easy to carry.

entries.explanation: Read a printed or displayed code with a scanner or phone.

examples.hanzi: 请扫码查看菜单。
examples.pinyin: qǐng sǎo mǎ chá kàn cài dān.
examples.english: Scan the code to see the menu.

examples.hanzi: 我扫码打开了储物柜。
examples.pinyin: wǒ sǎo mǎ dǎ kāi le chǔ wù guì.
examples.english: I scanned the code to open the locker.

entries.explanation: Make an electronic payment by scanning a payment code.

examples.hanzi: 这家店支持扫码支付。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn zhī chí sǎo mǎ zhī fù.
examples.english: This shop accepts payment by scanning a code.

examples.hanzi: 我扫码支付了停车费。
examples.pinyin: wǒ sǎo mǎ zhī fù le tíng chē fèi.
examples.english: I paid the parking fee by scanning a code.

entries.explanation: A square two-dimensional code that stores information.

examples.hanzi: 门票上的二维码已经过期。
examples.pinyin: mén piào shàng de èr wéi mǎ yǐ jīng guò qí.
examples.english: The QR code on the ticket has expired.

examples.hanzi: 请把二维码对准镜头。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ èr wéi mǎ duì zhǔn jìng tóu.
examples.english: Point the QR code at the camera.

entries.explanation: A printed pattern of bars read by a scanner.

examples.hanzi: 收银员扫了包装上的条形码。
examples.pinyin: shōu yín yuán sǎo le bāo zhuāng shàng de tiáo xíng mǎ.
examples.english: The cashier scanned the barcode on the package.

examples.hanzi: 这本书的条形码被磨掉了。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū de tiáo xíng mǎ bèi mó diào le.
examples.english: The barcode on this book has worn off.

entries.explanation: Pay money for goods, services or a bill.

examples.hanzi: 请先付款，再到门口取餐。
examples.pinyin: qǐng xiān fù kuǎn, zài dào mén kǒu qǔ cān.
examples.english: Pay first, then collect your food at the door.

examples.hanzi: 客户答应周五付款。
examples.pinyin: kè hù dā ying zhōu wǔ fù kuǎn.
examples.english: The customer agreed to pay on Friday.

entries.explanation: Accept money paid for goods or services.

examples.hanzi: 店主用手机收款。
examples.pinyin: diàn zhǔ yòng shǒu jī shōu kuǎn.
examples.english: The shopkeeper receives payments on a phone.

examples.hanzi: 收款后请给我一张收据。
examples.pinyin: shōu kuǎn hòu qǐng gěi wǒ yì zhāng shōu jù.
examples.english: Give me a receipt after receiving the payment.

entries.explanation: Return money already paid, or the money returned.

examples.hanzi: 店员同意给我退款。
examples.pinyin: diàn yuán tóng yì gěi wǒ tuì kuǎn.
examples.english: The clerk agreed to refund my payment.

examples.hanzi: 退款将在三天内到账。
examples.pinyin: tuì kuǎn jiāng zài sān tiān nèi dào zhàng.
examples.english: The refund will arrive within three days.

chunks.gloss: (of money) to arrive in an account

entries.explanation: Send or take purchased goods back to the seller.

examples.hanzi: 这双鞋太小，我想退货。
examples.pinyin: zhè shuāng xié tài xiǎo, wǒ xiǎng tuì huò.
examples.english: These shoes are too small; I want to return them.

examples.hanzi: 退货时需要保留包装。
examples.pinyin: tuì huò shí xū yào bǎo liú bāo zhuāng.
examples.english: Keep the packaging when returning goods.

entries.explanation: Replace purchased goods with another item from the seller.

examples.hanzi: 她拿着收据来换货。
examples.pinyin: tā ná zhe shōu jù lái huàn huò.
examples.english: She brought the receipt to exchange the item.

examples.hanzi: 商品拆封后不能换货。
examples.pinyin: shāng pǐn chāi fēng hòu bù néng huàn huò.
examples.english: The item cannot be exchanged once opened.

entries.explanation: Submit an order for goods or services.

examples.hanzi: 我昨晚下单买了一把伞。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zuó wǎn xià dān mǎi le yì bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: I ordered an umbrella last night.

examples.hanzi: 下单前请核对地址。
examples.pinyin: xià dān qián qǐng hé duì dì zhǐ.
examples.english: Check the address before placing the order.

entries.explanation: A recorded request to purchase goods or services.

examples.hanzi: 这笔订单还没有发货。
examples.pinyin: zhè bǐ dìng dān hái méi yǒu fā huò.
examples.english: This order has not been shipped yet.

examples.hanzi: 我把订单号发给了客服。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ dìng dān hào fā gěi le kè fú.
examples.english: I sent the order number to customer service.

entries.explanation: A cart for carrying purchases, or an online list of items to buy.

examples.hanzi: 购物车里放着牛奶和面包。
examples.pinyin: gòu wù chē lǐ fàng zhe niú nǎi hé miàn bāo.
examples.english: There is milk and bread in the shopping cart.

examples.hanzi: 我把这件衣服加入了购物车。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn yī fu jiā rù le gòu wù chē.
examples.english: I added this garment to my online cart.

entries.explanation: A bag used to carry purchased goods.

examples.hanzi: 她出门时带了一个购物袋。
examples.pinyin: tā chū mén shí dài le yí ge gòu wù dài.
examples.english: She took a shopping bag when she went out.

examples.hanzi: 这个购物袋可以重复使用。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge gòu wù dài kě yǐ chóng fù shǐ yòng.
examples.english: This shopping bag can be used again.

entries.explanation: A written record confirming that money has been received.

examples.hanzi: 交完房租后，房东给了我收据。
examples.pinyin: jiāo wán fáng zū hòu, fáng dōng gěi le wǒ shōu jù.
examples.english: The landlord gave me a receipt after I paid the rent.

chunks.gloss: rent for a room or house

examples.hanzi: 请保留这张收据作为凭证。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎo liú zhè zhāng shōu jù zuò wéi píng zhèng.
examples.english: Keep this receipt as proof.

entries.explanation: An invoice issued and stored in electronic form.

examples.hanzi: 电子发票已经发到我的邮箱。
examples.pinyin: diàn zǐ fā piào yǐ jīng fā dào wǒ de yóu xiāng.
examples.english: The electronic invoice has been sent to my email.

examples.hanzi: 报销时可以上传电子发票。
examples.pinyin: bào xiāo shí kě yǐ shàng chuán diàn zǐ fā piào.
examples.english: You can upload an electronic invoice for reimbursement.

entries.explanation: Prepare and issue an invoice for a transaction.

examples.hanzi: 请按公司的名称开票。
examples.pinyin: qǐng àn gōng sī de míng chēng kāi piào.
examples.english: Issue the invoice in the company's name.

examples.hanzi: 这家小店也能开票。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā xiǎo diàn yě néng kāi piào.
examples.english: This small shop can also issue invoices.

entries.explanation: Obtain or pay for a required ticket that was not bought earlier.

examples.hanzi: 他上车后去找乘务员补票。
examples.pinyin: tā shàng chē hòu qù zhǎo chéng wù yuán bǔ piào.
examples.english: He found the attendant to buy a ticket after boarding.

chunks.gloss: to get on; to get into a vehicle
(used after certain verbs to indicate detachment or separation)
attendant on an airplane, train, boat etc

examples.hanzi: 坐过了站，需要补票。
examples.pinyin: zuò guò le zhàn, xū yào bǔ piào.
examples.english: If you travel beyond your stop, you need to pay the extra fare.

entries.explanation: Purchase admission or a ticket for travel.

examples.hanzi: 我们提前买票去看演出。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men tí qián mǎi piào qù kàn yǎn chū.
examples.english: We bought tickets in advance for the performance.

examples.hanzi: 老人可以在窗口买票。
examples.pinyin: lǎo rén kě yǐ zài chuāng kǒu mǎi piào.
examples.english: Older passengers can buy tickets at the counter.

entries.explanation: Offer and sell tickets for travel or admission.

examples.hanzi: 音乐厅明天开始售票。
examples.pinyin: yīn yuè tīng míng tiān kāi shǐ shòu piào.
examples.english: The concert hall starts selling tickets tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 这个窗口只负责售票。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge chuāng kǒu zhī fù zé shòu piào.
examples.english: This counter only sells tickets.

entries.explanation: The amount charged for a ticket.

examples.hanzi: 儿童票价比成人票价低。
examples.pinyin: ér tóng piào jià bǐ chéng rén piào jià dī.
examples.english: Children's tickets cost less than adult tickets.

examples.hanzi: 节假日的票价没有变化。
examples.pinyin: jié jià rì de piào jià méi yǒu biàn huà.
examples.english: Ticket prices have not changed for the holidays.

entries.explanation: An urban railway system, often running underground.

examples.hanzi: 我每天坐地铁上班。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān.
examples.english: I take the subway to work every day.

examples.hanzi: 最后一班地铁已经开走了。
examples.pinyin: zuì hòu yì bān dì tiě yǐ jīng kāi zǒu le.
examples.english: The last subway train has already left.

entries.explanation: Public transport, commonly used to mean the city bus system.

examples.hanzi: 下雨天坐公交更方便。
examples.pinyin: xià yǔ tiān zuò gōng jiāo gèng fāng biàn.
examples.english: Taking public buses is more convenient on rainy days.

examples.hanzi: 这个小区附近的公交很少。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge xiǎo qū fù jìn de gōng jiāo hěn shǎo.
examples.english: There are few bus services near this residential area.

entries.explanation: A bus that carries passengers on a scheduled public route.

examples.hanzi: 公交车在路口停了下来。
examples.pinyin: gōng jiāo chē zài lù kǒu tíng le xià lái.
examples.english: The city bus stopped at the junction.

chunks.gloss: down; complement of completion or change

examples.hanzi: 这辆公交车能到医院。
examples.pinyin: zhè liàng gōng jiāo chē néng dào yī yuàn.
examples.english: This bus goes to the hospital.

entries.explanation: Continue a journey by changing to another service or vehicle.

examples.hanzi: 到市中心后转乘地铁。
examples.pinyin: dào shì zhōng xīn hòu zhuǎn chéng dì tiě.
examples.english: Transfer to the subway when you reach the city center.

examples.hanzi: 我们需要在下一站转乘。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men xū yào zài xià yí zhàn zhuǎn chéng.
examples.english: We need to change services at the next stop.

entries.explanation: Enter a railway station, or arrive at one in a train.

examples.hanzi: 进站前请准备好证件。
examples.pinyin: jìn zhàn qián qǐng zhǔn bèi hǎo zhèng jiàn.
examples.english: Have your identification ready before entering the station.

examples.hanzi: 列车正在缓慢进站。
examples.pinyin: liè chē zhèng zài huǎn màn jìn zhàn.
examples.english: The train is slowly pulling into the station.

entries.explanation: Exit a railway station or depart from it in a train.

examples.hanzi: 出站后向左走就是广场。
examples.pinyin: chū zhàn hòu xiàng zuǒ zǒu jiù shì guǎng chǎng.
examples.english: Turn left after leaving the station to reach the square.

examples.hanzi: 乘客需要刷卡出站。
examples.pinyin: chéng kè xū yào shuā kǎ chū zhàn.
examples.english: Passengers need to tap their cards to exit the station.

chunks.gloss: use a payment or access card

entries.explanation: A controlled gate that allows entry after a ticket or pass is checked.

examples.hanzi: 闸机前排着一队乘客。
examples.pinyin: zhá jī qián pái zhe yì duì chéng kè.
examples.english: A line of passengers is waiting at the ticket gate.

examples.hanzi: 他的车票没能打开闸机。
examples.pinyin: tā de chē piào méi néng dǎ kāi zhá jī.
examples.english: His ticket did not open the ticket gate.

chunks.gloss: ticket for a bus or train

entries.explanation: A ticket or pass valid for a month.

examples.hanzi: 经常坐车的人可以买月票。
examples.pinyin: jīng cháng zuò chē de rén kě yǐ mǎi yuè piào.
examples.english: Frequent travelers can buy a monthly pass.

chunks.gloss: take the car, bus, train etc

examples.hanzi: 我的月票月底到期。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de yuè piào yuè dǐ dào qī.
examples.english: My monthly pass expires at the end of the month.

entries.explanation: A ticket or pass valid for a year.

examples.hanzi: 这张年票可以用于多次入园。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng nián piào kě yǐ yòng yú duō cì rù yuán.
examples.english: This annual pass allows repeated entry to the park.

chunks.gloss: enter a park or other place for public recreation (typically, one whose name ends in : a zoo , amusement park etc)

examples.hanzi: 我为游泳馆续了年票。
examples.pinyin: wǒ wèi yóu yǒng guǎn xù le nián piào.
examples.english: I renewed my annual pass for the swimming pool.

entries.explanation: Travel in one direction without the return journey.

examples.hanzi: 这段路单程需要两个小时。
examples.pinyin: zhè duàn lù dān chéng xū yào liǎng gè xiǎo shí.
examples.english: This route takes two hours each way.

examples.hanzi: 他只订了单程机票。
examples.pinyin: tā zhī dìng le dān chéng jī piào.
examples.english: He booked only a one-way flight.

entries.explanation: Travel to a place and back again.

examples.hanzi: 我每天往返于学校和家之间。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān wǎng fǎn yú xué xiào hé jiā zhī jiān.
examples.english: I travel between school and home every day.

examples.hanzi: 往返车费一共六十元。
examples.pinyin: wǎng fǎn chē fèi yí gòng liù shí yuán.
examples.english: The round-trip fare is sixty yuan.

entries.explanation: A ticket covering a journey in one direction only.

examples.hanzi: 她买了一张单程票。
examples.pinyin: tā mǎi le yì zhāng dān chéng piào.
examples.english: She bought a one-way ticket.

examples.hanzi: 单程票只能使用一次。
examples.pinyin: dān chéng piào zhǐ néng shǐ yòng yí cì.
examples.english: A single-journey ticket can be used only once.

entries.explanation: A ticket covering travel to a destination and back.

examples.hanzi: 往返票比分开买两张票便宜。
examples.pinyin: wǎng fǎn piào bǐ fēn kāi mǎi liǎng zhāng piào pián yi.
examples.english: A round-trip ticket is cheaper than two separate tickets.

examples.hanzi: 这张往返票的回程日期能改。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng wǎng fǎn piào de huí chéng rì qī néng gǎi.
examples.english: The return date on this round-trip ticket can be changed.

entries.explanation: One ticket that covers several connected journeys or attractions.

examples.hanzi: 这张通票包括三个展馆。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng tōng piào bāo kuò sān gè zhǎn guǎn.
examples.english: This combined pass includes three exhibition halls.

examples.hanzi: 购买通票后不用分别买票。
examples.pinyin: gòu mǎi tōng piào hòu bú yòng fēn bié mǎi piào.
examples.english: You do not need separate tickets after buying the combined pass.

entries.explanation: A coupon that reduces the price of a purchase.

examples.hanzi: 这张优惠券下周到期。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng yōu huì quàn xià zhōu dào qī.
examples.english: This discount coupon expires next week.

examples.hanzi: 结账时别忘了使用优惠券。
examples.pinyin: jié zhàng shí bié wàng le shǐ yòng yōu huì quàn.
examples.english: Remember to use the discount coupon at checkout.

entries.explanation: A code entered to obtain a discount on a purchase.

examples.hanzi: 输入优惠码后，价格降了十元。
examples.pinyin: shū rù yōu huì mǎ hòu, jià gé jiàng le shí yuán.
examples.english: Entering the discount code reduced the price by ten yuan.

examples.hanzi: 这个优惠码只适用于新客户。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge yōu huì mǎ zhī kuò yòng yú xīn kè hù.
examples.english: This discount code applies only to new customers.

entries.explanation: Activities or special offers intended to increase sales.

examples.hanzi: 超市正在举行周末促销。
examples.pinyin: chāo shì zhèng zài jǔ xíng zhōu mò cù xiāo.
examples.english: The supermarket is running a weekend promotion.

examples.hanzi: 促销结束后就恢复原价。
examples.pinyin: cù xiāo jié shù hòu jiù huī fù yuán jià.
examples.english: The original price returns after the promotion ends.

entries.explanation: Reduce the selling price by a stated proportion.

examples.hanzi: 这件外套正在打折。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn wài tào zhèng zài dǎ zhé.
examples.english: This coat is on sale.

examples.hanzi: 会员买书可以打折。
examples.pinyin: huì yuán mǎi shū kě yǐ dǎ zhé.
examples.english: Members can get a discount on books.

entries.explanation: A reduction from the usual price.

examples.hanzi: 这家店给学生提供折扣。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn gěi xué sheng tí gōng zhé kòu.
examples.english: This shop offers students a discount.

examples.hanzi: 折扣只适用于指定商品。
examples.pinyin: zhé kòu zhī kuò yòng yú zhǐ dìng shāng pǐn.
examples.english: The discount applies only to selected items.

entries.explanation: The price before a discount or adjustment.

examples.hanzi: 标签上写着这件衣服的原价。
examples.pinyin: biāo qiān shàng xiě zhe zhè jiàn yī fu de yuán jià.
examples.english: The label shows the original price of this garment.

examples.hanzi: 活动结束后商品恢复原价。
examples.pinyin: huó dòng jié shù hòu shāng pǐn huī fù yuán jià.
examples.english: The goods return to their original price after the event.

entries.explanation: The price currently charged for an item.

examples.hanzi: 这台电脑的现价比去年低。
examples.pinyin: zhè tái diàn nǎo de xiàn jià bǐ qù nián dī.
examples.english: The current price of this computer is lower than last year's.

examples.hanzi: 牌子上标明了原价和现价。
examples.pinyin: pái zi shàng biāo míng liǎo yuán jià hé xiàn jià.
examples.english: The sign shows the original and current prices.

entries.explanation: The price displayed for an item, or the act of displaying it.

examples.hanzi: 这把椅子的标价是两百元。
examples.pinyin: zhè bǎ yǐ zi de biāo jià shì liǎng bǎi yuán.
examples.english: The marked price of this chair is two hundred yuan.

examples.hanzi: 店员正在给新商品标价。
examples.pinyin: diàn yuán zhèng zài gěi xīn shāng pǐn biāo jià.
examples.english: The clerk is putting prices on the new goods.

entries.explanation: The combined price of all items in a purchase.

examples.hanzi: 三件商品的总价是八十元。
examples.pinyin: sān jiàn shāng pǐn de zǒng jià shì bā shí yuán.
examples.english: The three items cost eighty yuan in total.

examples.hanzi: 运费没有计入总价。
examples.pinyin: yùn fèi méi yǒu jì rù zǒng jià.
examples.english: Shipping has not been included in the total price.

entries.explanation: The charge for transporting or delivering goods.

examples.hanzi: 退货的运费由商家承担。
examples.pinyin: tuì huò de yùn fèi yóu shāng jiā chéng dān.
examples.english: The seller pays the shipping charge for the return.

examples.hanzi: 偏远地区的运费更高。
examples.pinyin: piān yuǎn dì qū de yùn fèi gèng gāo.
examples.english: Shipping charges are higher for remote areas.

entries.explanation: Sell an item with the shipping charge included or waived.

examples.hanzi: 买两本书就能包邮。
examples.pinyin: mǎi liǎng běn shū jiù néng bāo yóu.
examples.english: Buying two books qualifies for free shipping.

examples.hanzi: 这件商品包邮送到家。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn shāng pǐn bāo yóu sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: This item includes free delivery to your home.

entries.explanation: A service that sends parcels quickly to recipients.

examples.hanzi: 我的快递放在楼下。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de kuài dì fàng zài lóu xià.
examples.english: My parcel delivery is downstairs.

examples.hanzi: 请用快递寄这份合同。
examples.pinyin: qǐng yòng kuài dì jì zhè fèn hé tóng.
examples.english: Send this contract by express delivery.

entries.explanation: Food prepared by a business for takeaway or delivery.

examples.hanzi: 加班时我们点了外卖。
examples.pinyin: jiā bān shí wǒ men diǎn le wài mài.
examples.english: We ordered food delivery while working late.

examples.hanzi: 这家餐馆只做外卖。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā cān guǎn zhī zuò wài mài.
examples.english: This restaurant only prepares food for takeaway and delivery.

entries.explanation: A worker who delivers express parcels.

examples.hanzi: 快递员打电话确认了地址。
examples.pinyin: kuài dì yuán dǎ diàn huà què rèn le dì zhǐ.
examples.english: The courier called to confirm the address.

examples.hanzi: 她向快递员出示了取件码。
examples.pinyin: tā xiàng kuài dì yuán chū shì le qǔ jiàn mǎ.
examples.english: She showed the courier the collection code.

entries.explanation: Send goods to their assigned destinations.

examples.hanzi: 生鲜食品每天早上配送。
examples.pinyin: shēng xiān shí pǐn měi tiān zǎo shang pèi sòng.
examples.english: Fresh food is delivered every morning.

chunks.gloss: fresh produce and freshly prepared foods

examples.hanzi: 商家不向这个区域配送。
examples.pinyin: shāng jiā bú xiàng zhè ge qū yù pèi sòng.
examples.english: The seller does not deliver to this area.

entries.explanation: A worker who delivers ordered goods or meals.

examples.hanzi: 配送员把餐点送到了前台。
examples.pinyin: pèi sòng yuán bǎ cān diǎn sòng dào le qián tái.
examples.english: The delivery worker left the meal at reception.

examples.hanzi: 下雨时配送员仍在工作。
examples.pinyin: xià yǔ shí pèi sòng yuán réng zài gōng zuò.
examples.english: Delivery workers are still working in the rain.

entries.explanation: Pick up a parcel or another item held for collection.

examples.hanzi: 取件时请带上手机。
examples.pinyin: qǔ jiàn shí qǐng dài shàng shǒu jī.
examples.english: Bring your phone when collecting the parcel.

examples.hanzi: 我下班后去楼下取件。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xià bān hòu qù lóu xià qǔ jiàn.
examples.english: I collect my parcel downstairs after work.

chunks.gloss: (used after certain verbs to indicate detachment or separation)

entries.explanation: Hand over a parcel or document for delivery.

examples.hanzi: 寄件前要填写收件人的地址。
examples.pinyin: jì jiàn qián yào tián xiě shōu jiàn rén de dì zhǐ.
examples.english: Fill in the recipient's address before sending the parcel.

examples.hanzi: 附近的便利店可以寄件。
examples.pinyin: fù jìn de biàn lì diàn kě yǐ jì jiàn.
examples.english: You can send parcels at the nearby convenience store.

entries.explanation: Accept an item sent by post or courier.

examples.hanzi: 前台可以代替住客收件。
examples.pinyin: qián tái kě yǐ dài tì zhù kè shōu jiàn.
examples.english: Reception can receive parcels for guests.

examples.hanzi: 收件时请检查包装是否完整。
examples.pinyin: shōu jiàn shí qǐng jiǎn chá bāo zhuāng shì fǒu wán zhěng.
examples.english: Check that the packaging is intact when receiving the parcel.

entries.explanation: Send an item to someone using a postal or delivery service.

examples.hanzi: 学校会寄送录取通知书。
examples.pinyin: xué xiào huì jì sòng lù qǔ tōng zhī shū.
examples.english: The school will send the admission letter by post.

examples.hanzi: 我给朋友寄送了一份礼物。
examples.pinyin: wǒ gěi péng you jì sòng le yì fèn lǐ wù.
examples.english: I sent a gift to my friend.

parts.gloss: to send by post; to mail
to send; to deliver; to transmit

entries.explanation: Confirm receipt of a delivered item, usually with a signature.

examples.hanzi: 包裹由门卫签收了。
examples.pinyin: bāo guǒ yóu mén wèi qiān shōu le.
examples.english: The security guard signed for the parcel.

examples.hanzi: 签收之前请检查货物。
examples.pinyin: qiān shōu zhī qián qǐng jiǎn chá huò wù.
examples.english: Check the goods before signing for them.

entries.explanation: Pick up an order personally rather than having it delivered.

examples.hanzi: 这张桌子只能到店自提。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi zhǐ néng dào diàn zì tí.
examples.english: This table is available for collection at the shop only.

examples.hanzi: 我选择了明天下午自提。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xuǎn zé le míng tiān xià wǔ zì tí.
examples.english: I chose to collect my order tomorrow afternoon.

entries.explanation: Take delivery of goods from the place where they are held.

examples.hanzi: 司机带着单据来仓库提货。
examples.pinyin: sī jī dài zhe dān jù lái cāng kù tí huò.
examples.english: The driver brought the documents to collect goods from the warehouse.

examples.hanzi: 付款后可以凭收据提货。
examples.pinyin: fù kuǎn hòu kě yǐ píng shōu jù tí huò.
examples.english: After paying, you can collect the goods with your receipt.

entries.explanation: A code used to identify an order when collecting goods.

examples.hanzi: 提货码已经发到你的手机。
examples.pinyin: tí huò mǎ yǐ jīng fā dào nǐ de shǒu jī.
examples.english: The goods collection code has been sent to your phone.

examples.hanzi: 店员核对提货码后交出了商品。
examples.pinyin: diàn yuán hé duì tí huò mǎ hòu jiāo chū le shāng pǐn.
examples.english: The clerk handed over the goods after checking the collection code.

entries.explanation: A code needed to collect a parcel from a locker or collection point.

examples.hanzi: 我不小心删除了取件码。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎo xīn shān chú le qǔ jiàn mǎ.
examples.english: I accidentally deleted the parcel collection code.

examples.hanzi: 输入取件码后，柜门打开了。
examples.pinyin: shū rù qǔ jiàn mǎ hòu, guì mén dǎ kāi le.
examples.english: The locker opened after I entered the collection code.

entries.explanation: Pick up food that has been prepared for an order.

examples.hanzi: 请到左边的窗口取餐。
examples.pinyin: qǐng dào zuǒ bian de chuāng kǒu qǔ cān.
examples.english: Collect your meal at the window on the left.

examples.hanzi: 我的取餐时间是十二点。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de qǔ cān shí jiān shì shí èr diǎn.
examples.english: My meal collection time is noon.

entries.explanation: A container used to hold or pack a meal.

examples.hanzi: 请把空餐盒放进垃圾桶。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ kōng cān hé fàng jìn lā jī tǒng.
examples.english: Put the empty food container in the bin.

examples.hanzi: 这个餐盒可以放进微波炉。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge cān hé kě yǐ fàng jìn wēi bō lú.
examples.english: This food container can go in the microwave.

entries.explanation: Bring prepared meals to customers or other recipients.

examples.hanzi: 餐厅每天给老人送餐。
examples.pinyin: cān tīng měi tiān gěi lǎo rén sòng cān.
examples.english: The restaurant delivers meals to older people every day.

examples.hanzi: 送餐途中汤洒了出来。
examples.pinyin: sòng cān tú zhōng tāng sǎ le chū lái.
examples.english: The soup spilled during the meal delivery.

parts.gloss: to send; to deliver; to transmit

entries.explanation: Give a request or item urgent treatment to finish it sooner.

examples.hanzi: 这份文件需要加急处理。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn wén jiàn xū yào jiā jí chǔ lǐ.
examples.english: This document needs urgent processing.

examples.hanzi: 加急服务要另外收费。
examples.pinyin: jiā jí fú wù yào lìng wài shōu fèi.
examples.english: Expedited service costs extra.

entries.explanation: Arrange a time in advance for a service or visit.

examples.hanzi: 看展览需要提前预约。
examples.pinyin: kàn zhǎn lǎn xū yào tí qián yù yuē.
examples.english: You need to reserve a visit to the exhibition in advance.

examples.hanzi: 我取消了明天的预约。
examples.pinyin: wǒ qǔ xiāo le míng tiān de yù yuē.
examples.english: I canceled tomorrow's appointment.

entries.explanation: A number identifying a reservation or appointment.

examples.hanzi: 请告诉我你的预约号。
examples.pinyin: qǐng gào su wǒ nǐ de yù yuē hào.
examples.english: Tell me your appointment number.

examples.hanzi: 护士根据预约号找到了记录。
examples.pinyin: hù shi gēn jù yù yuē hào zhǎo dào le jì lù.
examples.english: The nurse found the record using the appointment number.

entries.explanation: The fee charged when registering to see a doctor.

examples.hanzi: 挂号费可以用银行卡支付。
examples.pinyin: guà hào fèi kě yǐ yòng yín háng kǎ zhī fù.
examples.english: You can pay the medical registration fee by bank card.

examples.hanzi: 这张收据上列出了挂号费。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng shōu jù shàng liè chū le guà hào fèi.
examples.english: The medical registration fee is listed on this receipt.

entries.explanation: Go to a medical professional for assessment or treatment.

examples.hanzi: 就诊时请带上以前的报告。
examples.pinyin: jiù zhěn shí qǐng dài shàng yǐ qián de bào gào.
examples.english: Bring your earlier reports when seeing the doctor.

examples.hanzi: 她陪父亲去医院就诊。
examples.pinyin: tā péi fù qīn qù yī yuàn jiù zhěn.
examples.english: She accompanied her father to the hospital for medical care.

entries.explanation: Wait for one's turn to receive a medical consultation.

examples.hanzi: 请在走廊里候诊。
examples.pinyin: qǐng zài zǒu láng lǐ hòu zhěn.
examples.english: Wait in the corridor to see the doctor.

examples.hanzi: 候诊的人已经坐满了椅子。
examples.pinyin: hòu zhěn de rén yǐ jīng zuò mǎn le yǐ zi.
examples.english: The chairs are full of people waiting to see a doctor.

examples.hanzi: 医生让她两周后复诊。
examples.pinyin: yī shēng ràng tā liǎng zhōu hòu fù zhěn.
examples.english: The doctor asked her to return in two weeks.

examples.hanzi: 复诊时需要带上病历。
examples.pinyin: fù zhěn shí xū yào dài shàng bìng lì.
examples.english: Bring your medical record to the follow-up consultation.

entries.explanation: Send a patient to another clinician or medical institution.

examples.hanzi: 医生安排他转诊到另一家医院。
examples.pinyin: yī shēng ān pái tā zhuǎn zhěn dào lìng yì jiā yī yuàn.
examples.english: The doctor arranged a referral to another hospital.

examples.hanzi: 转诊之前需要准备相关材料。
examples.pinyin: zhuǎn zhěn zhī qián xū yào zhǔn bèi xiāng guān cái liào.
examples.english: Prepare the relevant documents before the referral.

entries.explanation: The supply of registration or appointment slots that can be booked.

examples.hanzi: 明天上午的号源已经用完了。
examples.pinyin: míng tiān shàng wǔ de hào yuán yǐ jīng yòng wán le.
examples.english: All tomorrow morning's appointment slots have been booked.

examples.hanzi: 医院每周公布新的号源。
examples.pinyin: yī yuàn měi zhōu gōng bù xīn de hào yuán.
examples.english: The hospital releases new appointment slots each week.

entries.explanation: Call out or display numbers to summon people in a queue.

examples.hanzi: 大厅用屏幕叫号。
examples.pinyin: dà tīng yòng píng mù jiào hào.
examples.english: The hall displays queue numbers on a screen.

examples.hanzi: 请留意叫号，不要错过。
examples.pinyin: qǐng liú yì jiào hào, bú yào cuò guò.
examples.english: Pay attention to the queue calls so you do not miss yours.

entries.english: take a place in a numbered queue
entries.explanation: Obtain a number that determines one's turn for a service.

examples.hanzi: 我们先到前台排号。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men xiān dào qián tái pái hào.
examples.english: We first got a queue number at reception.

chunks.gloss: take a place in a numbered queue

examples.hanzi: 这家餐馆周末需要排号。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā cān guǎn zhōu mò xū yào pái hào.
examples.english: This restaurant uses a numbered waiting list on weekends.

chunks.gloss: take a place in a numbered queue

parts.gloss: take a place in a numbered queue

entries.explanation: Wait in an ordered line for a turn.

examples.hanzi: 大家在售票窗口前排队。
examples.pinyin: dà jiā zài shòu piào chuāng kǒu qián pái duì.
examples.english: Everyone is lining up at the ticket counter.

examples.hanzi: 排队的人一直等到门口。
examples.pinyin: pái duì de rén yì zhí děng dào mén kǒu.
examples.english: The queue stretched all the way to the door.

entries.explanation: Carry out work or deal with practical affairs.

examples.hanzi: 他今天去银行办事。
examples.pinyin: tā jīn tiān qù yín háng bàn shì.
examples.english: He went to the bank to handle some business today.

examples.hanzi: 这位工作人员办事很认真。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi gōng zuò rén yuán bàn shì hěn rèn zhēn.
examples.english: This staff member handles matters carefully.

parts.gloss: to take care of (a matter); to deal with (a task, procedure etc); to organize (an event)

entries.explanation: Arrange the issue of an official document or certificate.

examples.hanzi: 办证需要两张照片。
examples.pinyin: bàn zhèng xū yào liǎng zhāng zhào piàn.
examples.english: Applying for the document requires two photographs.

examples.hanzi: 大厅周六也能办证。
examples.pinyin: dà tīng zhōu liù yě néng bàn zhèng.
examples.english: The hall also processes certificates on Saturdays.

entries.explanation: An official document proving identity or another recognized status.

examples.hanzi: 进入考场前要检查证件。
examples.pinyin: jìn rù kǎo chǎng qián yào jiǎn chá zhèng jiàn.
examples.english: Identification is checked before entering the exam room.

examples.hanzi: 他把证件放在内侧口袋里。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ zhèng jiàn fàng zài nèi cè kǒu dài lǐ.
examples.english: He put his identification documents in an inner pocket.

entries.explanation: An official card that verifies a person's identity.

examples.hanzi: 她在柜台出示了身份证。
examples.pinyin: tā zài guì tái chū shì le shēn fèn zhèng.
examples.english: She showed her identity card at the counter.

examples.hanzi: 我的身份证快要到期了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de shēn fèn zhèng kuài yào dào qī le.
examples.english: My identity card will expire soon.

entries.explanation: An official document used to identify a traveler internationally.

examples.hanzi: 请检查护照上的姓名。
examples.pinyin: qǐng jiǎn chá hù zhào shàng de xìng míng.
examples.english: Check the name in the passport.

examples.hanzi: 他的护照丢在酒店了。
examples.pinyin: tā de hù zhào diū zài jiǔ diàn le.
examples.english: He left his passport at the hotel.

entries.explanation: An official document confirming residence in a place.

examples.hanzi: 申请居住证需要准备哪些材料？
examples.pinyin: shēn qǐng jū zhù zhèng xū yào zhǔn bèi nǎ xiē cái liào?
examples.english: What documents are needed to apply for a residence permit?

examples.hanzi: 她到窗口领取了居住证。
examples.pinyin: tā dào chuāng kǒu lǐng qǔ le jū zhù zhèng.
examples.english: She collected her residence permit at the counter.

entries.explanation: A common short form for the document permitting someone to drive.

examples.hanzi: 他上个月拿到了驾照。
examples.pinyin: tā shàng gè yuè ná dào le jià zhào.
examples.english: He got his driving license last month.

examples.hanzi: 租车时需要出示驾照。
examples.pinyin: zū chē shí xū yào chū shì jià zhào.
examples.english: You need to show your driving license when renting a car.

entries.explanation: An official document permitting a person to drive specified vehicles.

examples.hanzi: 他的驾驶证需要更新照片。
examples.pinyin: tā de jià shǐ zhèng xū yào gēng xīn zhào piàn.
examples.english: His driver's license needs an updated photograph.

examples.hanzi: 请把驾驶证带在身上。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ jià shǐ zhèng dài zài shēn shang.
examples.english: Keep your driver's license with you.

entries.explanation: A plate displaying a vehicle's registration number.

examples.pinyin: jiān kòng pāi dào liǎo zhè liàng chē de chē pái.
examples.english: The camera recorded this vehicle's license plate.

examples.hanzi: 车牌上的泥需要擦掉。
examples.pinyin: chē pái shàng de ní xū yào cā diào.
examples.english: The mud on the license plate needs to be wiped off.

entries.explanation: A plate or tag displaying an assigned identifying number.

examples.hanzi: 这辆新车还没有安装号牌。
examples.pinyin: zhè liàng xīn chē hái méi yǒu ān zhuāng hào pái.
examples.english: This new vehicle does not have its number plates installed yet.

entries.explanation: A counter dedicated to a particular brand or product type.

examples.pinyin: tā zài huà zhuāng pǐn zhuān guì gōng zuò.
examples.english: She works at a cosmetics counter.

examples.hanzi: 商场新开了一个手表专柜。
examples.pinyin: shāng chǎng xīn kāi le yí ge shǒu biǎo zhuān guì.
examples.english: The mall has opened a new watch counter.

entries.explanation: Divide an action or payment into successive stages.

examples.hanzi: 这笔费用可以分期支付。
examples.pinyin: zhè bǐ fèi yòng kě yǐ fēn qī zhī fù.
examples.english: This fee can be paid in installments.

examples.hanzi: 工程将分期完成。
examples.pinyin: gōng chéng jiāng fēn qī wán chéng.
examples.english: The project will be completed in stages.

entries.explanation: Wait for a bus, train or another vehicle.

examples.hanzi: 旅客在大厅候车。
examples.pinyin: lǚ kè zài dà tīng hòu chē.
examples.english: Passengers are waiting in the hall.

examples.hanzi: 候车时请远离车道。
examples.pinyin: hòu chē shí qǐng yuǎn lí chē dào.
examples.english: Stay away from the roadway while waiting for transport.

entries.explanation: Continue a journey by changing buses or trains.

examples.hanzi: 到医院需要转车。
examples.pinyin: dào yī yuàn xū yào zhuǎn chē.
examples.english: You need to change services to reach the hospital.

examples.hanzi: 我们在市中心转车。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men zài shì zhōng xīn zhuǎn chē.
examples.english: We change vehicles in the city center.

entries.explanation: The charge for sending an item by post.

examples.hanzi: 邮费已经包含在价格里。
examples.pinyin: yóu fèi yǐ jīng bāo hán zài jià gé lǐ.
examples.english: Postage is already included in the price.

examples.hanzi: 寄往国外的邮费更高。
examples.pinyin: jì wǎng guó wài de yóu fèi gèng gāo.
examples.english: Postage abroad is more expensive.

entries.explanation: The price charged for one unit of an item.

examples.hanzi: 这袋米的单价写在标签上。
examples.pinyin: zhè dài mǐ de dān jià xiě zài biāo qiān shàng.
examples.english: The unit price of this rice is on the label.

examples.hanzi: 买得多时单价会降低。
examples.pinyin: mǎi de duō shí dān jià huì jiàng dī.
examples.english: The unit price falls when you buy more.

entries.explanation: Goods available for immediate sale or delivery.

examples.hanzi: 这款手机还有现货。
examples.pinyin: zhè kuǎn shǒu jī hái yǒu xiàn huò.
examples.english: This phone model is still in stock.

examples.hanzi: 现货可以当天发出。
examples.pinyin: xiàn huò kě yǐ dàng tiān fā chū.
examples.english: Goods in stock can be dispatched the same day.

entries.explanation: Extend an existing agreement or authorization by renewing it.

examples.hanzi: 她准备续签租房合同。
examples.pinyin: tā zhǔn bèi xù qiān zū fáng hé tóng.
examples.english: She is preparing to renew her rental contract.

examples.hanzi: 签证续签需要新的照片。
examples.pinyin: qiān zhèng xù qiān xū yào xīn de zhào piàn.
examples.english: Visa renewal requires new photographs.

entries.explanation: The count of individual pieces or items.

examples.hanzi: 请核对行李的件数。
examples.pinyin: qǐng hé duì xíng li de jiàn shù.
examples.english: Check the number of pieces of luggage.

examples.hanzi: 件数不符时要联系仓库。
examples.pinyin: jiàn shù bù fú shí yào lián xì cāng kù.
examples.english: Contact the warehouse if the item count does not match.

entries.explanation: A card that pays directly from available account funds.

examples.hanzi: 她用借记卡买了车票。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng jiè jì kǎ mǎi le chē piào.
examples.english: She bought the ticket with a debit card.

chunks.gloss: ticket for a bus or train

examples.hanzi: 这张借记卡不能透支。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng jiè jì kǎ bù néng tòu zhī.
examples.english: This debit card does not allow an overdraft.

entries.english: use a payment or access card
entries.explanation: Read a card electronically for payment or access.

examples.hanzi: 进门需要刷卡。
examples.pinyin: jìn mén xū yào shuā kǎ.
examples.english: You need to use your card to enter.

chunks.gloss: use a payment or access card

examples.hanzi: 我刷卡买了午饭。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shuā kǎ mǎi le wǔ fàn.
examples.english: I paid for lunch with my card.

chunks.gloss: use a payment or access card

parts.gloss: use a payment or access card

entries.explanation: Take money from a bank account.

examples.hanzi: 他到银行取钱。
examples.pinyin: tā dào yín háng qǔ qián.
examples.english: He went to the bank to withdraw money.

examples.hanzi: 取钱以后请收好银行卡。
examples.pinyin: qǔ qián yǐ hòu qǐng shōu hǎo yín háng kǎ.
examples.english: Put your bank card away after withdrawing money.

entries.explanation: Support provided after a product is sold.

examples.hanzi: 她联系售后申请维修。
examples.pinyin: tā lián xì shòu hòu shēn qǐng wéi xiū.
examples.english: She contacted after-sales support for a repair.

examples.hanzi: 这家公司的售后服务很好。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī de shòu hòu fú wù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This company provides good after-sales service.

entries.explanation: Put money aside or place it in an account.

examples.hanzi: 我每月存钱买书。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měi yuè cún qián mǎi shū.
examples.english: I save money every month to buy books.

examples.hanzi: 她去银行存钱了。
examples.pinyin: tā qù yín háng cún qián le.
examples.english: She went to deposit money at the bank.

entries.explanation: A small printed receipt recording a purchase.

examples.hanzi: 请把购物小票给我。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ gòu wù xiǎo piào gěi wǒ.
examples.english: Give me the purchase receipt.

examples.hanzi: 小票上的金额不对。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo piào shàng de jīn é bú duì.
examples.english: The amount on the receipt is wrong.

entries.explanation: A card used to unlock a hotel room.

examples.hanzi: 我的房卡打不开门。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de fáng kǎ dǎ bù kāi mén.
examples.english: My room card will not open the door.

examples.hanzi: 退房时请归还房卡。
examples.pinyin: tuì fáng shí qǐng guī huán fáng kǎ.
examples.english: Return the room card at checkout.

chunks.gloss: check out of a hotel room

entries.explanation: Accept goods that have been delivered.

examples.hanzi: 她在家等着收货。
examples.pinyin: tā zài jiā děng zhe shōu huò.
examples.english: She is waiting at home for the delivery.

examples.hanzi: 收货地址需要修改。
examples.pinyin: shōu huò dì zhǐ xū yào xiū gǎi.
examples.english: The delivery address needs changing.

entries.explanation: Have no remaining stock of a product.

examples.hanzi: 这种牛奶已经断货。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng niú nǎi yǐ jīng duàn huò.
examples.english: This milk is out of stock.

examples.hanzi: 商家说断货后要等一周。
examples.pinyin: shāng jiā shuō duàn huò hòu yào děng yì zhōu.
examples.english: The seller said to wait a week after stocks ran out.

entries.explanation: Examine tickets before allowing entry or travel.

examples.hanzi: 列车开始检票了。
examples.pinyin: liè chē kāi shǐ jiǎn piào le.
examples.english: Ticket checks for the train have begun.

examples.hanzi: 检票员站在入口处。
examples.pinyin: jiǎn piào yuán zhàn zài rù kǒu chù.
examples.english: The ticket inspector is at the entrance.

entries.explanation: A person who pays to use rented property.

examples.hanzi: 新租客明天搬进来。
examples.pinyin: xīn zū kè míng tiān bān jìn lái.
examples.english: The new tenant moves in tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 房东把通知发给了租客。
examples.pinyin: fáng dōng bǎ tōng zhī fā gěi le zū kè.
examples.english: The landlord sent the notice to the tenant.

entries.explanation: Pay to extend a subscription or service period.

examples.hanzi: 会员下个月需要续费。
examples.pinyin: huì yuán xià gè yuè xū yào xù fèi.
examples.english: The membership needs renewing next month.

examples.hanzi: 不续费就无法继续使用。
examples.pinyin: bú xù fèi jiù wú fǎ jì xù shǐ yòng.
examples.english: You cannot keep using it without renewing payment.

entries.explanation: A passenger car booked through an online platform.

examples.hanzi: 我叫了一辆网约车。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiào le yì liàng wǎng yuē chē.
examples.english: I booked a car through an app.

examples.hanzi: 网约车停在门口。
examples.pinyin: wǎng yuē chē tíng zài mén kǒu.
examples.english: The app-booked car is outside the door.

entries.explanation: Replenish goods that have sold or run low.

examples.hanzi: 店员正在给货架补货。
examples.pinyin: diàn yuán zhèng zài gěi huò jià bǔ huò.
examples.english: The clerk is restocking the shelves.

examples.hanzi: 这款鞋周五补货。
examples.pinyin: zhè kuǎn xié zhōu wǔ bǔ huò.
examples.english: This shoe model will be restocked on Friday.

entries.explanation: Book a room for a future stay.

examples.hanzi: 出发前先订房。
examples.pinyin: chū fā qián xiān dìng fáng.
examples.english: Book your accommodation before departure.

examples.hanzi: 她打电话给酒店订房。
examples.pinyin: tā dǎ diàn huà gěi jiǔ diàn dìng fáng.
examples.english: She called the hotel to reserve a room.

entries.explanation: End a stay and return a rented room.

examples.hanzi: 我们中午退房。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men zhōng wǔ tuì fáng.
examples.english: We check out at noon.

examples.hanzi: 退房前请检查抽屉。
examples.pinyin: tuì fáng qián qǐng jiǎn chá chōu ti.
examples.english: Check the drawers before checking out.

entries.explanation: A card issued by a bank for account access or payments.

examples.hanzi: 我的银行卡找不到了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de yín háng kǎ zhǎo bú dào le.
examples.english: I cannot find my bank card.

examples.hanzi: 他用银行卡支付车费。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng yín háng kǎ zhī fù chē fèi.
examples.english: He paid the fare by bank card.

entries.explanation: Ride in or on a vehicle.

examples.hanzi: 我们乘坐火车去海边。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men chéng zuò huǒ chē qù hǎi biān.
examples.english: We travel to the coast by train.

examples.hanzi: 老人免费乘坐这班车。
examples.pinyin: lǎo rén miǎn fèi chéng zuò zhè bān chē.
examples.english: Older passengers ride this service free.

entries.explanation: An established transport route or electrical connection.

examples.hanzi: 这条公交线路经过学校。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo gōng jiāo xiàn lù jīng guò xué xiào.
examples.english: This bus route passes the school.

examples.hanzi: 电工检查了照明线路。
examples.pinyin: diàn gōng jiǎn chá le zhào míng xiàn lù.
examples.english: The electrician checked the lighting circuit.

entries.explanation: A road used by vehicles and pedestrians.

examples.hanzi: 过马路时要看信号灯。
examples.pinyin: guò mǎ lù shí yào kàn xìn hào dēng.
examples.english: Watch the traffic lights when crossing the road.

examples.hanzi: 马路对面有一家书店。
examples.pinyin: mǎ lù duì miàn yǒu yì jiā shū diàn.
examples.english: There is a bookstore across the road.

entries.explanation: A large building or area containing shops.

examples.hanzi: 商场里有很多餐厅。
examples.pinyin: shāng chǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō cān tīng.
examples.english: There are many restaurants in the mall.

examples.hanzi: 这家商场晚上十点关闭。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā shāng chǎng wǎn shang shí diǎn guān bì.
examples.english: This mall closes at ten at night.

entries.explanation: A public bus or a vehicle provided for official work.

examples.hanzi: 她每天搭公车上学。
examples.pinyin: tā měi tiān dā gōng chē shàng xué.
examples.english: She takes a bus to school every day.

examples.hanzi: 这辆公车只用于公务。
examples.pinyin: zhè liàng gōng chē zhī yòng yú gōng wù.
examples.english: This official vehicle is used only for official work.

entries.explanation: An area of a city bounded by streets.

examples.hanzi: 这个街区有很多老店。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge jiē qū yǒu hěn duō lǎo diàn.
examples.english: This neighborhood has many old shops.

examples.hanzi: 整片街区正在修路。
examples.pinyin: zhěng piàn jiē qū zhèng zài xiū lù.
examples.english: Road work is underway throughout the neighborhood.

entries.explanation: Items or services sold together as a package.

examples.hanzi: 我点了一份午餐套餐。
examples.pinyin: wǒ diǎn le yì fèn wǔ cān tào cān.
examples.english: I ordered a lunch set.

examples.hanzi: 这个手机套餐包含流量。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge shǒu jī tào cān bāo hán liú liàng.
examples.english: This phone package includes data.

entries.explanation: Professional work or services provided by an organization.

examples.hanzi: 银行下午暂停这项业务。
examples.pinyin: yín háng xià wǔ zàn tíng zhè xiàng yè wù.
examples.english: The bank suspends this service in the afternoon.

examples.hanzi: 她正在学习新的业务流程。
examples.pinyin: tā zhèng zài xué xí xīn de yè wù liú chéng.
examples.english: She is learning the new business procedure.

entries.explanation: Bring a route or service into use.

examples.hanzi: 新地铁明天开通。
examples.pinyin: xīn dì tiě míng tiān kāi tōng.
examples.english: The new subway opens tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 我刚开通网上银行。
examples.pinyin: wǒ gāng kāi tōng wǎng shàng yín háng.
examples.english: I have just activated online banking.

entries.explanation: Items used for an activity or purpose.

examples.hanzi: 他去商店买生活用品。
examples.pinyin: tā qù shāng diàn mǎi shēng huó yòng pǐn.
examples.english: He went to buy household necessities.

examples.hanzi: 旅行用品已经收拾好了。
examples.pinyin: lǚ xíng yòng pǐn yǐ jīng shōu shi hǎo le.
examples.english: The travel supplies are packed.

parts.gloss: to use; to make use of; to employ

entries.explanation: Move into and out of a place.

examples.hanzi: 车辆从侧门进出。
examples.pinyin: chē liàng cóng cè mén jìn chū.
examples.english: Vehicles enter and leave through the side gate.

examples.hanzi: 进出大楼需要登记。
examples.pinyin: jìn chū dà lóu xū yào dēng jì.
examples.english: Registration is required when entering or leaving the building.

entries.explanation: The area along a country's territorial boundary.

examples.hanzi: 边境附近有一个小镇。
examples.pinyin: biān jìng fù jìn yǒu yí ge xiǎo zhèn.
examples.english: There is a small town near the border.

examples.hanzi: 他们在边境接受检查。
examples.pinyin: tā men zài biān jìng jiē shòu jiǎn chá.
examples.english: They underwent checks at the border.

entries.explanation: Have a document, asset or other thing in one's possession.

examples.hanzi: 她持有有效护照。
examples.pinyin: tā chí yǒu yǒu xiào hù zhào.
examples.english: She holds a valid passport.

examples.hanzi: 持有这张票可以免费参观。
examples.pinyin: chí yǒu zhè zhāng piào kě yǐ miǎn fèi cān guān.
examples.english: Holders of this ticket can visit for free.

entries.explanation: Leave one's home or usual location.

examples.hanzi: 外出前关好窗户。
examples.pinyin: wài chū qián guān hǎo chuāng hu.
examples.english: Close the windows before going out.

examples.hanzi: 她外出办事还没回来。
examples.pinyin: tā wài chū bàn shì hái méi huí lai.
examples.english: She went out on business and has not returned.

entries.explanation: Go past a place on the way somewhere.

examples.hanzi: 我回家时路过这家店。
examples.pinyin: wǒ huí jiā shí lù guò zhè jiā diàn.
examples.english: I pass this shop on my way home.

examples.hanzi: 他路过医院时看望了朋友。
examples.pinyin: tā lù guò yī yuàn shí kàn wàng le péng you.
examples.english: He visited his friend while passing the hospital.

entries.explanation: A shop serving coffee and related drinks or snacks.

examples.hanzi: 我们在咖啡店见面。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men zài kā fēi diàn jiàn miàn.
examples.english: We meet at the coffee shop.

examples.hanzi: 这家咖啡店早上七点开门。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi diàn zǎo shang qī diǎn kāi mén.
examples.english: This coffee shop opens at seven in the morning.

entries.explanation: Move away in a vehicle or cause a vehicle to leave.

examples.hanzi: 公交车已经开走了。
examples.pinyin: gōng jiāo chē yǐ jīng kāi zǒu le.
examples.english: The bus has already left.

examples.hanzi: 他把车从门口开走了。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ chē cóng mén kǒu kāi zǒu le.
examples.english: He drove the car away from the entrance.

entries.explanation: Sign an agreement or official document.

examples.hanzi: 双方签署了合同。
examples.pinyin: shuāng fāng qiān shǔ le hé tóng.
examples.english: Both parties signed the contract.

examples.hanzi: 签署之前请仔细阅读。
examples.pinyin: qiān shǔ zhī qián qǐng zǐ xì yuè dú.
examples.english: Read carefully before signing.

entries.explanation: Receive goods with payment deferred.

examples.hanzi: 这家店不允许赊账。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn bù yǔn xǔ shē zhàng.
examples.english: This shop does not allow purchases on credit.

examples.hanzi: 他赊账买了种子。
examples.pinyin: tā shē zhàng mǎi le zhǒng zi.
examples.english: He bought the seeds on credit.

entries.explanation: Give money for a charitable or public purpose.

examples.hanzi: 她向救助机构捐款。
examples.pinyin: tā xiàng jiù zhù jī gòu juān kuǎn.
examples.english: She donated to a relief organization.

examples.hanzi: 捐款用于修建图书馆。
examples.pinyin: juān kuǎn yòng yú xiū jiàn tú shū guǎn.
examples.english: The donations fund construction of the library.

entries.explanation: Acquire information, goods or other things.

examples.hanzi: 我们从公告中获取信息。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men cóng gōng gào zhōng huò qǔ xìn xī.
examples.english: We obtained the information from the notice.

examples.hanzi: 会员可以获取优惠券。
examples.pinyin: huì yuán kě yǐ huò qǔ yōu huì quàn.
examples.english: Members can obtain discount coupons.

entries.explanation: Go beyond an amount, boundary or expectation.

examples.hanzi: 行李重量超出了限制。
examples.pinyin: xíng li zhòng liàng chāo chū le xiàn zhì.
examples.english: The luggage exceeded the weight limit.

examples.hanzi: 维修费用超出了预算。
examples.pinyin: wéi xiū fèi yòng chāo chū le yù suàn.
examples.english: The repair cost exceeded the budget.

entries.explanation: A place serving alcoholic drinks.

examples.hanzi: 街角的酒馆关门了。
examples.pinyin: jiē jiǎo de jiǔ guǎn guān mén le.
examples.english: The tavern on the corner has closed.

chunks.gloss: close a door; close for business

examples.hanzi: 游客坐在酒馆外聊天。
examples.pinyin: yóu kè zuò zài jiǔ guǎn wài liáo tiān.
examples.english: The visitors chatted outside the tavern.

entries.explanation: The built-up area of a city.

examples.hanzi: 从机场到市区需要一小时。
examples.pinyin: cóng jī chǎng dào shì qū xū yào yì xiǎo shí.
examples.english: It takes an hour from the airport to the city.

examples.hanzi: 市区里停车很贵。
examples.pinyin: shì qū lǐ tíng chē hěn guì.
examples.english: Parking is expensive in the urban area.

entries.explanation: Have a collision involving vehicles.

examples.hanzi: 路口发生了撞车事故。
examples.pinyin: lù kǒu fā shēng le zhuàng chē shì gù.
examples.english: A vehicle collision occurred at the junction.

examples.hanzi: 司机及时刹车，避免了撞车。
examples.pinyin: sī jī jí shí shā chē, bì miǎn le zhuàng chē.
examples.english: The driver braked in time and avoided a collision.

entries.explanation: Give something in one's possession to another party.

examples.hanzi: 请交出柜子的钥匙。
examples.pinyin: qǐng jiāo chū guì zi de yào shi.
examples.english: Hand over the cabinet key.

examples.hanzi: 他交出了找到的钱包。
examples.pinyin: tā jiāo chū le zhǎo dào de qián bāo.
examples.english: He handed in the wallet he found.

entries.explanation: A person operating a vehicle or aircraft.

examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn bú zài shòu mài bào zhǐ.
examples.english: This shop no longer sells newspapers.

examples.hanzi: 他发现买到了假货。
examples.pinyin: tā fā xiàn mǎi dào le jiǎ huò.
examples.english: He found he had bought a counterfeit item.

examples.hanzi: 店主拒绝销售假货。
examples.pinyin: diàn zhǔ jù jué xiāo shòu jiǎ huò.
examples.english: The shopkeeper refuses to sell counterfeit goods.

entries.explanation: Premises used for selling goods or services.

examples.hanzi: 街边的商铺正在装修。
examples.pinyin: jiē biān de shāng pù zhèng zài zhuāng xiū.
examples.english: The shop premises beside the street are being renovated.

examples.hanzi: 这间商铺每月租金很高。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiān shāng pù měi yuè zū jīn hěn gāo.

examples.pinyin: tā zuò chuán shí róng yì yùn chuán.

examples.pinyin: tā yùn chuán hòu tǎng xià xiū xi.
examples.english: He lay down to rest after becoming seasick.

entries.explanation: A worker who moves goods or luggage.

examples.hanzi: 搬运工把箱子送进仓库。
examples.pinyin: bān yùn gōng bǎ xiāng zi sòng jìn cāng kù.
examples.english: The porter moved the boxes into the warehouse.

examples.hanzi: 他请搬运工帮忙抬家具。
examples.pinyin: tā qǐng bān yùn gōng bāng máng tái jiā jù.
examples.english: He asked a porter to help lift the furniture.

entries.explanation: Ask how to reach a place.

examples.hanzi: 我向警察问路。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiàng jǐng chá wèn lù.
examples.english: I asked the police officer for directions.

examples.pinyin: wèn lù shí kě yǐ chū shì dì tú.
examples.english: You can show a map when asking for directions.

entries.explanation: Carry out a task or procedure for another person.

examples.hanzi: 她请家人代办手续。
examples.pinyin: tā qǐng jiā rén dài bàn shǒu xù.
examples.english: She asked a relative to handle the formalities.

examples.hanzi: 这项业务可以代办。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng yè wù kě yǐ dài bàn.
examples.english: Someone else can handle this service for you.

parts.gloss: to be a substitute for; to act on behalf of; to replace; to substitute

entries.explanation: Make a paper copy of a document using a machine.

examples.hanzi: 请复印这份合同。
examples.pinyin: qǐng fù yìn zhè fèn hé tóng.
examples.english: Photocopy this contract.

examples.pinyin: wǒ zài lóu xià fù yìn le zhèng jiàn.
examples.english: I photocopied my identification downstairs.

entries.explanation: Read or capture an image or document electronically.

examples.hanzi: 她把照片扫描到电脑里。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ zhào piàn sǎo miáo dào diàn nǎo lǐ.
examples.english: She scanned the photo into the computer.

examples.pinyin: zhè tái jī qì kě yǐ sǎo miáo wén jiàn.
examples.english: This machine can scan documents.

entries.explanation: Send a file from a device to a remote system.

examples.hanzi: 请上传一张清楚的照片。
examples.pinyin: qǐng shàng chuán yì zhāng qīng chu de zhào piàn.
examples.english: Upload a clear photograph.

examples.pinyin: hé tóng yǐ jīng shàng chuán chéng gōng.
examples.english: The contract was uploaded successfully.

examples.hanzi: 我下载了车站地图。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xià zài le chē zhàn dì tú.
examples.english: I downloaded the station map.

examples.hanzi: 下载完成后可以打印。
examples.pinyin: xià zài wán chéng hòu kě yǐ dǎ yìn.
examples.english: You can print it after the download finishes.

examples.pinyin: zhàng dān shàng liè chū le shuǐ fèi.
examples.english: The water charge is listed on the bill.

examples.english: Electricity charges are higher in winter.

examples.english: He forgot to pay the electricity bill.

entries.explanation: The amount charged for a household gas supply.

examples.hanzi: 燃气费按用量计算。
examples.pinyin: rán qì fèi àn yòng liàng jì suàn.
examples.english: The gas charge is calculated from usage.

examples.pinyin: tā zài wǎng shàng jiāo le rán qì fèi.
examples.english: She paid the gas bill online.

entries.explanation: A charge for managing and maintaining shared property.

examples.hanzi: 物业费包含清洁服务。
examples.pinyin: wù yè fèi bāo hán qīng jié fú wù.
examples.english: The property management fee includes cleaning services.

examples.pinyin: wǒ shōu dào le yì zhāng wù yè fèi zhàng dān.
examples.english: I received a property management bill.

entries.explanation: Money paid in advance when arranging an order or reservation.

examples.hanzi: 订桌时她先付了订金。
examples.pinyin: dìng zhuō shí tā xiān fù le dìng jīn.
examples.english: She paid an advance amount when reserving the table.

examples.pinyin: shōu jù zhù míng le dìng jīn jīn é.
examples.english: The receipt states the advance payment amount.

examples.pinyin: tōng zhī zhōng liè chū le zhì nà jīn.
examples.english: The notice lists the late payment charge.

examples.hanzi: 他询问滞纳金如何计算。
examples.pinyin: tā xún wèn zhì nà jīn rú hé jì suàn.
examples.english: He asked how the late payment charge was calculated.

entries.explanation: Remove an amount from an account or payment.

examples.pinyin: yín háng yǐ jīng zì dòng kòu kuǎn.
examples.english: The bank has debited the payment automatically.

examples.pinyin: kòu kuǎn jì lù kě yǐ zài shǒu jī shàng chá kàn.
examples.english: You can check the debit record on your phone.

examples.pinyin: tā gěi jiā rén huì kuǎn.
examples.english: He sends money to his family.

examples.hanzi: 这笔汇款还没有到账。
examples.pinyin: zhè bǐ huì kuǎn hái méi yǒu dào zhàng.
examples.english: This remittance has not arrived yet.

chunks.gloss: (of money) to arrive in an account

entries.explanation: A document listing charges or account transactions.

examples.hanzi: 请把账单拿给我。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhàng dān ná gěi wǒ.
examples.english: Bring me the bill.

examples.hanzi: 她检查了每月的账单。
examples.pinyin: tā jiǎn chá le měi yuè de zhàng dān.
examples.english: She checked the monthly statement.

entries.explanation: Urge someone to pay money owed.

examples.pinyin: gōng sī fā chū le yì fēng cuī kuǎn yóu jiàn.
examples.english: The company sent a payment reminder email.

examples.hanzi: 他打电话给客户催款。
examples.pinyin: tā dǎ diàn huà gěi kè hù cuī kuǎn.
examples.english: He called the customer to request payment.

entries.explanation: Pay back money that is owed.

examples.hanzi: 还款日期是每月五号。
examples.pinyin: huán kuǎn rì qī shì měi yuè wǔ hào.
examples.english: Repayment is due on the fifth of each month.

examples.hanzi: 她按时完成了还款。
examples.pinyin: tā àn shí wán chéng le huán kuǎn.
examples.english: She made the repayment on time.

entries.explanation: A bank card linked to a savings or deposit account.

examples.hanzi: 工资打进了储蓄卡。
examples.pinyin: gōng zī dǎ jìn le chǔ xù kǎ.
examples.english: The salary was paid into the savings account.

examples.hanzi: 这张储蓄卡已经停用了。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng chǔ xù kǎ yǐ jīng tíng yòng le.
examples.english: This savings account card is no longer in use.

entries.explanation: The charge for leaving a vehicle in a parking area.

examples.hanzi: 停车费每小时五元。
examples.pinyin: tíng chē fèi měi xiǎo shí wǔ yuán.
examples.english: Parking costs five yuan an hour.

examples.hanzi: 酒店替住客支付停车费。
examples.pinyin: jiǔ diàn tì zhù kè zhī fù tíng chē fèi.
examples.english: The hotel pays guests' parking fees.

examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎo liú rù kǒu fā de tíng chē piào.
examples.english: Keep the parking ticket issued at the entrance.

examples.pinyin: fù kuǎn hòu bǎ tíng chē piào chā jìn jī qì.
examples.english: Insert the parking ticket into the machine after paying.

examples.pinyin: wǒ qí gòng xiǎng dān chē qù chē zhàn.
examples.english: I rode a shared bicycle to the station.

examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī jīng yíng kè yùn yè wù.

examples.pinyin: jiāo tōng kǎ kě yǐ zài jī qì shàng chōng zhí.

examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng jiāo tōng kǎ néng zuò dì tiě.

examples.pinyin: jī qì shàng de hóng dēng liàng le.

examples.pinyin: lǜ dēng liàng hòu chē liàng kāi shǐ qián jìn.
examples.english: The vehicles moved forward when the light turned green.

examples.pinyin: wǒ děng lǜ dēng zài guò mǎ lù.
examples.english: I wait for the green light before crossing.

examples.pinyin: xìn hào dēng biàn chéng le huáng dēng.

examples.hanzi: 面板上的黄灯一直闪烁。
examples.pinyin: miàn bǎn shàng de huáng dēng yì zhí shǎn shuò.

examples.pinyin: cóng zhè lǐ zhí xíng jiù dào chē zhàn.

examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo chē dào zhǐ néng zhí xíng.
examples.english: This lane is for straight-ahead traffic only.

examples.hanzi: 过桥后左转。
examples.pinyin: guò qiáo hòu zuǒ zhuǎn.

examples.pinyin: zhè liàng chē zhǔn bèi zuǒ zhuǎn.

entries.explanation: Change direction toward the right.

examples.pinyin: zài yín háng qián yòu zhuǎn.

examples.pinyin: yòu zhuǎn shí qǐng liú yì xíng rén.

examples.pinyin: sī jī zài qián miàn diào tóu.

examples.pinyin: sī jī děng dào ān quán shí cái chāo chē.

examples.pinyin: dēng jī pái shàng xiě zhe zuò wèi hào.
examples.english: The boarding pass shows the seat number.

examples.pinyin: ān jiǎn kǒu qián pái zhe cháng duì.

examples.pinyin: qǐng cóng zuǒ cè ān jiǎn kǒu jìn rù.
examples.english: Enter through the security checkpoint on the left.

entries.explanation: An entrance where tickets are checked.

examples.hanzi: 检票口已经开放。
examples.pinyin: jiǎn piào kǒu yǐ jīng kāi fàng.
examples.english: The ticket-checking gate is open.

examples.hanzi: 我在检票口旁边等你。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài jiǎn piào kǒu páng biān děng nǐ.
examples.english: I will wait beside the ticket gate.

entries.explanation: A place where tickets are sold.

examples.hanzi: 售票处就在入口右边。
examples.pinyin: shòu piào chù jiù zài rù kǒu yòu bian.
examples.english: The ticket office is to the right of the entrance.

examples.hanzi: 她去售票处询问余票。
examples.pinyin: tā qù shòu piào chù xún wèn yú piào.
examples.english: She asked about remaining tickets at the ticket office.

entries.explanation: A desk or office providing answers and directions.

examples.hanzi: 问讯处就在大厅门口。
examples.pinyin: wèn xùn chù jiù zài dà tīng mén kǒu.
examples.english: The information office is at the hall entrance.

examples.hanzi: 我到问讯处询问发车时间。
examples.pinyin: wǒ dào wèn xùn chù xún wèn fā chē shí jiān.
examples.english: I asked about departure times at the information office.

entries.explanation: A station where road tolls or other fees are collected.

examples.hanzi: 车辆在收费站前减速。
examples.pinyin: chē liàng zài shōu fèi zhàn qián jiǎn sù.
examples.english: Vehicles slowed before the toll station.

examples.pinyin: zhè ge shōu fèi zhàn jiē shòu xiàn jīn.
examples.english: This toll station accepts cash.

entries.explanation: A roadside area providing rest, food and vehicle services.

examples.hanzi: 我们在服务区吃午饭。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men zài fú wù qū chī wǔ fàn.
examples.english: We ate lunch at the service area.

examples.hanzi: 下一个服务区还有二十公里。
examples.pinyin: xià yī ge fú wù qū hái yǒu èr shí gōng lǐ.
examples.english: The next service area is twenty kilometers away.

entries.explanation: Inquire about information or directions.

examples.hanzi: 他向值班人员问讯。
examples.pinyin: tā xiàng zhí bān rén yuán wèn xùn.
examples.english: He asked the duty staff for information.

examples.hanzi: 旅客可以到大厅问讯。
examples.pinyin: lǚ kè kě yǐ dào dà tīng wèn xùn.
examples.english: Passengers can inquire in the hall.

entries.explanation: Help people in danger or difficulty.

examples.hanzi: 救援车辆已经到达。
examples.pinyin: jiù yuán chē liàng yǐ jīng dào dá.
examples.english: The rescue vehicles have arrived.

examples.pinyin: dà yǔ gěi jiù yuán zēng jiā le kùn nan.
examples.english: Heavy rain made the rescue harder.

examples.hanzi: 她救助了受伤的小猫。
examples.pinyin: tā jiù zhù le shòu shāng de xiǎo māo.
examples.english: She helped the injured kitten.

examples.pinyin: zhōng xīn wèi kùn nan jiā tíng tí gōng jiù zhù.
examples.english: The center provides relief to families in difficulty.

examples.hanzi: 工作人员调解了邻里纠纷。
examples.pinyin: gōng zuò rén yuán tiáo jiě le lín lǐ jiū fēn.

examples.pinyin: shuāng fāng tóng yì jiē shòu tiáo jiě.
examples.english: Both parties agreed to mediation.

entries.explanation: Gather information to understand an issue.

examples.hanzi: 警察正在调查事故。
examples.pinyin: jǐng chá zhèng zài diào chá shì gù.
examples.english: The police are investigating the accident.

examples.hanzi: 学校调查了学生的需求。
examples.pinyin: xué xiào diào chá le xué sheng de xū qiú.
examples.english: The school surveyed students' needs.

entries.explanation: Check an item or document for validity or compliance.

examples.hanzi: 工作人员查验了护照。
examples.pinyin: gōng zuò rén yuán chá yàn le hù zhào.
examples.english: The staff checked the passport.

examples.pinyin: huò wù xū yào kāi xiāng chá yàn.
examples.english: The goods need to be unpacked for inspection.

examples.hanzi: 材料已经寄出，请查收。
examples.pinyin: cái liào yǐ jīng jì chū, qǐng chá shōu.
examples.english: The documents have been sent; check their receipt.

examples.pinyin: tā chá shōu le jīn tiān de yóu jiàn.
examples.english: She checked today's incoming email.

entries.explanation: Complete a procedure again to replace a missing item.

examples.hanzi: 身份证丢了需要补办。
examples.pinyin: shēn fèn zhèng diū le xū yào bǔ bàn.
examples.english: A lost identity card needs replacing.

examples.pinyin: tā dào chuāng kǒu bǔ bàn zhèng jiàn.

examples.english: He submitted the missing application documents.

examples.pinyin: chuāng kǒu wèi tā huàn fā le xīn de zhèng shū.

examples.pinyin: tā lái bǔ lǐng diū shī de zhèng jiàn.
examples.english: She came to obtain a replacement for the lost document.

examples.pinyin: bǔ lǐng kǎ piàn xū yào dēng jì.

examples.hanzi: 他换领了新的驾驶证。
examples.pinyin: tā huàn lǐng le xīn de jià shǐ zhèng.

examples.pinyin: huàn lǐng shí qǐng dài shàng jiù kǎ.

examples.pinyin: lǐng zhèng rì qī xiě zài huí zhí shàng.

examples.pinyin: tā shàng wǔ qù chuāng kǒu lǐng zhèng.

examples.hanzi: 钱包丢失后他立即报失。
examples.pinyin: qián bāo diū shī hòu tā lì jí bào shī.

examples.pinyin: gōng zuò rén yuán chá xún le hù jí xìn xī.

examples.pinyin: tā shēn qǐng gēng xīn hù jí jì lù.

examples.pinyin: kāi diàn qián xū yào bàn lǐ zhí zhào.

examples.pinyin: zhèng míng shū shàng gài yǒu yìn zhāng.
examples.english: The certificate bears a stamp.

examples.pinyin: zhèng míng rén xiàng gōng zuò rén yuán jiě shì le qíng kuàng.

examples.pinyin: zhī qǔ jì lù kě yǐ chá xún.

examples.pinyin: cún zhé shàng yìn zhe zhàng hù yú é.
